ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

The Assignment Desk Editor will help ensure that the network is well positioned to cover the day's top stories across morning, dayside, and primetime programming for the 24-7 cable news network. This is a union position, and the successful candidate will need to join the News Guild upon hire.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Man NewsNation's national assignment desk during varied shifts
  • Identify news of interest to a national audience
  • Research stories, conduct outreach to sources to verify information and report out stories
  • Gather editorial information and elements to best tell stories including video, audio, and pictures
  • Coordinate coverage of news stories: news of day, breaking news, continuing stories with correspondents, producers, and photojournalists
  • Maintain direct contact with field teams to offer support, request and confirm live hits
  • Monitor social media and clear user generated content
  • Monitor competitive broadcasts, cable and digital platforms
  • Work with Nexstar T.V. stations to harness additional reporting resources and story elements and to provide NewsNation content to stations
  • Occasionally coordinate booking of transmission facilities and satellite space for live/tape feeds
  • Utilize various file sharing platforms to gather video
  • Follow and communicate Rights and Clearances restrictions
  • Assist in compiling editorial and logistics notes used by the newsgathering and show teams

• Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Five to ten years of newsroom experience ideally in national news or a top local market
  • Must be willing to work extended or modified shifts as news developments warrant
  • Must also be willing to weekdays and holidays as needed
  • Strong writing, organizational, and people skills are vital

• Attention to detail is key

  • The successful candidate will be a self-starter with excellent communication skills who brings lots of ideas to the table.

Compensation - $36.05 – 43.27 (Commensurate with experience)

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more. Part time employees are eligible for 401(k) and any local/state leave plans. Union positions are subject to the benefits outlined in their Collective Bargaining Agreement.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Job Description

Are you a compassionate, organized, and relationship-focused nurse who loves helping people find their way through the healthcare system? As a Care Connection Nurse Navigator, you’ll be a trusted advocate and primary point of contact for patients as they connect with care across the organization.

This role is focused on helping new patients establish primary care, connecting patients with the right services, and making every step of their healthcare experience as seamless as possible. You’ll combine clinical knowledge with exceptional customer service to coordinate appointments, navigate referrals, identify barriers to care, provide education and support, and connect patients with the resources they need to achieve their best possible outcomes.

You’ll work closely with physicians, nurses, clinical teams, and non-clinical staff throughout the organization to build strong relationships and create solutions that work for both patients and care teams. You’ll also help strengthen connections between patients and the organization by promoting available services, supporting access to myUHealth, and proactively identifying opportunities to keep patients engaged in their care.

What You’ll Bring (Minimum Requirements)

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or equivalent combination of an Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN) and relevant experience.

  • Current Missouri Registered Nurse (RN) license.

  • Minimum of three years of experience working in a healthcare setting.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to read and speak the English language.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • Current BCLS certification.

  • Ability to develop and maintain strong knowledge of healthcare resources and services available within the organization and through community health-related organizations.

  • Ability to maintain a calm and professional demeanor in a demanding, high-stress environment while consistently demonstrating sound judgment, exceptional customer service, and strong problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to handle patient concerns and sensitive information with tact, professionalism, and confidentiality.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse cultural, socioeconomic, and professional backgrounds.

  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently as an autonomous self-starter and collaboratively as a team player.

  • Professional appearance and presentation.

What You’ll Do

Be a Trusted Patient Advocate

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for referred and newly engaged patients throughout their healthcare experience.

  • Proactively reach out to patients who are not yet established with primary care and help connect them with the appropriate provider and services.

  • Answer incoming calls, accurately identify patient needs, and guide patients to the appropriate area of care or service.

  • Schedule physician appointments and help patients understand what to expect before, during, and after their visits.

  • Verify insurance information and ensure required pre-certifications and authorizations are obtained and appropriately documented.

  • Explain organizational policies and procedures in a clear, helpful, and patient-friendly manner.

  • Make appointment reminder calls and proactively schedule future appointments when appropriate.

  • Greet and guide patients to the appropriate areas of care and assist with questions related to billing information.

Coordinate Care Across the Healthcare System

  • Assess patients’ medical needs and help coordinate care across multiple settings and services.

  • Track laboratory and imaging results and notify patients of normal and abnormal results according to established protocols.

  • Provide timely clinical advice by telephone and electronic messaging during and after office hours, within the scope of practice and established protocols.

  • Coordinate referrals and track patients throughout the referral process to help ensure care is completed without unnecessary delays.

  • Facilitate the exchange of clinical information during inpatient hospitalizations.

  • Provide telephonic or face-to-face follow-up with patients within 72 hours of emergency department or inpatient discharge.

  • Promote continuity of care by helping patients move smoothly between primary care, specialty care, inpatient, outpatient, and community services.

  • Provide direct clinic patient care as needed based on department priorities, staffing, and patient volumes.

Remove Barriers & Connect Patients to Resources

  • Work collaboratively with clinical and non-clinical team members to identify barriers that may prevent patients from accessing or completing care.

  • Develop solutions and connect patients with appropriate organizational and community resources.

  • Build and maintain strong knowledge of healthcare resources and services available within the organization and throughout the community.

  • Provide patient education, outreach, encouragement, and ongoing support to promote successful engagement in care.

  • Help patients navigate and make the most of myUHealth and other available tools and services.

  • Promote awareness of preventative care, wellness services, and other healthcare resources available through the organization and University Health.

  • Look for opportunities to proactively connect patients with services that can support their health and well-being.

Build Relationships & Deliver Exceptional Service

  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with physicians, support staff, clinical teams, and non-clinical personnel throughout the organization.

  • Partner with providers and staff to accommodate patient needs, support access to care, and contribute to organizational patient volumes.

  • Demonstrate strong collaboration, communication, relationship-building, and team-building skills.

  • Practice cultural competency and adapt communication and support to meet the needs of diverse patients and families.

  • Create a culture of exemplary customer service and responsive, patient-centered care.

  • Ensure care is compassionate, coordinated, and respectful of each patient’s preferences, values, and individual needs.

  • Consistently demonstrate a calm, professional, courteous, and helpful demeanor, even in demanding or high-stress situations.

  • Handle patient concerns and sensitive information with tact, professionalism, confidentiality, and sound judgment.

Document, Track & Improve

  • Accurately document patient services and interactions in the electronic medical record.

  • Track and manage data related to the patient navigation program to demonstrate outcomes and monitor service quality.

  • Generate reports related to patient navigation program performance as requested by the manager or designee.

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives designed to enhance patient access, service, safety, and outcomes.

  • Promote staff and patient safety and cultural diversity through daily operations and personal performance.

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and find more effective ways to support patients and care teams.

Bring Flexibility & Leadership to the Team

  • Adapt to changing priorities, accept new assignments, and approach new challenges with flexibility and enthusiasm.

  • Look for opportunities to learn new skills, improve workflows, and help others learn new tasks.

  • Evaluate and maintain nursing practice in accordance with professional standards, guidelines, applicable statutes, rules, regulations, and organizational expectations.

  • Provide age-appropriate service and demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to meet patients’ physical, psychosocial, educational, and safety needs.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Compliance & Professional Excellence

  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable statutes, regulations, guidelines, and standards necessary to perform job responsibilities.

  • Comply with the organization’s Code of Conduct, Corporate Compliance Plan, and Compliance Policies and Procedures, including all required training.

  • Participate in compliance activities under the direction of the Department Manager and Corporate Compliance Officer.

  • Consistently represent the organization with professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to patient-centered care.

jobs.title: Freelance Integrated Brand Partnerships & Sponsorship Revenue Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About the ShowJust N Life with Nekia Nichelle is a lifestyle and entertainment television series bringing together meaningful conversations, culture, wellness, beauty, fashion, food, entrepreneurship, and everyday inspiration.
jobs.description:
About the Show

Just N Life with Nekia Nichelle is a lifestyle and entertainment television series bringing together meaningful conversations, culture, wellness, beauty, fashion, food, entrepreneurship, and everyday inspiration.

The show combines the warmth of a lifestyle program with the energy of a modern talk show, creating partnership opportunities across broadcast television, streaming, digital content, editorial coverage, social media, creator-driven media, and live or experiential extensions.

As the show grows, we are expanding our ability to connect brands with relevant stories, trusted conversations, and culturally meaningful content.

Who We're Looking For

We are not looking for a traditional advertising salesperson who only sells commercial spots or waits for leads to be provided.

We are looking for an experienced, relationship-driven partnership seller who already understands how brands invest in modern media, branded entertainment, sponsorships, integrated marketing, and cross-platform storytelling.

The ideal candidate enters this opportunity with an active and relevant book of business that includes established relationships with brands, advertising and media agencies, CMOs, brand marketing executives, media buyers, partnership leaders, public relations agencies, and sponsorship decision-makers.

This person must know how to open the right doors, identify a brand's business objectives, develop a compelling partnership concept, present the opportunity, negotiate the terms, and move the relationship toward a signed and paid agreement.

This is not an entry-level sales opportunity. It is designed for a proven closer who can confidently represent a growing television property and develop meaningful, high-value partnerships.

The Role

The Freelance Integrated Brand Partnerships & Sponsorship Revenue Specialist will be responsible for originating and closing paid sponsorships and brand integrations for Just N Life with Nekia Nichelle.

The primary focus is selling brands into the show through segment sponsorships, season partnerships, presenting sponsorships, category exclusivity, branded entertainment, product or service integrations, and customized cross-platform opportunities.

This role is different from selling an individual marketing campaign. The selected specialist must be able to sell the larger value of the show, its content, its audience, its intellectual property, and its television, digital, social, editorial, and experiential extensions.

The specialist will manage the revenue-development process from the initial relationship and discovery conversation through proposal development, negotiation, closing, payment coordination, and partnership handoff.

What You Will Sell

Partnership opportunities may include:

  • Individual sponsored television segments
  • Recurring branded segments
  • Full-season sponsorships
  • Presenting or title sponsorships
  • Whole-show sponsorship opportunities
  • Category-exclusive partnerships
  • Branded-content and branded-entertainment integrations
  • Product or service integrations within approved segments
  • Expert, spokesperson, or thought-leadership integrations
  • Sponsored demonstrations and lifestyle features
  • Sponsored resource guides or audience experiences
  • Custom broadcast integrations
  • Television and digital content packages
  • Social media and creator-led extensions
  • Editorial and website extensions
  • Event, experiential, and community activation opportunities
  • Approved multi-platform packages across the broader Nekia Nichelle Media Ecosystem

All partnership concepts, pricing, benefits, editorial involvement, talent usage, category exclusivity, and deliverables are subject to company approval.

Core Responsibilities

Generate Sponsorship Revenue

  • Originate, develop, and close paid sponsorships and integrated brand partnerships.
  • Use existing brand and agency relationships to introduce qualified partnership opportunities.
  • Build new relationships with prospective sponsors and agency decision-makers.
  • Maintain an active pipeline of qualified brands with the ability and intent to invest.
  • Focus on revenue-producing conversations rather than general networking without a defined business opportunity.

Sell High-Level Show Integrations

  • Position the show as a premium media and branded-storytelling opportunity.
  • Sell segment, season, presenting, category, and whole-show sponsorships.
  • Develop customized concepts that connect a partner's objectives with the show's content and audience.
  • Package broadcast visibility with approved digital, social, editorial, creator, and experiential extensions.
  • Clearly communicate the difference between a basic media placement and a fully integrated brand partnership.

Lead the Sales Process

  • Conduct discovery conversations with brand and agency decision-makers.
  • Identify the prospect's audience, campaign, visibility, storytelling, and business objectives.
  • Develop and deliver persuasive presentations, proposals, and sponsorship recommendations.
  • Respond to objections and guide prospects toward the appropriate partnership level.
  • Negotiate approved commercial terms and move qualified opportunities toward closing.
  • Follow up consistently without allowing viable opportunities to stall.
  • Coordinate the completion of partnership agreements and payment requirements.

Maintain and Activate a Book of Business

  • Bring an active network of relevant brand, agency, and sponsorship relationships.
  • Re-engage appropriate existing contacts with tailored opportunities for the show.
  • Maintain professional, long-term relationships that can generate renewals and expanded partnerships.
  • Identify brands whose products, services, expertise, or audience objectives align naturally with the show.
  • Protect confidential information belonging to current or former employers and comply with any valid contractual restrictions.

Develop Partnership Concepts

  • Work with leadership and production representatives to develop partnership-ready show opportunities.
  • Translate show concepts into clear, buyer-friendly sponsorship packages.
  • Recommend new recurring segments, categories, or content franchises that could support partner investment.
  • Balance partner objectives with the show's creative direction, editorial integrity, audience trust, and production capabilities.
  • Avoid promising deliverables, results, exclusivity, talent participation, editorial coverage, or usage rights without written approval.

Manage the Pipeline and CRM

  • Record all leads, contacts, conversations, proposals, follow-ups, and deal stages in the company's designated CRM.
  • Maintain accurate contact and company information.
  • Document the source and ownership of each opportunity.
  • Provide reliable revenue projections and pipeline updates.
  • Identify stalled deals, next actions, decision-makers, objections, and expected closing dates.
  • Keep company leadership informed of material developments, risks, and partnership requests.

Support Partnership Handoff and Retention

  • Provide the production and fulfillment teams with a complete summary of sold deliverables.
  • Participate in the partnership kickoff and handoff process when needed.
  • Maintain the commercial relationship while internal teams manage approved fulfillment.
  • Help identify renewal, upsell, extension, and long-term partnership opportunities.
  • Support post-partnership conversations that demonstrate value and encourage repeat investment.

Revenue-Share Compensation

This is a freelance, performance-based revenue-share opportunity.

The selected specialist will receive 20% of qualifying gross partnership revenue actually collected by the company from eligible partnerships the specialist personally originates and closes.

There is:

  • No base salary
  • No hourly wage
  • No guaranteed minimum
  • No employee benefits
  • No payment for unsigned proposals
  • No revenue share on funds that are not received by the company

The specialist's written independent-contractor agreement will define:

  • What constitutes qualifying partnership revenue
  • How the company determines lead and account ownership
  • Requirements for documenting a sourced opportunity
  • Treatment of company-provided leads
  • Credit for jointly developed or jointly closed opportunities
  • Revenue-share eligibility for renewals, extensions, and upsells
  • Treatment of existing company accounts and previously active prospects
  • Payment timing after partner funds are received
  • Treatment of payment plans and installment payments
  • Treatment of cancellations, refunds, credits, nonpayment, and chargebacks
  • Treatment of separately itemized taxes and approved third-party pass-through costs
  • Any revenue-share rights following the end of the freelance engagement

Revenue-share payments will be calculated only on qualifying funds actually received and cleared by the company, subject to the final written agreement.

Availability and Communication

Candidates must maintain reliable availability Monday through Friday between 11:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Central Time.

This does not mean the specialist will be scheduled continuously throughout the entire five-hour window. However, the specialist must generally be reachable and able to schedule prospect meetings, partner calls, sales follow-ups, proposal discussions, and internal coordination during these core business hours.

The selected specialist must:

  • Respond to time-sensitive business communications professionally and promptly
  • Attend scheduled partnership and pipeline meetings
  • Communicate through the company's approved communication channels
  • Keep calendars and availability current
  • Meet proposal, follow-up, reporting, and documentation deadlines
  • Notify the appropriate contact in advance when availability materially changes

Some partner meetings or special opportunities may fall outside the standard availability window and will be coordinated in advance when possible.

Required Experience

  • At least five years of relevant experience in sponsorship sales, media sales, branded entertainment, integrated marketing, brand partnerships, advertising sales, or business development
  • An active and relevant book of business with brand, agency, media-buying, or sponsorship decision-makers
  • A demonstrated record of personally originating and closing paid partnerships
  • Experience selling customized sponsorships rather than only predetermined advertising inventory
  • Experience presenting to senior brand, marketing, agency, or corporate decision-makers
  • Understanding of television, digital media, branded content, social media, creator marketing, and integrated campaigns
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, relationship-management, and closing skills
  • Ability to develop proposals and communicate the commercial value of a partnership
  • Experience managing a sales pipeline and maintaining accurate CRM records
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet agreed deadlines
  • Reliable computer, internet connection, telephone access, and professional virtual-meeting environment
  • Availability Monday through Friday from 11:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Central Time

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to candidates with:

  • Experience selling television, streaming, podcast, publisher, entertainment, or creator-led sponsorships
  • Current relationships with national or regional consumer brands
  • Current relationships with advertising, media, experiential, multicultural, or public relations agencies
  • Experience closing segment, season, presenting, category-exclusive, or multi-platform sponsorships
  • Experience working with lifestyle, entertainment, beauty, wellness, fashion, food, travel, financial services, technology, automotive, retail, or entrepreneurship-focused brands
  • Experience developing five- or six-figure custom media partnerships
  • Familiarity with partnership agreements, media kits, sponsorship decks, pricing structures, usage rights, category exclusivity, and fulfillment requirements

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Qualified brand and agency conversations
  • Decision-maker meetings secured
  • Value of the active sales pipeline
  • Sponsorship proposals presented
  • Partnerships contracted
  • Partnership revenue collected
  • Closing rate
  • Accuracy of CRM and pipeline records
  • Quality of internal partnership handoffs
  • Sponsor retention, renewals, and expanded agreements
  • Professional representation of the show and company

Activity without qualified movement toward revenue will not be considered sufficient performance.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who is polished, persuasive, proactive, accountable, and commercially sharp.

You should be comfortable initiating conversations, asking direct business questions, discussing budgets, following up consistently, negotiating value, and closing agreements.

You must understand that a strong book of business is more than a list of names. It means maintaining credible, active relationships with people who trust your judgment and are positioned to consider legitimate sponsorship opportunities.

Confidentiality, communication, documentation, and integrity are essential. The specialist may have access to unreleased show concepts, sponsorship pricing, prospective partner information, talent information, production plans, and other confidential business materials.

This opportunity is ideal for an experienced partnership professional who wants to help build a growing television property and earn directly from the revenue they generate.

Independent-Contractor Relationship

This is a freelance independent-contractor engagement and not an offer of employment.

The selected specialist is responsible for their own applicable taxes, insurance, business expenses, equipment, and other independent-contractor obligations unless otherwise stated in the written agreement.

The specialist may not sign agreements, alter approved pricing, promise editorial coverage, commit production resources, grant usage rights, approve category exclusivity, or otherwise legally bind the company without prior written authorization.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your résumé
  • A brief introduction describing your sponsorship and integrated-media sales experience
  • A summary of the industries represented within your current book of business
  • An anonymized overview of relevant brand and agency relationships
  • Two examples of partnerships you personally originated and closed
  • The approximate value or deal-size range of those partnerships
  • Confirmation that you accept a 20% performance-based revenue-share structure with no base salary or hourly compensation
  • Confirmation that you are available Monday through Friday from 11:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Central Time
  • Any relevant sponsorship decks, case studies, sales presentations, or partnership materials that you are legally permitted to share

Do not submit confidential client lists, proprietary documents belonging to another company, private contact information, or materials restricted by a current or former employer.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr.Data Scientist - Process Modeling

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will join the Digital Process and Systems Analysis group within Process Development plays a key role in providing data infrastructure, platforms, and analytics to support engineering teams across our network, ensuring state-of-the-art data insights to drive innovation and efficiency for the commercialization and optimization of Amgen’s pipeline. This group also supports key priorities and the development of strategies for digital process development for both biologic and synthetic moieties.

This position is part of a team advancing biologics drug-substance modeling and the digitization of tech-transfer workflows. As new modeling capabilities are developed and information is parameterized, opportunities abound to deploy modeling tools to enable early insights and phase-appropriate decision-making. These capabilities support drug substance development, technology transfer, manufacture, and life-cycle management across Amgen’s global network of manufacturing and development sites.

This role will contribute to the success of Drug Substance Technology organization by helping to digitize workflows to drive improvements in technology transfer timelines and ensure right-first-time success. As a Sr. Data Scientist, you will evaluate and improve Amgen’s digital assets, collaborating as part of a multi-disciplinary team of scientists and engineers on a wide range of problems. The position will lead to solutions for open-ended “no single right answer” challenges, including modeling, data pipelines, and visualizations to support drug substance development, tech transfer, and manufacturing. The Sr. Data Scientist will also be responsible for determining, defining, and tracking performance improvements.

Responsibilities:

  • Leverage tech-transfer and process-modeling domain knowledge to drive implementation of digital technologies
  • Digital Product Ownership of tech-transfer digital applications, focused initially on expansion of digital process-modeling for the DS network
  • Change management to integrate tech transfer digital applications into product teams
  • Development of data products to enable FAIR data for tech transfer/NPI
  • Enable AI Agentic workflows for DST modeling assets
  • Collaborate with digital product teams to build and integrate modeling assets into business processes for DST
  • Interact cross-functionally with a wide variety of people and teams. Work closely with engineers to identify opportunities for process design improvements for Amgen products
  • Make business recommendations (cost-benefit, forecasting, scenario analysis) with effective presentation of findings to varied levels of stakeholders
  • Contribute to establishing a robust data science strategy by providing recommendations related to process monitoring, data engineering, analytic platforms, analysis plans, and other relevant areas of data science

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Data Scientist professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications.

Doctorate degree

OR

Master’s degree and 2 years of Data Science or Engineering experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Data Science or Engineering experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 8 years of Data Science or Engineering experience

OR

High School diploma or GED and 10 years of Data Science or Engineering experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MS degree or doctorate in an engineering or scientific field with demonstrated capability in application of data science.

  • 3+ years of work experience in biotechnology role (e.g. process engineer, scientist, data scientist)

  • Experience in developing AI applications for process development workflows and integrating AI solutions into process development business processes
  • Experience with process modeling for cell-culture, harvest,and purification scale-up
  • Demonstrated performance in application of digital tools to solve analytical problems
  • Demonstrated effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated leadership and self-direction. Demonstrated willingness to both teach others and learn new techniques as well as manage team members and deliverables.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.excerpt: wir suchenSie möchten nicht nur Software entwickeln, sondern technische Lösungen von der Idee bis zum produktiven Betrieb gestalten?
jobs.description:
wir suchen

Sie möchten nicht nur Software entwickeln, sondern technische Lösungen von der Idee bis zum produktiven Betrieb gestalten? - Dann sind Sie bei HWS richtig. Wir sind eine mittelständische Wirtschaftsprüfungs- und Steuerberatungsgesellschaft aus Baden-Württemberg. Unsere Arbeit verbindet anspruchsvolle Beratung mit dem klaren Ziel, Prozesse intelligenter, einfacher und digitaler zu gestalten.

Dafür suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Software Solution Architect (m/w/d), der unsere Softwarearchitektur maßgeblich mitgestaltet und gleichzeitig nah an der technischen Umsetzung bleibt. Unser technologischer Schwerpunkt liegt auf C# und dem modernen .NET-Stack – ebenso wie auf einer KI-basierten Softwareentwicklung. Wir arbeiten mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen und Large Language Models (LLMs), um Anforderungen zu analysieren, Architekturen und Code zu entwerfen, Tests vorzubereiten und Dokumentationen zu erstellen.

Deshalb suchen wir keine klassische Softwareentwicklung – bei der jede Zeile Code selbst geschrieben wird, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die KI-gestützte Entwicklung professionell steuert: effiziente Prompts formuliert, Ergebnisse kritisch prüft, Qualität sicherstellt und gemeinsam mit dem Team wartbare und zuverlässig betreibbare Softwarelösungen schafft.

ihre aufgaben

Sie gestalten gemeinsam mit unserem Team die technische Architektur unserer digitalen Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung und moderner Softwareentwicklung.

Dabei arbeiten Sie sowohl an internen Anwendungen zur Automatisierung und Digitalisierung unserer Kanzlei als auch an digitalen Produkten und Services für unsere Mandant:innen.

Konkret bedeutet das:

  • Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für Solution Design und Softwarearchitektur neuer und bestehender Anwendungen und entwickeln daraus tragfähige technische Zielbilder.
  • Sie entwerfen und entwickeln Lösungen schwerpunktmäßig auf Basis von C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core und Web APIs.
  • Sie definieren geeignete Architekturprinzipien, Schnittstellen, Komponenten und Datenmodelle und schaffen damit die Grundlage für langfristig wartbare Systeme.
  • Sie wählen pragmatisch zwischen modularen Anwendungen, Services und Integrationslösungen – passend zur jeweiligen Aufgabenstellung.
  • Sie konzipieren die Integration interner und externer Systeme über REST APIs und weitere Schnittstellen, beispielsweise zu Finanzbuchhaltung, Dokumentenmanagement, Kollaborations- oder Datenplattformen.
  • Sie entwickeln unsere GitLab-basierte Entwicklungs- und Delivery-Landschaft, unsere CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Prozesse gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.
  • Sie analysieren bestehende Anwendungen und Systemlandschaften, erkennen technische Risiken und entwickeln geeignete Modernisierungs- und Migrationsstrategien.
  • Sie bleiben nah an der technischen Umsetzung, entwickeln bei wichtigen Komponenten und Prototypen selbst mit und unterstützen das Team durch Code- und Architecture-Reviews.
  • Sie arbeiten eng mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammen, übersetzen fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungen und dokumentieren wesentliche Architekturentscheidungen nachvollziehbar.
  • Sie nutzen KI- und LLM-Werkzeuge von der Anforderungsanalyse und dem Solution Design bis zur Codegenerierung, Dokumentation und Testvorbereitung. Die Ergebnisse prüfen Sie konsequent im Hinblick auf Qualität, Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit, Performance und Compliance.

ihr profil

Unser Tech-Stack entwickelt sich mit unseren Anforderungen kontinuierlich weiter. Für diese Rolle setzen wir bewusst einen starken Schwerpunkt auf das Microsoft- und C#-Ökosystem: C# · .NET · ASP.NET Core · Web APIs · REST · Entity Framework · SQL · GitLab · CI/CD · Docker
Darüber hinaus begegnen Ihnen moderne Web-Technologien, Cloud- und Container-Plattformen, Automatisierung, Identity & Access Management, Monitoring sowie KI- und LLM-basierte Anwendungen.

Das macht Sie aus und passt zu HWS:

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# und .NET, idealerweise in einer Senior-, Lead- oder Architekturrolle
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Solution Design und in der Architektur anspruchsvoller Softwarelösungen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, API- und Backend-Entwicklung sowie in Datenmodellierung, Systemintegration und verteilten Systemen
  • Praxiserfahrung mit GitLab, CI/CD-Pipelines, Docker, relationalen Datenbanken und ORM-Technologien
  • Erfahrung entlang des gesamten Software-Lifecycles – von der Analyse und Entwicklung über automatisierte Tests bis zu Deployment und Monitoring
  • Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie die Fähigkeit, pragmatische Architekturentscheidungen zu treffen und bei Bedarf selbst produktiven Code zu entwickeln
  • Ein hoherQualitätsanspruch, den Sie durch Standards, Reviews, automatisierte Tests und Security-Checks im Team verankern
  • Sichere Deutschkenntnisse und die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln
  • Erfahrung mit oder Interesse an KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung: Sie steuern KI-Werkzeuge gezielt, formulieren Anforderungen präzise und validieren die Ergebnisse verantwortungsvoll
  • Idealerweise Interesse an datenintensiven oder regulierten Prozessen sowie an Finance, Tax und Compliance – das notwendige Fachwissen vermitteln wir Ihnen

warum wir?

  • Arbeiten von überall in Deutschland: Wir arbeiten remote und setzen auf eine verlässliche, direkte Zusammenarbeit ohne überflüssige Präsenzpflicht.
  • Echte Architekturverantwortung: Sie setzen nicht nur vorgegebene Tickets um, sondern gestalten maßgeblich mit, wie unsere zukünftige Softwarelandschaft aufgebaut wird.
  • Hands-on statt PowerPoint-Architektur: Architektur und Entwicklung gehören für uns zusammen. Ihre technischen Entscheidungen müssen sich daher auch im produktiven System bewähren.
  • Ein moderner .NET-Technologiestack: C# und .NET bilden den zentralen technologischen Schwerpunkt unserer Softwareentwicklung.
  • Engineering mit Anspruch: Automatisierte Tests, GitLab CI/CD, saubere Schnittstellen, Security, Observability und wartbarer Code sind für uns feste Bestandteile professioneller Softwareentwicklung.
  • Technologischer Gestaltungsspielraum: Sie setzen Technologien gezielt dort ein, wo sie ein konkretes Problem sinnvoll lösen – nicht nur, weil sie gerade im Trend liegen.
  • Kurze Wege: Sie arbeiten direkt mit den Menschen zusammen, die Ihre Lösungen später einsetzen, und können fachliche sowie technische Entscheidungen wirksam beeinflussen.
  • Raum für neue Themen: Neben klassischen Geschäftsanwendungen beschäftigen Sie sich bei uns mit Automatisierung, Datenintegration und neuen Möglichkeiten durch KI und Large Language Models.
  • Ein bodenständiges Team: Sie erwartet ein professionelles und hilfsbereites Team ohne unnötiges Tech-Theater. Gute Argumente zählen bei uns mehr als Titel.
  • AI-first Engineering: Wir entwickeln maßgeblich KI-gestützt und nutzen LLMs entlang des gesamten Software-Lifecycles – von der Anforderungsanalyse und Architektur über die Implementierung bis hin zu Testing, Dokumentation und Betrieb.
  • Qualität durch systematische Reviews: KI-generierte Ergebnisse übernehmen wir nicht ungeprüft, sondern sichern sie durch automatisierte Tests, strukturierte Review-Prozesse und klare Qualitätssicherungskriterien ab.

ansprechpartner

Klingt nach Ihrem nächsten Schritt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf sowie – wenn vorhanden – Links zu GitHub, Portfolio, Projektbeispielen oder anderen Arbeiten, auf die Sie stolz sind.

Frau Beatrix Dreher

Job Title: Coding Services Specialist
Reports To: Coding Services Director
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote

Company Description
Vee Healthtek is an expertise-led, technology-powered revenue cycle partner. We help healthcare providers turn rework into resilience. We engineer first-pass performance - work done right the first time, upstream, so denials are prevented rather than managed. We pioneered Open Accountability - making performance visible, aligning our success with providers', and earning renewal through results rather than lock-in. We exist to make the business of care - the revenue cycle resilient, so clinicians can focus on care and patients progress with confidence. To learn more, please visit


This position is responsible for reviewing documentation of outpatient diagnostic and ancillary services for diagnostic radiology, meeting performance standards set for accurate and timely submission of charges and coding for professional and facility services. It will require maintaining hourly productivity standards and quality standards as set by Vee Healthtek, Inc. and Industry Standards. This position require attendance at department meetings via conference call and Microsoft Teams. Coding Work Queue assignment will vary based on business needs or management assignment.


Major Responsibilities:
  • Analyzes medical records to abstract clinical data by assigning codes from patient records in accordance with the coding classification systems of ICD-10-CM and/or CPT, HCPCS.
  • Review patient encounters for accurate code assignment of all relevant diagnoses and procedures and/or modifiers.
  • Review and check for CCI bundling edits as well as NCD/LCD edits.
  • Enter appropriate codes into the client’s coding program for the transfer of data to billing files for reimbursement.
  • Queries manager when code assignments are not straightforward or documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes.

Essential Responsibilities:
  • Applies guidelines as indicated through the Local Coverage Determination (LCD), National Coverage Determination (NCD), as well as the National Correct Coding Initiative (CCI) as set for the by the client.
  • Resolves claim and billing edits as well as denials by performing second review of medical record documentation and code assignments. Review and provide resolution of edits/warnings. You will assign codes to medical diagnoses and procedures using appropriate coding classifications for assigned areas/record types.
  • Communicates with department manager on coding, compliance, and documentation issues.
  • Seeks clarification from healthcare providers or other designated resources to ensure accurate and complete coding.
  • Enhances coding knowledge and skills with continuing education activities and by reviewing pertinent literature.
  • Within the scope of the job, requires critical thinking skills, decisive judgment, and the ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Follows guidelines for each project as set by the client.

Required Skills:
  • 3-5 Years Diagnostic Radiology Coding experience
  • 3M experience a plus
  • Audit scored at 95% or better
  • Maintain a production rate of 90% or higher
  • Maintain strict confidentiality/follow HIPAA rules
  • RCC, CPC or CCS-P or equivalent certification
  • Possess moderate knowledge of level 1&2 modifiers
  • Radiology coders must be able to code the following modalities: Level I, Duplex and Doppler ultrasounds, CT’s/CTA’s, MRI’s and Nuclear medicine at a minimum

Minimum Requirements:
  • Ability to examine documents for accuracy and completeness
  • Ability to understand and follow compliance issues of moderate complexity
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to identify and resolve problems
  • Must possess moderate knowledge of CCI edits and LCDs and be able to accurately apply regulation knowledge to coding situations
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with co-workers
  • Conduct self in an ethical, honest, and professional manner

Salary: $25.00 - $28.00/hour depending on experience. This position is eligible for full health insurance including medical/dental/vision, PTO, and a 401k match!

*A Coding Assessment Test will be administered before initial pre-screen.

*Must be a US resident and reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Texas.

Travel Requirements: Fully remote/home-based office

We are a group of relentless optimists and innovators in education, working collaboratively with public and private partners to help improve the student experience and expand pathways to economic and social mobility in communities across California.

The Success Center at the Foundation for California Community Colleges supports California Community Colleges in advancing equity-centered student success through policy development, research, strategic innovation projects, field engagement, and professional development. This work is engaging, fast-paced, and ever evolving and requires a flexible personality who enjoys working in a team-based environment. The Foundation for California Community Colleges is the trusted partner of the California Community Colleges— facilitating collaboration, accelerating innovation, and increasing system-wide resources.

  • Build and sustain strong relationships with FoundationCCC partners, the Chancellor’s Office, and other higher education, government, and nonprofit partners
  • Stay attuned to federal, state and system office policy development efforts by attending Chancellor’s Office events, Board of Governors meetings, legislative hearings and briefings, and other relevant meetings, virtually or in-person.

Attributes for Success

  • Minimum of three (3) years of related work experience in stakeholder engagement, policy development, research, or project management.
  • Experience working within higher education systems and structures, including working with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Experience conducting secondary, applied research, writing in-depth reports in a professional setting, and managing multiple projects with competing deadlines.

  • We have a commitment to professional development and an emphasis on shared leadership, to ensure growth for employees and the organization overall

What we Offer

FoundationCCC is fully committed to a “remote-first” philosophy, and recruits and hires talent across the state in fully remote positions, where virtual work is possible. Our headquarters are located in Downtown Sacramento, just blocks from California’s State Capitol.

jobs.excerpt: At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience.
jobs.description:
At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra is what drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and instead create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for Fortune 500 companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. And we make this lofty standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design and technology together to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone.

We use these values to fuel superior results:

Lock arms
We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good.

Show hustle
We’re not ones to sit on our hands and wait. Instead, we anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional.

Embrace change
From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what’s next.

Elevate empathy
We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.

Never settle
We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.

 

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you. 
 
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Project Manager with a consulting mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for cultivating high-performing teams and acting as a trusted advisor to our clients. You will drive delivery excellence and value outcomes with speed and quality on your programs/projects. You will bring your expertise to partner with clients, identify their needs and challenges, and then leverage Agile (and hybrid) practices to deliver exceptional results.

What you’ll do: 

  • Project Delivery: Independently lead one large, complex project in a full-time capacity or multiple mid-size complex projects simultaneously comprised of cross-functional Horizontal team members.
  • Delivery Consulting: Consult on delivery strategies to ensure success, including frameworks, tools, processes, etc. Drive agile and product delivery methods wherever possible. Solve complex delivery issues and modify processes as needed for each engagement to ensure success.
  • Project Planning: Create and manage detailed project plans based on the delivery methodology/framework chosen, project scope, constraints, risks, and dependencies.
  • Budget Management: Proactively manage your project budgets to ensure the work we’re planning to deliver can be accomplished within the approved budget. Monitor weekly burn and velocity to develop burndown reports against remaining scope. Understand and report on project margin performance and revenue forecasting. Develop plans to course-correct if project begins to trend over budget.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify project risks and build mitigation plans in an ongoing RAID log. Triage projects in the red to identify a path to green. Escalate as needed to obtain support and solve risks before they become issues.
  • Client Partnership: Be the primary point of contact for clients in delivery to not only deliver consistent status, communicate risks, and manage deliverables – but also to build strong client relationships and be seen as a delivery leader and consultant.
  • Scope Management: Fully understand the scope of work being delivered and consult with the team and client to manage to it consistently. Proactively prioritize scope where needed. Estimate, create, and deliver change orders as needed when scope deviates.
  • Tools Knowledge: Hold expert-level knowledge of standard PM tools, including Smartsheet and Atlassian suite (Jira; Confluence).
  • Team Leadership: Lead a team of globally distributed cross-functional Horizontal designers, strategists, technologists, etc. to understand client objectives and successfully deliver solutions that achieve them. Manage resourcing process within assigned projects.
  • Practice Involvement: Actively participate in initiatives that uplevel and mature the Horizontal Delivery team. Proactively identify ways we can improve our processes/methods and work with practice leadership to fill gaps as appropriate.
  • Mentorship and Coaching: Mentor junior program managers and team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.

Who you are: 

Digital Consulting Experience

  • Proven track record of leading and executing large-scale digital transformation initiatives that deliver significant business value and competitive advantage.
  • Deep expertise in leveraging key technologies like CMS, CRM, CDP, Sitecore, and Salesforce products to drive transformational digital initiatives.
  • Experience in advising key client stakeholders on digital program best practices to optimize their program operations and enhance their digital presence.
  • Ability to identify and capitalize on new opportunities to drive growth and innovation.

Project Management Expertise

  • Proven ability to lead and manage multiple complex digital projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery of value with quality and speed to meet business objectives within budget and exceeding client expectations.
  • Proven ability to align digital initiatives with overall business goals and drive measurable outcomes.
  • Deep experience in managing large, geographically dispersed teams to foster collaboration and deliver results.
  • Proven ability to define contracts and manage programs and partnership to contract terms that will achieve and drive business value.
  • Proactive approach to risk management and issue resolution, ensuring project success.
  • Strong financial acumen to estimate and optimize project profitability.
  • Proficiency with advanced project management methodologies and tools, including Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid approaches.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to anticipate and address complex challenges proactively

Team Leadership and Development

  • Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams of digital experts, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.
  • Strong leadership skills to inspire and motivate teams to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Mentorship and coaching skills to develop and empower team members to reach their full potential.
  • Effective conflict resolution skills to maintain a positive and productive team environment.

Effective Communication and Presentation

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills to build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences clearly and concisely.
  • Influence and persuasion skills to drive consensus and gain buy-in from key stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills to present strategic recommendations and justify investment decisions.

What you bring:  

  • Minimum 7+ years of experience leading digital projects/programs.
  • A minimum of 2 years agency/consultancy experience. 5+ years preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Certifications in Agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP) preferred.
  • Experience with standard project management tools including Smartsheet and Jira/Confluence (or similar).

Travel

  • Some travel required based on client and business needs.

HZTL offers a wide range of competitive benefits to eligible employees including health, dental, vision, life, retirement plans, paid time off, paid holidays, paid time off to volunteer, paid parental leave, flexible work environment, and more.

Keywords: Agile, SAFe Agile, End-to-end delivery, Sitecore, Product mindset / Product operations, Consulting, Contentstack, Optimizely, CMS, Cross-functional team leadership, Project Plans, Atlassian, Jira, Confluence, Collaboration, Content Migration, DAM, Digital Assent Management, Content Hub

Job Title: Engineering Manager - Comms & Docs Team

Company: Snapsheet

Job Location: USA,Remote

About Snapsheet: Snapsheet is claims technology the way it should be: purposeful, precise, and designed to deliver outcomes. Where others bolt things on, we engineer them into our core systems and processes across cloud-based claims management, virtual vehicle appraisals, and elite loss and recovery services. Trusted by over 170+ P&C Carriers, MGAs, MGUs, TPAs, and logistics companies, our open architecture is built to fit how our companies work, not the other way around.

What you’ll get:

  • Remote working environment - your new commute is however long it takes to walk to your desk!
  • Flexibility - empathy is ingrained in who we are and we are happy to offer a flexible PTO policy, casual dress code, and more!
  • Development - 1-on-1 management, promote when ready culture, and quarterly goal setting sessions.
  • Fun - Celebrations just because, yearly in-person and remote events, Snapsheet Swag, Employee Resource Groups, and more!

About the Role:

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join Snapsheet's Communications & Documents team — a sub-team of Claims Management — who is passionate about technology, eager to learn, and ready to create impactful solutions. You'll drive major initiatives while fostering strong relationships and guiding the team's ongoing success.

At Snapsheet, Engineering Managers are not just people leaders — they're also builders and strategists who stay close to the code and the customer.

The Comms and Docs team is central to the insurance experience. At Snapsheet, we're building an industry-leading ecosystem that removes friction for users at every step. We lead with a collaborative, quality-driven culture and a commitment to innovation.

What you will do as an Engineering Manager:

  • Manage and contribute to upcoming projects
  • Coach and mentor a team of high powered engineers.
  • Write code in a fast-paced environment with a commitment to quality.
  • Collaborate with other development teams, product management and design to identify and solve challenging, cross-domain problems.
  • Contribute to architecture, strategy and decisions.
  • Coordinate, scope and execute on large initiatives.
  • Play an influential role in growing Snapsheet to be the industry leader in technology.
  • Partner with our internal recruitment team to screen, interview and hire top talent.

What we are looking for:

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related STEM field
  • 7+ years of full-stack web development experience
    • Designing and building APIs
    • Designing schemas and performant queries for relational databases
    • Understanding of scalability challenges and performance of server-side code
    • Prior experience using back end languages, Ruby on Rails a plus
    • Prior experience using front end web frameworks
  • 2+ years of experience in an engineering manager, team lead, or lead developer-like role.
  • Preference for candidates with experience using Rails, React, and Typescript

Technologies we use:

  • Infrastructure
    • MySQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, CloudFront
  • Languages
    • Javascript, Ruby, SQL
  • Programming Frameworks
    • Rails, React
  • Communication and task management
    • Slack, Jira, Atlassian, Confluence

We’re Built to Grow With You – And That Starts With How We Support You

At Snapsheet, we know that growth doesn’t happen in a vacuum—it’s fueled by the right support at the right time. That’s why we’ve built a benefits experience designed to grow with you, wherever life takes you.

  • Choose from 2 robust medical plans through Blue Cross Blue Shield—plus, we contribute to your HSA when you enroll in our high-deductible health plan.
  • Offer two dental plans and one vision plan to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Peace of mind with company-paid Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance.
  • Additional protection through voluntary benefits like Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Legal Assistance.
  • 401(k) with a 4% company match—because your future is worth investing in.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 6 sessions per life incident to support your mental well-being.

Perks That Make Growing Here Even Better:

  • Flexible PTO and 7.5 company-observed holidays to recharge on your terms.
  • In-person connection points throughout the year including our annual Summit and Roadshows.
  • Snapsheet SWAG and surprise mailers to keep the spirit alive.
  • Endless opportunity to shape your path—career growth, learning, and real impact are all within reach.
  • Health and wellness campaigns that evolve with you year over year.

Compensation that Grows with You

For this position, the base salary range is $180,000-200,000 + equity. While this range serves as a guideline, your actual compensation will reflect your experience and skillset.

At Snapsheet, we believe growth should be rewarded—our compensation and benefits are built to evolve with you as your career does.

We are currently unable to accept applications for candidates who reside in the following states: Alaska, California, Hawaii, Montana, New York, North Dakota, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Wyoming.

*Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position at this time.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Snapsheet, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

WRS Health is seeking a strategic and results-driven Sales Manager to drive growth by helping healthcare organizations transform their clinical, operational, and financial performance through innovative software and AI-powered solutions.

This is Sales Manager role is focused on complex consultative engagements with physician groups, specialty practices, practice management organizations, and healthcare executives. The ideal candidate is a trusted advisor who can uncover business challenges, navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes, and articulate the value of EHR, Practice Management, RCM, analytics, and AI technologies in a highly regulated healthcare environment.

Success in this role requires strong business acumen, enterprise SaaS sales expertise, and the ability to position WRS Health as a long-term strategic technology partner.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Consultative Selling

  • Build executive-level relationships with physicians, practice administrators, healthcare executives, and operational leaders.
  • Conduct in-depth discovery sessions to understand clinical, financial, operational, and technical challenges.
  • Develop tailored solution strategies that align WRS Health capabilities with customer objectives and measurable business outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and executive presentations focused on ROI, workflow transformation, revenue optimization, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead opportunities through the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting, and close.
  • Consistently achieve and exceed revenue, pipeline, and strategic growth targets.

Solution & Industry Expertise

  • Develop deep expertise in WRS Health’s EHR, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, Business Intelligence, interoperability, and AI-powered solutions.
  • Communicate the value of AI-enabled workflows, automation, predictive analytics, and healthcare interoperability to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partner with Sales Engineering, Product, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to address complex customer requirements and ensure solution alignment.
  • Support technical discussions involving APIs, FHIR integrations, cloud architecture, and third-party healthcare systems when appropriate.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of healthcare industry trends, regulatory requirements, reimbursement models, and emerging AI technologies.

Customer Partnership & Market Development

  • Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the evaluation, purchasing, and transition process.
  • Identify opportunities for long-term account expansion, cross-sell, and strategic partnerships.
  • Gather market intelligence and customer feedback to influence product strategy, messaging, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Represent WRS Health at industry conferences, webinars, executive briefings, and customer events.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Leadership teams to strengthen market positioning and accelerate growth initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of successful consultative B2B software sales experience, preferably in enterprise SaaS or healthcare technology.
  • Proven experience selling EHR/EMR, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, healthcare IT, AI, cloud software, or enterprise technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and consistently exceeding sales quotas.
  • Strong executive-level presentation, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare workflows, interoperability standards (FHIR, APIs), AI technologies, and cloud-based software solutions.
  • Highly self-motivated, organized, strategic, and committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Consistently exceed sales revenue and pipeline targets across enterprise healthcare accounts.
  • Build trusted executive relationships with physicians, practice administrators, and healthcare leadership teams.
  • Position WRS Health as a strategic technology and AI transformation partner within target healthcare organizations.
  • Increase adoption of AI-powered healthcare solutions, automation capabilities, and advanced platform functionality.
  • Improve sales cycle effectiveness through strong discovery, solution alignment, and executive engagement.
  • Generate long-term customer growth opportunities through account expansion and strategic partnerships.
  • Contribute market insights and customer intelligence that influence product innovation and go-to-market strategy.

At WRS Health, the Senior Consultative Sales Executive plays a critical role in helping healthcare organizations embrace AI-driven transformation while accelerating the company’s growth and leadership in specialty healthcare technology.

Additional Details

  • Job Type: Full-time - Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

This role serves as the operational hub for project execution, coordinating activities between clients, vCIOs, vITMs, engineering teams, service delivery, procurement, vendors, and leadership. The Senior Project Manager owns project visibility, drives accountability, removes roadblocks, manages risk, and ensures projects are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

Success in this position requires exceptional communication, strong organizational skills, the ability to manage competing priorities, and a relentless focus on execution and follow-through. The role supports all project types, including client onboarding, infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, cybersecurity initiatives, application deployments, process improvements, strategic business initiatives, and internal operational projects.

Primary Responsibilities

Project Planning & Execution

  • Manage projects through all phases of the project lifecycle from initiation through closure.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource assignments.
  • Coordinate project execution across multiple departments and stakeholders.
  • Facilitate project kickoff meetings, status meetings, review sessions, and project closeout activities.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet scope, quality, schedule, and budget expectations.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively address delays, risks, and dependencies.

  • Escalate delays, blockers, and risks before they impact project outcomes.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and execution.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination for assigned projects.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Communicate project status, risks, decisions, and upcoming milestones clearly and consistently.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Facilitate discussions between business and technical teams.
  • Coordinate executive-level communications and project reporting.
  • Ensure a positive customer experience throughout project delivery.
  • Conduct project reviews and stakeholder meetings as needed.

Risk, Issue & Escalation Management

  • Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Maintain project risk, issue, and decision logs.
  • Lead resolution efforts for project-related issues.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for client blockers, vendor delays, approval dependencies, communication breakdowns, resource conflicts, and scope concerns.
  • Coordinate cross-functional problem resolution activities.
  • Escalate issues to leadership when appropriate.
  • Monitor project health and implement corrective actions when necessary.

Resource & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate activities between vCIOs, vITMs, Project Engineers, Service Delivery Managers, Service Desk personnel, Centralized Services, Procurement, Security Teams, vendors, and third-party providers.
  • Balance competing priorities across multiple projects and resources.
  • Ensure resources are appropriately scheduled and utilized.
  • Coordinate project dependencies across departments.
  • Facilitate collaboration between technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ensure all required materials, information, approvals, and resources are available to support project success.

Financial & Scope Management

  • Maintain accurate project forecasts and status reporting.
  • Assist leadership with portfolio visibility and reporting.
  • Ensure project financial data is accurate and current.
  • Support project billing readiness and financial review processes.

Onboarding, Handoff & Project Closure

  • Ensure onboarding and implementation projects are successfully transitioned into operational support.
  • Verify project documentation is complete prior to handoff.
  • Coordinate client acceptance and project signoff activities.

  • Conduct customer satisfaction reviews following project completion.
  • Ensure all project closure requirements have been completed.

Vendor & Procurement Coordination

  • Schedule and coordinate activities with third-party vendors.
  • Manage vendor-related project risks and delays.

Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain project plans, meeting notes, action registers, decision logs, risk registers, status reports, and closure documentation.
  • Ensure project records remain accurate and auditable.
  • Adhere to GXA project governance standards and methodologies.

  • Ensure project artifacts are properly stored and maintained.

Continuous Improvement

  • Recommend improvements to project workflows, standards, templates, and procedures.

  • Contribute to operational maturity and service delivery excellence.

  • Share lessons learned and best practices across teams.
