jobs.excerpt: THE ROLE Gorilla Commerce is seeking a Manager, PLM & Product Data to serve as the business owner and super-user of the company's PLM platform.
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Gorilla Commerce is seeking a Manager, PLM & Product Data to serve as the business owner and super-user of the company's PLM platform.

Gorilla Commerce has successfully implemented PLM as the system of record for product specifications, BOMs, materials, suppliers and costing, and the platform is live across the sourcing organization. This role owns it from here — closing the residual data gaps that follow any implementation, raising the standard of governance, and maturing the platform through its next phases of capability.

The scope is broad but well supported. Sourcing teams own day-to-day data entry and maintenance following go-live. A dedicated analyst supports bulk uploads, reconciliation and heavy data work. IT leads the technical build of the PLM–ERP integration. This role sets the standards, makes the system decisions, and directs the work.

There is genuine white space here. An 18-month roadmap is defined — stronger specification and BOM structure, packaging and artwork governance, warning-label and claims data — and the person in this role will shape how it is prioritized, sequenced and delivered.

The role can be based globally and works core US Eastern hours to stay aligned with the VP and the wider team, with some flexibility for Asia-based sourcing partners.

This is not a data-entry or system-administration role. It is a product-data ownership role focused on structure, governance, adoption and system maturity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

System Ownership & Configuration

  • Own the day-to-day health, configuration and evolution of the PLM platform.

  • Act as the internal authority on how PLM should be structured and used across parent and SKU hierarchy, specifications, BOMs, materials, supplier and factory records, quotes and costing.

  • Determine whether an issue is best solved through configuration, data architecture, process design or vendor development.

  • Own integration keys and mappings between PLM and the ERP.

Product Data Governance & Integrity

  • Own product data quality as an ongoing discipline rather than a periodic cleanup.

  • Establish validation standards, naming conventions and audit routines that prevent errors upstream.

  • Reconcile PLM against ERP master data and resolve discrepancies at root cause.

  • Close residual implementation gaps across product hierarchy, suppliers and factories, BOMs, color/size and supplier quote data.

Workflow, Change & Version Control

  • Design and govern state models, approval workflows and revision control.

  • Define how specification and BOM changes are requested, approved, tested and released.

  • Assess downstream impact of data and configuration changes before release.

  • Establish clear decision rights across this role, functional owners, IT and leadership.

Adoption, Training & Process Discipline

  • Drive adoption across a distributed sourcing organization as a core deliverable of the role.

  • Build and maintain SOPs, training materials and onboarding for new users.

  • Move remaining product workflows off spreadsheets and email and into PLM.

  • Identify recurring process failures and resolve the root cause rather than the symptom.

Vendor Partnership & Roadmap

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with the PLM software vendor.

  • Manage tickets, requirements, testing and feature scoping independently, escalating commercial matters to the VP.

  • Own the business-side PLM roadmap and translate business needs into practical system and process solutions.

  • Sequence future capability including deeper Level 2 and 3 BOM structure, packaging governance and claims data.

Integration Support

  • Support the IT-led PLM–ERP integration through requirements definition, mapping validation and UAT.

  • Diagnose whether issues originate in source data, PLM configuration, integration logic or the ERP.

  • Keep integration keys complete and accurate across all active SKUs.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 5+ years in PLM, product data management or product operations, including direct ownership of a PLM or comparable product-data platform.

  • Strong grasp of product hierarchy, multi-level BOMs, specifications and revision management.

  • Experience maintaining product data integrity against an ERP, including reconciliation and integration keys.

  • Experience designing or governing approval workflows and version control.

  • Advanced Excel and confident handling of large product datasets.

  • Excellent written and verbal English.

Preferred

  • Experience through a PLM implementation or major system rollout.

  • Vendor management experience with software providers.

  • Experience in Centric PLM would be a plus.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, integration mapping and UAT.

  • Python, SQL or Power Query for data reconciliation and automation.

  • Exposure to packaging, artwork or compliance documentation data.

  • Background in consumer products, retail, sourcing, manufacturing, apparel, footwear or hardlines.

Competencies

  • High ownership and accountability

  • Strong systems and structured-data thinking

  • Comfortable acting as a data gatekeeper

  • Independent problem solver — brings recommendations, not questions

  • Clear communicator across time zones and functions

  • Builds processes and standards that scale

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

  • PLM is live, but no single person owns its structure, standards and evolution.

  • Product data underpins sourcing, costing, compliance, quality and planning.

  • Residual implementation gaps need closing — and preventing.

  • Adoption determines whether the platform delivers its value.

  • This role exists to own PLM end to end, raise data standards, drive adoption and deliver the roadmap.

    This is a fully remote position, international contractor position.

Job Description — Liquidation Specialist

Job Title:Liquidation Specialist

Department:Sales

Reports To:Director of Ecommerce & Sales

About Chai Vision

Chai Vision is a fast-growing eCommerce company managing a portfolio of direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands across high-impact categories—from fitness and wellness to home goods, pet care, children's products, outdoor products, kitchen essentials, and supplements. We scale rapidly on platforms like Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop through a data-driven, community-first approach and a relentless focus on product-market fit.

The organization is driven by a data-informed approach to growth, disciplined operational execution, and a commitment to delivering high-quality products and customer experiences at scale. Chai Vision continues to invest in expanding its omnichannel sales strategy and retail presence worldwide, offering team members the opportunity to contribute within a fast-paced, performance-oriented organization focused on sustainable growth and long-term value creation.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Liquidation Specialistto own our excess, aged, and slow-moving inventory strategy across multiple brands.

This role is ideal for someone who has successfully worked with off-price retailers and liquidation channels and knows how to move inventory while maximizing recovery value. You'll partner closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Finance, and Operations to proactively identify inventory risks, execute liquidation programs, and improve overall inventory health.

We’re looking for an experienced off-price and liquidation sales professional to own the disposition of excess, aged, and slow-moving inventory across our portfolio of consumer brands.

A key requirement for this role is an established network of direct buyer relationships with national off-price retailers such as TJX, Burlington, Ross, Ollie’s, Big Lots, or comparable retailers.

What You'll Do

Inventory Management

    • Monitor aged, excess, and slow-moving inventory across multiple brands and sales channels.
    • Analyze inventory trends and identify products at risk before they become obsolete.
    • Develop strategies to minimize inventory exposure while maximizing recovery.

Liquidation Strategy & Execution

    • Build and execute liquidation plans across multiple channels.
    • Manage relationships with off-price retailers, liquidation partners, jobbers, and bulk buyers.
    • Pitch available inventory and negotiate opportunities that maximize recovery value.
    • Coordinate inventory movement and ensure timely execution of liquidation programs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Ecommerce, and Finance to improve inventory planning.
    • Provide recommendations that reduce future overstock and aged inventory.
    • Support forecasting efforts through inventory analysis and reporting.

Reporting & Analysis

    • Maintain accurate reporting of inventory disposition activities.
    • Track liquidation performance and recovery rates.
    • Provide regular updates to leadership on inventory health and liquidation progress.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in inventory liquidation, inventory management, or off-price retail sales.
  • Proven experience liquidating excess inventory for consumer products.
  • Existing relationships with off-price retailers such as:
    • TJX Companies
    • Burlington
    • Ross Stores
    • Ollie's Bargain Outlet
    • Big Lots
    • Other discount or liquidation buyers
  • Strong understanding of inventory planning and inventory lifecycle management.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in ecommerce, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or omnichannel retail.
  • Experience working with Shopify, SellerCloud, Power BI, Monday.com, or similar systems.
  • Experience managing inventory across multiple brands.
  • Knowledge of wholesale, closeout, and liquidation marketplaces.

What Makes You Successful

You are someone who:

  • Thinks strategically while executing quickly.
  • Enjoys solving inventory challenges using data.
  • Builds strong business relationships and negotiates effectively.
  • Takes ownership and works independently.
  • Thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment.
  • Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

Success in This Role

Within this role, you'll help us:

  • Reduce aged inventory (180+ days) across our product portfolio.
  • Maximize recovery value on liquidated inventory.
  • Improve inventory forecasting and planning.
  • Maintain highly accurate inventory disposition reporting.
  • Reduce overall inventory liability quarter over quarter.

Tools You'll Use

  • Shopify
  • SellerCloud
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • Power BI

Job Summary:

As a Customer Onboarding Specialist at Sierra Interactive, you are the owner of the client onboarding journey and the primary point of accountability for ensuring new customers experience a smooth, successful transition from sale to site launch, and for supporting existing clients through account changes and platform adoption.

You’ll lead each client from contract to go-live, maintaining momentum, setting clear expectations, and building trust through proactive, high-touch communication. You’ll remove blockers, provide solutions, and ensure every client feels guided, informed, and supported.

This is not a behind-the-scenes role. You are expected to own outcomes, demonstrate strong client management skills, and drive measurable results for every project.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Client Setup Ownership
    • Own the onboarding experience for a portfolio of new clients, serving as the single point of accountability from signed agreement through CRM and website launch.
    • Drive client progress by sending proactive nudges and following up via email, phone, and Zoom to ensure clients stay on track.
    • Guide clients through key deliverables like Customer Intake, IDX approvals, EIN submission, and billing setup.
    • Monitor and manage onboarding tasks using internal project management tools. Identify risks early, communicate clearly, and escalate delays or blockers when needed.
    • Reignite stalled clients through persistence, solution-oriented communication, and ownership of the path forward.
    • Facilitate a smooth website go-live experience.
  • Existing Client & Account Support
    • Own account reactivations, package changes, and website template conversions for existing clients, guiding each through to completion with the same accountability and communication standard as new client onboarding.
    • Manage go-live requests for sites completed through a new build, template conversion, or reactivation.
    • Client Management and Relationship Building
    • Act as the trusted advisor and central point of contact throughout the onboarding journey, setting expectations and maintaining transparency.
    • Anticipate client needs before they arise and communicate proactively to prevent confusion or frustration.
    • Build confidence and trust with clients through empathy, professionalism, and accountability in every interaction.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Education, Support, Operations, etc.) to ensure a unified, frictionless client experience, including clean, well-documented handoffs at each phase transition.
  • Customer Activation and Adoption
    • Serve as the primary point of contact post-sale through the completion of onboarding and training.
    • Facilitate adoption by connecting clients with the Customer Education Team, providing self-service training resources, or answering basic platform questions.
    • Identify at-risk clients early, including signs of hesitation or resistance to adopting the platform, and coordinate turnaround strategies with internal teams.
    • Promote Sierra’s platform features that help clients achieve measurable success.
    • Process Feedback and Refinement
    • Own your feedback loop by collecting and sharing client insights to improve onboarding processes and materials.
    • Collaborate with internal teams to propose and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency and client satisfaction.
  • Educational and Product Guidance
    • Provide first-line phone support for basic customer education questions during onboarding, including setup and “how-to” guidance on CRM features, IDX, and lead management.
    • Escalate advanced training needs to the Customer Education Team and technical issues to Support.

Requirements

  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Experience: 1–3+ years working in customer support, project or account coordination, or customer success in a SaaS environment

Skills

  • You take ownership of outcomes end-to-end without needing to be managed, and you follow through until the job is actually done.
  • You communicate proactively, reaching out with updates and next steps before a client has to ask.
  • You build trust and confidence quickly, with empathy and professionalism, even when a client is frustrated or a project is off track.
  • Your writing skills are top-notch. You have an engaging, conversational style and a solid grasp of grammar.
  • You’re highly organized and able to juggle a full portfolio of concurrent projects, re-prioritizing quickly as risks and deadlines shift.
  • You coordinate smoothly across teams, keeping handoffs clean and other teams informed rather than working in isolation.

Subject Matter Knowledge

  • Prior experience with customer onboarding is a plus.
  • Experience with best practices for lead generation, digital marketing, or contact database management.
  • Familiarity with content management systems and CRMs is a plus.
  • Interpersonal Abilities
  • You're a hard worker — both independently and in group settings — with a proven track record of getting things done carefully and efficiently. You're patient and pay attention to the details.
  • Working with people makes you happy. You're a talented communicator and can artfully break down something complex into smaller, consumable concepts.

Additional Requirements

  • A team player who can collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across the organization.
  • A commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Prior experience working remotely or with distributed teams is preferred.
  • Real estate experience is a plus.

Benefits

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage. Full cost covered for employee, and option to add spouse/partner and dependents.
  • 401k retirement plan (up to 4% matching).
  • 15 days PTO, 10 paid holidays.
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave.

  • Optimize slow queries and resolve systemic performance bottlenecks in high-throughput integration pipelines.
  • Deploy, monitor, and debug containerized integration services in Kubernetes, including the alerting and runbooks that catch vendor degradations before customers do.
  • Lead pragmatic refactors of legacy or accreted integration code into modular, testable, swappable adapters.
  • Handle production incidents methodically (vendor outages, schema changes, auth rotations, quota exhaustion) and harden the system to reduce recurrence.

  • Communicate complex tradeoffs across engineering, product, partnerships, and customer-facing teams.

  • Experience building or maintaining event-driven systems using Kafka.

  • Proven ability to refactor complex or legacy integration code into modular, swappable, well-tested adapters.

jobs.description:
About The Lisinski Law Firm

Since 2020, Lisinski Law Firm has served as a dedicated humanitarian immigration practice committed to providing meaningful support to individuals and families seeking safety, stability, and a path forward. We frequently stand with clients who have been turned away elsewhere, offering both advocacy and care. Joining our Firm means becoming part of a team devoted to keeping families together and “Changing as Many Lives as Possible.”

About the Role

The Product Owner is the day-to-day owner of a defined product or feature set within a broader product area at LLF. They are responsible for the health of their product’s backlog; refining work, authoring clear user stories with acceptance criteria, prioritizing tactically within the sprint cadence, and serving as the primary product voice to IT during execution.

This role focuses on execution, ownership, and operational consistency in a regulated, high-stakes legal services environment. Working in close partnership with Product Managers, IT, the Project Management Office (PMO), and operational stakeholders, the Product Owner ensures that strategic product intent translates into well-formed, well-prioritized work that engineering can deliver predictably. The Product Owner also organizes and drives the "Quick Wins" pipeline for their product area; surfacing, scoping, and shepherding smaller improvements that deliver tangible value alongside larger initiatives.

This role operates as an individual contributor, partnering closely with Product Managers and reporting to a Product Team Lead.

Your Key Contributions

  • Own the day-to-day health of the product backlog for an assigned product or feature set — including authoring and refining user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
  • Partner with Product Managers to take ownership of epics and break them down into well-formed user stories that can be slotted into the team’s sprint cadence.
  • Organize and drive the Quick Wins pipeline for the assigned product area — surfacing smaller improvements, scoping them appropriately, and shepherding them through delivery.
  • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies (planning, refinement, review, retrospective) as the primary product voice to IT.
  • Tactically prioritize work within the sprint and near-term backlog, making routine trade-off decisions and escalating non-routine ones to the Product Manager or Product Team Lead.
  • Resolve routine execution exceptions — answering engineering questions, refining acceptance criteria, and unblocking story-level ambiguity during the sprint.
  • Validate that delivered work meets acceptance criteria and product intent before sign-off.
  • Maintain operational consistency in how product work is captured, refined, prioritized, and tracked, contributing to team standards and reducing rework.
  • Partner with PMO on sprint-level reporting, dependency tracking, and risk surfacing.
  • Engage with operational and end-user stakeholders to gather feedback, clarify needs, and validate that delivered work solves the intended problem.
  • Ensure work is delivered in a manner consistent with the firm’s regulatory, ethical, and data-handling obligations, escalating to the Product Manager or Legal/Compliance when in doubt.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 1–3 years of experience as a Product Owner, Project Manager, Business Analyst, or in a closely related role contributing to software delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring user stories and acceptance criteria for software products.
  • Demonstrated experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment, including active participation in sprint ceremonies.
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum frameworks and sprint-based software delivery.
  • Proficiency with product/backlog management tooling (e.g., Craft.io, Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent).
  • Strong written documentation skills, particularly user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Comfort working in close partnership with engineering teams on day-to-day execution.
  • Basic understanding of modern software delivery practices and the ability to engage substantively with engineering on story-level scope and trade-offs.

Work Schedule

  • Monday to Friday 9:00 am to 5:00 pm EST.

Equipment Requirements

For PC Users:

  • A modern processor (Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from the last few years)
  • Windows 11 (kept up to date)

For Mac Users:

  • A modern processor (Apple M1 chip or a recent Intel Core i5)
  • A recent macOS (Ventura or newer)

For Everyone:

  • At least 8 GB of memory (RAM) to run applications smoothly
  • A fast hard drive with sufficient available storage

Our Firm

At Lisinski Law Firm, the commitment we show to our clients is matched by how we support and invest in our people. LLF is a place where employees are encouraged by peers, heard by leadership, and strengthened by a genuinely collaborative team culture. Whether you join Marketing, IT, Accounting, Legal, or any other function, your work matters. Every role contributes to meaningful, lasting impact in the lives of those we serve.

Our Values

At Lisinski Law Firm, we are driven by a client obsessed mindset and a commitment to learning, advocacy, efficiency, and nimbleness in everything we do. We work as true team players, delivering creative problem-solving and high-quality service to support families with excellence and care.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Project Coordinator to bring structure, accountability, and visibility across multiple projects and operational workflows.

This is not a passive administrative role. You’ll help keep projects on track by managing timelines, coordinating stakeholders, tracking deliverables, identifying risks, and maintaining organized documentation.

If you’re highly organized, proactive, and enjoy keeping teams aligned and projects moving forward, this role is a great fit.

What You’ll Do

Project Planning & Timeline Management

  • Maintain project plans using Asana, Trello, Monday.com, MS Project, or Smartsheet.
  • Track timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Keep project schedules and trackers accurate and up to date.
  • Help teams stay aligned on priorities and deadlines.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Prepare meeting agendas, notes, action items, and weekly project reports.
  • Maintain organized documentation in SharePoint, Google Drive, or Confluence.
  • Track project progress, risks, blockers, and key metrics.
  • Ensure documentation remains accurate and accessible.

Communication & Coordination

  • Act as the central point of coordination between project managers, team members, leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Follow up on tasks and deliverables proactively.
  • Escalate delays, blockers, or risks before they impact project timelines.
  • Ensure decisions and updates are clearly documented.

Task & Resource Tracking

  • Monitor task completion, resource availability, and project dependencies.
  • Help maintain accountability across active projects.
  • Ensure deliverables stay on schedule.

Risk & Vendor Management

  • Identify delays, bottlenecks, and operational risks.
  • Maintain project risk logs and escalation tracking.
  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and external stakeholders.
  • Track vendor deliverables and escalate issues when needed.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Project Coordination
    • Operations Support
    • Administrative or Project Support roles
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Asana
    • Trello
    • Monday.com
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Project trackers
    • Pivot tables
    • Conditional formatting
  • Excellent organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working remotely across multiple stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • PMP, CAPM, or Agile certifications (or currently pursuing them).
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or sprint planning.
  • Experience in SaaS, marketing, professional services, construction, or operations-focused environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Update project plans and task trackers.
  • Follow up with teams on deadlines and deliverables.
  • Support meetings with notes and action items.
  • Prepare weekly project status reports.
  • Coordinate communication across stakeholders.
  • Identify and escalate project risks.
  • Maintain organized project documentation.

In short: You’ll ensure projects stay organized, on schedule, and visible while helping teams execute efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success

  • On-time completion of tasks and milestones.
  • Accurate and consistent project reporting.
  • Fewer missed deadlines due to coordination gaps.
  • Organized and up-to-date project documentation.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on communication and execution.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Project Tracker & Status Report)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your project coordination experience, and share how you’ve managed timelines, stakeholders, documentation, and project tracking tools like Asana or Trello. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you enjoy keeping projects organized, coordinating teams, and ensuring work gets delivered on time, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive successful project execution in a fast-paced remote environment.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

Company Overview

Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.

With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.

Job Description

The Professional Billing Specialist (Anesthesia) is responsible for managing all professional billing requirements and managing accounts receivable tasks according to standard and productivity measurements. Responsible to ensure all regulatory and payor guidelines are followed. ​

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinating payor denial and appeal follow up activities to ensure timely response from third party payors and the processing of all payor denials, documentation requests and appeals

  • Review all denial accounts for categorization, level of appeal, special requirements for initiating appeals

  • Communicate global payer issues with the payer relations team.

  • Communicating and coordinating with various individuals/distributions and assisting with monitoring of the day-to-day activities related to appeal follow up and denials.

  • Maintaining the healthcare tracking tool/application that stores/communicates all claim edits, review and denial activity. This will include user access management, updates to software, and end-user training to support all follow up activities.

  • Monitor all Claim Edit and Denial Management work queues and lists to ensure they are fully resolved.

  • Ensure medical records requests are completed and submitted within 48 hours.

  • Track all denials on a database to determine outcome. Collecting/analyzing, report status, metrics and trends of activity by different reviews from the tool. Distributing reports on a routine basis to specific distribution group.

  • Organizing all data and activity in a retrievable way to ensure timely follow up on appeals to third party payors. Assisting with the coordination of denial and review activities and materials for committee meetings, including analyses, reports, etc.

  • Knowledgeable about federal, state and third-party claims processing. Supporting projects and initiatives of the Billing and Denials Management teams. This may include coordinating meetings, conducting research for payor criteria, and preparing documents

  • Able to build and maintain relationships with payer representatives

Required Qualifications:

  • Epic PB Resolute experience

  • 3 years of related Anesthesia experience

  • 5 years' experience in a Healthcare/Hospital Revenue Cycle Environment including Third Party Collection/AR Receivables

  • Healthcare Revenue Cycle revenue management EDI Transaction sets including 837P

  • Knowledge of insurance contract rates and terms

  • Understanding of Registration and Collections

  • Understanding of Government and Managed Care billing, coverage and payment rules Ability to comprehend payor 835 and paper EOB responses

  • Understanding of CCI edits, CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10 and Revenue Codes

  • Intermediate Excel skills

  • Excellent computer skills, especially spreadsheet and database applications.

  • Knowledge of managed care patient financial systems and of the specific billing and payment standards utilized for services provided within a hospital setting.

  • Thorough understanding of managed care payment methodologies and the principles of managed care.

  • Certification in Epic PB Resolute - or agree to obtain certification within 12 months after hire

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of SQL or Crystal Reports.

  • HFMA’s CRCR credential

The pay range for this position is $24.16 - $36.24. Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

Customer Support | Phone | Email | Live Chat | Ticketing Systems

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Customer Service Representative (CSR) to deliver exceptional customer support across phone, email, live chat, and ticketing platforms.

This is a customer-first role where you’ll be responsible for:

  • Resolving customer inquiries
  • Managing support tickets
  • Troubleshooting issues
  • Maintaining customer satisfaction
  • Delivering timely, professional communication

You’ll serve as the frontline voice of the company, ensuring every customer receives a positive, solutions-focused experience while helping strengthen customer loyalty and retention.

If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and working in a fast-paced support environment, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

  • Handle inbound customer inquiries through:
    • Phone
    • Email
    • Live chat
    • Support tickets
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally and efficiently.
  • Troubleshoot common issues and escalate complex cases when necessary.
  • Deliver timely, high-quality customer support.
  • Manage multiple customer conversations while maintaining service quality.

Ticket & Case Management

  • Manage customer support tickets using platforms such as:
    • Zendesk
    • Freshdesk
    • Help Scout
    • Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Prioritize cases based on:
    • Urgency

    • Business impact
  • Maintain accurate documentation of:

    • Troubleshooting steps
    • Case resolutions
  • Monitor open cases through completion.

Customer Experience & Communication

  • Communicate clearly and professionally across all support channels.
  • De-escalate challenging customer situations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Build trust through proactive communication and consistent follow-up.
  • Capture customer feedback and identify recurring support trends.
  • Maintain a customer-first approach in every interaction.

Knowledge Base & Process Improvement

  • Maintain and update:
    • FAQs
    • Internal knowledge base articles
    • Support documentation
  • Improve:
    • Response templates
    • Support macros
    • Workflow documentation
  • Share recurring customer issues and improvement recommendations with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Operations
    • Billing
    • Technical Support
    • Product teams
  • Coordinate escalations and ensure smooth issue resolution.
  • Follow company policies, documentation standards, and privacy requirements.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in:
    • Customer Service
    • Customer Support
    • Call Center
    • Client-facing roles
  • Experience using customer support platforms such as:
    • Zendesk
    • Freshdesk
    • Salesforce Service Cloud
    • Help Scout
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent multitasking and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage high ticket volumes while maintaining quality.
  • Proficiency with:
    • Google Workspace
    • Microsoft Office
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers.
  • Background in:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Healthcare
    • Finance
    • Service-based businesses
  • Familiarity with:
    • Live chat platforms
    • Customer support automation tools
    • KPI-driven support environments
  • Multilingual communication skills.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy helping customers and solving problems.
  • You remain calm under pressure.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally.
  • You manage multiple priorities efficiently.
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized.
  • You take ownership of customer issues until they are fully resolved.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review and prioritize incoming support tickets.
  • Respond to customers via phone, email, and live chat.
  • Troubleshoot customer issues and coordinate escalations.
  • Document customer interactions and update support records.
  • Follow up on unresolved cases.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend service improvements.

In short: You deliver fast, professional, and solution-oriented customer support that strengthens customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • First Contact Resolution (FCR)
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Average response time
  • Average resolution time
  • SLA compliance
  • Ticket quality and documentation accuracy
  • Quality assurance (QA) performance

Why Join Us?

  • High-impact customer-facing role.
  • Opportunity to strengthen customer experience operations.
  • Exposure to modern customer support platforms and workflows.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Customer Support Representative
    • Customer Success Specialist
    • Team Lead
    • Operations Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Assessment (Customer Support Scenarios or Simulated Tickets)
  4. Client Interview with Support Leadership
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about helping customers, thrive in fast-paced support environments, and take pride in delivering outstanding service, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help create exceptional customer experiences every day.

jobs.excerpt: AI2IO helps organizations navigate the complex landscape of technology solutions, from foundational IT services and system support to advanced software integration, automation, and cutting-edge AI implementations.
jobs.description:
AI2IO helps organizations navigate the complex landscape of technology solutions, from foundational IT services and system support to advanced software integration, automation, and cutting-edge AI implementations. Our expertise spans IT infrastructure management, custom software development, seamless system integrations, and optimization of low-code business automation, empowering clients to maximize their existing technology investments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title

Software Engineer Technical Lead

Position Location

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

ai2io is seeking a Software Engineer Technical Lead with deep C#/.NET, Microsoft Azure, and ASP.NET Blazor experience to own the technical direction and engineering outcomes of a software team. Blazor is our strategic web-application platform. You will remain a hands-on contributor while guiding architecture, delivery, production readiness, secure engineering, and team capability across our Microsoft-centric stack.

The current application portfolio also includes React applications that ai2io must responsibly maintain while planning and executing their transition to C#/.NET and Blazor. Strong React and TypeScript experience is therefore important for sustaining business continuity, stabilizing inherited applications, understanding their behavior and dependencies, and leading deliberate migrations without disrupting users or critical workflows. This role is not intended to establish React as a long-term parallel platform.

Experience with Revit, electrical or mechanical engineering, BIM, MEP workflows, or the broader architecture, engineering, and construction industry is valuable because many ai2io products support specialized engineering work, but that domain experience is not required.

Essential Functions

This role combines hands-on leadership of the strategic .NET and Blazor platform with accountable stewardship of transitional React applications, including their reliable operation and planned conversion.

Own Technical Direction for the Strategic Platform

  • Serve as the team's primary technical decision-maker for solutions built with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Blazor, Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, Microsoft Graph API, Entra ID, and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Lead design for new features and systems and guide teams toward C#/.NET and Blazor for ongoing development unless an approved exception is warranted.
  • Produce durable architecture decision records, system diagrams, API contracts, migration guidance, and implementation plans that engineers can execute against.
  • Define and enforce coding standards, pull-request practices, definition of done, automated testing expectations, accessibility, documentation, and the engineering quality bar.
  • Remain hands-on in production C#, Blazor, Azure, and targeted React/TypeScript work where continuity, diagnosis, or migration risk requires direct contribution.

Maintain Transitional React Applications

  • Own the technical health of React applications while ai2io is responsible for their continued operation, including defect resolution, dependency updates, security findings, diagnostics, testing, and production support.
  • Quickly assess inherited React applications, documenting architecture, build and deployment processes, dependencies, data flows, integrations, ownership gaps, operational risks, and critical business workflows.
  • Prioritize stabilization work that protects users and business continuity without expanding avoidable long-term investment in the transitional React platform.
  • Establish sufficient React and TypeScript coding, testing, review, and release practices to maintain inherited applications safely through their remaining lifecycle.
  • Identify unsupported, fragile, or high-risk components early and present clear mitigation and migration options.

Lead React-to-Blazor Conversion

  • Create phased migration strategies that move React applications and workflows to C#/.NET and Blazor while preserving user outcomes, data integrity, integrations, and operational continuity.
  • Decide what should be migrated, redesigned, consolidated, retired, or temporarily retained based on business value, technical risk, maintainability, usage, and migration cost.
  • Decompose migrations into controlled increments with coexistence boundaries, interface contracts, acceptance criteria, rollback plans, and explicit cutover checkpoints.
  • Partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and users to validate functional parity and identify where migration is an opportunity to simplify or improve the experience rather than reproduce unnecessary complexity.
  • Retire superseded React components and dependencies after verified cutover, ensuring documentation, monitoring, support ownership, and source repositories reflect the final state.

Plan and Coordinate Technical Delivery

  • Break complex features and migrations into coherent increments, identifying technical discovery, dependencies, sequencing constraints, integration risks, and milestones before commitments are finalized.
  • Own technical feasibility, decomposition, estimates, dependencies, execution health, and technical risk behind team commitments; partner with the Project Manager on the integrated schedule, stakeholder communication, scope coordination, and overall delivery process.
  • Coordinate engineers through purposeful delegation, design checkpoints, code review, blocker removal, and clear implementation direction.
  • Communicate business-continuity and migration tradeoffs clearly, bringing evidence and recommended options rather than status alone.

Own Azure Production Readiness

  • Own team-level readiness for Azure-hosted releases, including deployment planning, observability, diagnostics, rollback considerations, support documentation, and resolution of material technical risks.
  • Guide appropriate use of Azure application, data, identity, integration, storage, secrets, and monitoring services in alignment with organizational standards.
  • Lead investigation of significant production issues across Blazor and transitional React applications, coordinating mitigation, root-cause analysis, and follow-up improvements.
  • Convert incidents, support trends, recurring defects, and performance evidence into prioritized reliability, testability, migration, and maintainability work.

Set the Secure Engineering and Quality Bar

  • Ensure implementations follow approved practices for authentication, authorization, secrets, data access, dependency management, input validation, privacy, and secure coding.
  • Own testing strategy across .NET unit and integration tests, Blazor component and end-to-end tests, and sufficient React test coverage to support maintenance and migration confidence.
  • Ensure CI/CD pipelines apply reliable automated quality gates and provide actionable feedback for both strategic and transitional applications.
  • Balance feature delivery and business continuity with deliberate management of technical debt, security findings, migration risk, and long-term platform simplification.

Coach Engineers and Multiply Capability

  • Coach engineers through design reviews, pairing, pull-request feedback, debugging, migration planning, and targeted delegation.
  • Build shared capability in C#/.NET, Blazor, Azure, React application diagnosis, and controlled migrations so critical knowledge does not remain concentrated in one person.
  • Create opportunities for senior engineers to own increasingly complex designs, application transitions, and technical initiatives.
  • Ensure the team can make routine decisions within clear platform and migration principles without routing every question through the Technical Lead.

Contribute Beyond the Immediate Team

  • Partner with Architects and other Technical Leads to establish reusable Blazor patterns and avoid recreating transitional React architectures in new products.
  • Contribute migration lessons, assessment checklists, shared components, standards, and reference implementations that benefit future application transitions.
  • Identify when application capabilities should be consolidated into shared platform services rather than copied during conversion.
  • Represent the team's application-continuity and migration context in cross-team planning and architecture discussions.

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

What Success Looks Like

  • New web development follows coherent C#/.NET, Azure, and Blazor patterns aligned with ai2io standards.
  • Transitional React applications remain stable, supported, secure, observable, and understood while they remain in service.
  • React-to-Blazor migrations use documented priorities, phased plans, clear acceptance criteria, and business-continuity safeguards.
  • Users retain critical capabilities through migration, and retired React components do not leave hidden operational or ownership gaps.
  • Delivery commitments are based on credible decomposition, discovery, dependencies, estimates, and migration risk.
  • Engineers gain broader ownership because the Technical Lead delegates, coaches, and documents durable platform and migration practices.

Position Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software-development experience, including team technical direction, production ownership, delivery coordination, and engineering mentorship.
  • Deep professional proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET Blazor, and Microsoft Azure, with experience designing, delivering, and operating enterprise web applications.
  • Strong production experience maintaining React and TypeScript applications, including component architecture, state management, routing, API integration, testing, build tooling, dependency management, and production troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience modernizing, migrating, consolidating, or retiring applications while preserving business continuity and user outcomes.
  • Ability to evaluate React applications, document unknown systems, stabilize inherited code, and design a phased transition to C#/.NET and Blazor.
  • Experience designing ASP.NET Core APIs and integration patterns using SQL Server, identity, Microsoft Graph API, or comparable enterprise technologies.
  • Experience decomposing complex technical initiatives, validating estimates, managing dependencies, and communicating migration and continuity risks.
  • Experience with Azure observability, incident response, release engineering, secure development, automated testing, CI/CD, and operational support.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and demonstrated success coaching engineers through accountable technical leadership.
  • Hands-on Autodesk Revit experience, including Revit add-ins, model workflows, families, parameters, worksharing, or Revit API familiarity.
  • Experience in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, MEP design, BIM, architecture, construction, data-center engineering, or another AEC discipline.
  • Experience building software used by engineers, designers, BIM teams, or other specialized technical professionals.
  • Experience converting React interfaces to Blazor or leading migrations between front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with Entra ID, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365 services, Power Platform, infrastructure as code, or cloud-native operational tooling.

jobs.description:
Tagetik is seeking a highly commercial and growth-oriented Global Head of Inside Sales to lead and scale its global SDR and BDR organisation.

The role will own the global Inside Sales strategy, operating model and performance, with responsibility for building predictable pipeline, improving sales productivity and increasing the contribution of Inside Sales to revenue growth.

Working closely with Direct Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, Product and Customer Success, the Global Head of Inside Sales will turn market opportunity into qualified pipeline and revenue through scalable inbound and outbound sales motions.

The successful candidate will combine strong SaaS commercial leadership with operational rigour and a proven ability to build and lead high-performing global teams through growth, transformation and change. They will also be a strong advocate for the use of AI and emerging technologies to improve prospecting, productivity and commercial effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Global Strategy & Commercial Impact

  • Define and execute the global Inside Sales strategy in alignment with Tagetik's business and go-to-market priorities.
  • Shape Inside Sales contribution to annual planning, market segmentation, territory design, coverage models and growth initiatives.
  • Drive predictable pipeline and revenue growth through effective customer acquisition and demand-conversion strategies.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and commercial KPIs across the global organisation.
  • Provide data-driven insights, recommendations and performance updates to the Global Sales Leadership Team and senior executives.
  • Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of the Inside Sales organisation and identify opportunities to improve scale, productivity and commercial impact.

Pipeline Generation & Demand Conversion

  • Build and optimise scalable inbound and outbound SDR/BDR motions across regions, segments and markets.
  • Improve meeting creation, opportunity conversion, pipeline velocity and progression from marketing-qualified leads to qualified sales opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Marketing to improve lead quality, campaign performance, demand generation and lead hand-offs.
  • Develop and scale account-based prospecting strategies for strategic and high-value accounts.
  • Establish strong alignment between SDR/BDR teams and Account Executives to maximise conversion, follow-through and revenue generation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from initial engagement through to sales opportunity.

Global Team Leadership & Talent

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing global SDR and BDR organisation across multiple geographies.
  • Build a culture of accountability, execution, continuous improvement and customer engagement.
  • Develop strong management capability and create clear succession plans across the organisation.
  • Own capacity planning, workforce planning, headcount allocation and alignment of Inside Sales resources with field sales coverage.
  • Attract, retain and develop high-calibre commercial talent across the global organisation.
  • Establish clear career development pathways, including opportunities for high-performing SDR/BDR employees to progress into Field Sales roles.
  • Lead organisational transformation and change initiatives that improve performance and scalability.

Operating Excellence, Technology & AI

  • Establish a consistent global operating model covering processes, KPIs, forecasting, reporting and performance management.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to improve data quality, performance visibility, forecasting accuracy and commercial decision-making.
  • Use analytics and performance data to identify productivity opportunities and improve return on commercial investment.
  • Accelerate adoption of AI-enabled prospecting, research, engagement, automation and sales-enablement technologies.
  • Evaluate emerging sales technologies and identify practical opportunities to improve productivity, scale and effectiveness.
  • Establish best practices and ensure consistent execution across regions while allowing for appropriate local market requirements.
  • Stay current with developments in SaaS selling, digital engagement, AI and modern revenue-generation practices and translate relevant innovation into practical improvements.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Channel Management, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product and Customer Success to align pipeline generation with broader go-to-market priorities.
  • Work closely with Field Sales leadership to ensure effective territory alignment, account coverage and pipeline conversion.
  • Represent Inside Sales in strategic business reviews, annual planning and growth initiatives.
  • Communicate performance, opportunities, risks and actions clearly to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor on pipeline generation, sales productivity and scalable revenue growth.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • 10+ years' experience in B2B SaaS, technology, software, information services or other subscription-based businesses.
  • Proven experience leading Inside Sales, Sales Development, Business Development or broader commercial sales organisations.
  • Significant experience leading global, multi-region teams, including both managers and individual contributors.
  • Demonstrated success delivering measurable improvements in pipeline generation, revenue contribution and sales productivity.
  • Experience building, scaling or transforming a global Inside Sales/SDR/BDR capability.
  • Strong understanding of modern SaaS go-to-market strategies, demand conversion and digital sales engagement.
  • Strong understanding and practical experience of AI-enabled GTM tools and their application to prospecting, research, engagement and sales productivity.
  • Strong analytical and operational capabilities, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities, make decisions and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to develop high-performing teams, strengthen leadership capability and create effective talent pipelines.
  • Strong commercial judgement, strategic thinking and the ability to translate strategy into measurable execution.
  • Experience operating effectively in a complex, matrixed global organisation.
  • Comfortable leading transformation, managing change and challenging established ways of working.
  • Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills, with the credibility to operate effectively with senior commercial and executive leadership.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Salesforce Architecture, Integration and Data Assessor
jobs.excerpt: Remote role Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one-time retrospective assessment lasting four months of a large, multi-year public-sector enterprise modernization program.
jobs.description:
Remote role

Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one-time retrospective assessment lasting four months of a large, multi-year public-sector enterprise modernization program.

This is an assessment engagement, not an implementation. You will not build, configure, integrate, remediate, or operate anything. You will examine what has already been built, review the evidence, interview the people who built it, and reach independent, defensible conclusions for executive leadership. Independence from the program's implementation vendors is a contractual requirement of the engagement.

The scope covers nine assessment domains and 65 discrete assessment requirements: program governance and risk, business process alignment, architecture and design, integration and data management, mainframe and legacy modernization, security and privacy compliance, software development lifecycle and configuration management, testing and quality assurance, and operational readiness. The technology environment includes a major cloud customer relationship management platform, a public cloud infrastructure estate, an enterprise integration platform, a content management platform, intelligent document processing, and a mainframe lift-and-refactor migration.

Deliverables include an assessment management plan, an initial assessment report, recurring status briefings, per-domain assessment reports, readiness assessments, an executive briefing, and a final assessment report.
You will work full time for four months in a small paired-team structure alongside senior peers. Findings go directly to executive leadership and to a legislative oversight body.

Required

  • 10 or more years in enterprise architecture or solution architecture
  • Salesforce governance depth — data model, security and sharing model, configuration governance, release governance, and adherence to platform best practices. We need someone who can judge whether a Salesforce environment was governed well, not someone who wants to build one.
  • MuleSoft or a comparable integration platform — application programming interface (API) lifecycle management, error handling, interface design, and API security. This category is often called iPaaS, meaning integration platform as a service.
  • Data migration and conversion assessment — source-to-target mapping, data cleansing, reconciliation controls, and data quality frameworks
  • Reporting and analytics readiness assessment
  • Can evaluate scalability, maintainability, extensibility, and supportability and write the conclusion up defensibly

About Us: Sabot Consulting is a management consulting company focused on providing technical and management consulting to IT executives and managers in strategic, operational, and project-based practice areas. Our focus on providing expert staff that have the knowledge, experience, and professionalism to engage the client at all levels is the key to our success.
