We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience in building enterprise applications and integrations, with hands-on exposure to Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.

The ideal candidate should have strong backend development experience using Python, .NET/C# or similar technologies, along with experience building REST APIs, integrating enterprise systems and working with modern data platforms. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, AI/LLM applications and RAG-based solutions will be highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable enterprise applications using Python, .NET/C# or similar backend technologies.
  • Develop and integrate REST APIs and enterprise applications.
  • Build integrations between applications, databases, APIs and Microsoft/Azure services.
  • Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, OneLake, Data Warehouse and Data Pipelines.
  • Work with SQL databases and modern data architectures.
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows for application and analytics use cases.
  • Integrate LLMs and generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
  • Develop or support RAG-based applications using enterprise data sources.
  • Work with Azure services for application hosting, integration, storage and data processing.
  • Collaborate with product, data, AI and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot application, API, integration and data-pipeline issues.
  • Follow software engineering best practices including Git, code reviews, testing and CI/CD.

Required Skills

  • 3+ years of Full Stack / Backend Development experience
  • Strong development experience in Python, .NET/C# or similar backend technology
  • REST API design, development and integration
  • SQL and relational database experience
  • Enterprise application and system integration
  • Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric
  • Fabric Data Factory / Data Pipelines
  • OneLake / Lakehouse / Data Warehouse concepts
  • Azure cloud services
  • Git and CI/CD
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

AI & Data Experience

Candidates should have exposure to one or more of the following:

  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications
  • LLM/API integration
  • Azure OpenAI or similar AI platforms
  • Vector databases / embeddings
  • Python-based AI application development
  • Microsoft Fabric data engineering
  • PySpark and Fabric Notebooks

Front-End Experience

Working knowledge of a modern front-end framework such as:

  • React
  • Angular
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • HTML/CSS

The role is backend and integration heavy, so deep front-end specialization is not mandatory.

Good to Have

  • Power BI and Fabric Semantic Models
  • Direct Lake
  • Azure Functions / App Service
  • Azure DevOps
  • Azure Data Factory or Synapse
  • Docker/containerization
  • Microsoft Fabric or Azure certifications
  • Experience developing AI-enabled enterprise applications

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a Full Stack Developer who can bridge application development, data engineering and AI integration.

We are specifically looking for someone who can build enterprise applications and APIs while also working comfortably with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services and AI/LLM integrations. Pure front-end developers or candidates whose Fabric experience is limited to certification/theoretical knowledge would not be the right fit.

Job Description

A bit about this role:

Our Eligibility & Enrollment team is the front door to the member experience — we process every enrollment, disenrollment, plan change, and retroactive adjustment across our HMO, PPO, and Special Needs Plan products, and we own the CMS transactions that make membership accurate and auditable. As Manager, you'll turn departmental strategy into daily workflows, production targets, and staff assignments, keeping the work compliant with CMS requirements and on time.

You'll report to the Senior Manager, Eligibility & Enrollment and lead a team of Enrollment/Eligibility Associates. This is a hands-on operational leadership role: you'll be in the queues, in the data, and in the escalations, while building the reporting and controls the team runs on. Your results show up directly in CMS transaction accuracy and timeliness, inventory aging, quality audit scores, and the member experience measures tied to enrollment accuracy.

Your responsibilities and impact will include:

  • Managing daily workflow, work queues, and transaction inventory so enrollments, disenrollments, plan changes, cancellations, and retroactive adjustments across HMO, PPO, and SNP products clear within CMS and internal SLAs, holding aging and backlog inside established thresholds.

  • Monitoring CMS MARx submissions, response and reply files, and error reports so rejections and discrepancies are researched and resolved inside required timeframes, and membership reconciliation lands accurate and on time each month.

  • Serving as the first point of escalation on complex and exception-based cases, making case-level decisions consistent with CMS guidance and internal policy.

  • Supervising, coaching, and developing associates — hiring, onboarding, scheduling, one-on-ones, performance management, and individual production and quality goals tied to department KPIs — and owning the team's productivity, quality, engagement, and retention. You'll set the tone for accountability and service excellence, and address performance or conduct issues promptly and consistently.

  • Planning capacity and coverage for peak cycles, including AEP, OEP, and Special Election Periods, so volume surges don't become backlog.

  • Performing and documenting quality reviews of transactions and member records against the CMS Medicare Managed Care Enrollment and Disenrollment Guidance and internal controls, and driving individual and team audit scores.

  • Supporting CMS, internal, and external audits by preparing universes, pulling case files, validating samples, and answering auditor questions; executing assigned corrective action plans and closing them on time, with no repeat findings in your area.

  • Translating new CMS guidance and memos into operational changes — recommending workflow updates to the Senior Manager, keeping job aids and desk-level procedures current, and training staff on regulatory changes and system enhancements.

  • Identifying recurring errors, rework drivers, and manual workarounds, then implementing process improvements and automation opportunities.

  • Building and maintaining notebooks and monitoring views for volume, aging, throughput, accuracy, timeliness, and reconciliation completion, and escalating trends and risks with a recommended action rather than just a number.

  • Partnering with peer managers and staff on the design and use of AI agents in transaction processing under a human-in-the-loop model: defining where human review is required, setting quality checkpoints on agent-assisted output, documenting controls to audit standards, and coaching the team against over-reliance on automated output.

  • Partnering with Member Services, Billing, Data Reconciliation, Compliance, Sales, Agent Support, and Tech on member-impacting issues, defect resolution, file transmission and interface monitoring, and UAT for configuration changes, upgrades, new products, and plan expansions.

  • Supporting the Senior Manager with materials and analysis for leadership, CMS inquiries, and internal governance forums.

Required skills and experience:

  • 4+ years in Medicare Advantage eligibility and enrollment operations, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or team lead role.

  • Working knowledge of CMS enrollment and disenrollment regulations for HMO, PPO, and SNP products, including election periods, effective dating, and retroactive processing rules.

  • Hands-on experience with CMS MARx transaction processing, response and reply file handling, and membership reconciliation.

  • Experience supporting CMS or internal audits, including universe preparation and case documentation.

  • Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills on complex transaction and eligibility discrepancies, with proficiency in Excel and reporting tools for inventory tracking, trend analysis, and audit sampling.

  • Demonstrated aptitude for hands-on operational tooling — including the ability to learn and build notebooks for metric monitoring and reporting — and willingness to work directly in AI-assisted processes under a human-in-the-loop model.

  • Effective written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain regulatory requirements to staff and non-technical partners.

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and high-volume workloads in a deadline-driven, regulated environment, with a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy and member confidentiality (HIPAA).

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Health Administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and directly relevant Medicare enrollment experience will be considered.

  • Ability to work remotely with availability to support extended coverage during AEP, OEP, and other peak enrollment periods.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Health plan, MSO, or TPA experience, with proficiency in a health plan administration platform (QNXT, Facets, HealthEdge, or similar) and CMS data exchange tools including HPMS.

Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do, as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: France
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in France.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

Surface these opportunities with specificity — context, timing, and the right internal contact. Maintain awareness of each market’s competitive dynamics and flag threats as well as opportunities. Serve as the connective tissue between field-level insight and NAPA’s RVPs and business development.

SCOPE & DEPLOYMENT MODEL

CSDs are nationally deployable and assigned to markets by need and strategic priority, not by physical proximity alone. A CSD may support multiple markets within a region or cross-region boundaries when RVP capacity and client risk warrant. Assignments are determined collaboratively with Regional SVP leadership and adjusted as portfolio conditions evolve.

Deployment principles:

  • Every client has an assigned, accountable partner with a preset meeting cadence with the executive decision makers for the relationship.

  • Travel cadence is defined by market need; CSDs are expected to achieve meaningful face time with clients and clinicians without being anchored to a single geography.

  • Remote-first work is the operating assumption; on-site presence is purposeful and planned, not incidental.

KEY INTERNAL RELATIONSHIPS

Vice President of Operations - Primary reporting relationship; CSD provides operational and relational capacity relief; escalates only issues requiring RVP authority.

Clinical Vice President - Dotted-line accountability; input on portfolio assignments, performance standards, and strategic priorities.

Chief Physicians / Chief CRNAs - Day-to-day operational partners; CSD supports chief effectiveness and surfaces leadership development needs.

APP Senior Director - Aligned on APP staffing models, performance trends, and practice integration.

Talent Acquisition / HR - Coordinated recruitment, credentialing, onboarding, and provider relations support.

RCM / Accounting - Monitor site-level billing performance; escalate compliance gaps and payer issues.

Client Success / Implementation Teams - Collaboration on new site stand-ups, HyperCare transitions, and escalated client satisfaction situations.

Centralized Scheduling Leadership - High-partnership relationship; CSD owns the effectiveness of every clinical schedule in their market, with shared accountability for delivering consistent operational standards across clients.

Centralized HR Leadership - High-partnership relationship; CSD routes all HR issues — provider relations, payroll concerns, onboarding, credentialing delays, personnel matters — through centralized HR leadership. Acts as the field-level connector and advocate, not the resolver. Timely and accurate escalation to HR is a core performance expectation.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in healthcare operations, account management, or clinical services administration, preferably within an anesthesia or physician practice management organization.

  • Demonstrated track record of managing complex client relationships and driving measurable retention or satisfaction outcomes.

  • Strong financial literacy: ability to read site-level P&Ls, identify performance variances, and communicate financial risk clearly.

  • Experience coordinating clinician recruitment, credentialing, and onboarding workflows in a multi-site healthcare environment.

  • Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to build trust with clinicians, hospital administrators, and executive stakeholders.

  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently — expected 30–50% travel depending on market portfolio.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with clinical operations systems including scheduling platforms (Qgenda preferred), practice management tools (iPro preferred), and CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics preferred).

  • Experience supporting or leading new site implementations in a healthcare services environment.

  • Familiarity with various types of client contractual agreements.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

Client retention in assigned portfolio - No at-risk contracts escalate without early CSD involvement and documented action plan.

RVP capacity relief - RVPs report meaningful reduction in day-to-day operational interruptions from CSD-covered markets.

Issue resolution cycle time - Operational issues are closed at the CSD level; escalation rate to RVP is tracked and declining.

Locum and premium pay reduction - Month-over-month reduction in locum reliance and unplanned premium pay in assigned markets.

Clinician satisfaction / retention - Chiefs and clinicians in CSD-supported markets report accessible, responsive support.

Client relationship health - Regular cadenced client touchpoints are documented; no significant satisfaction deterioration goes unreported.

TOTAL REWARDS:

North American Partners in Anesthesia (NAPA) offers excellent salary, benefits and paid time off.

  • Generous benefits package, including:

    • Paid Time Off

    • Health, life, vision, dental, disability, and AD&D insurance

    • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts

    • 401(k)

    • Leadership and professional development opportunities

The Clinical Services Director (CSD) is a senior field-facing role responsible for the operational and financial health, clinician experience, and client relationships across an assigned portfolio of NAPA markets. Operating without a geographic residency requirement, the CSD is deployed where need and opportunity are greatest — providing consistent, high-quality support to their markets and amplifying the capacity and effectiveness of their VP of Operations who carries ultimate portfolio accountability.

The CSD role has full P&L ownership for their market and serves as the trusted, accountable partner to both NAPA clients and the clinicians who serve them. This is an intentionally matrixed role. The CSD works within the dyad clinical and operational leadership of their region, and is also expected to work through centralized service delivery leadership to achieve great outcomes. They consistently model the kind of cross-functional partnering that produces repeatable, high-quality output across every market they support.

EEO Statement

North American Partners in Anesthesia is an equal opportunity employer.

Location:Remote

Civic News Companyis leading a civic revival.

We were founded to address one of the most consequential market failures of our time: the collapse of local news. Since 2008, nearly two-thirds of U.S. newsroom jobs have disappeared, leaving communities without trusted reporting on education, elections, and public health. Our mission is simple and urgent: to help people understand how America works so they can make it work better.

ThroughChalkbeat(education),Votebeat(elections), andHealthbeat(public health), we operate a national network of local news bureaus that combine deep local expertise with centralized national infrastructure.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Civic News is seeking aReporterto cover schools and education policy as part of the Chalkbeat Indiana team.

This is a critical moment to report about education in Indianapolis. How the city’s schools are run and governed is going through a radical transformation, with shifting power dynamics and uncertainty over how it will play out in the city’s district-run and charter schools. Changes to how school performance is measured, decisions about students’transportation to and from school, and charged debates about school closures all loom on the horizon.

You will tell these stories, hold leaders accountable, and put the news into context for students and families.Your work will help families and leaders make decisions for stronger public understanding of the institutions and decisions that shape students' lives. You’ll also be a member of a team covering education across Indiana, including how high schools prepare students for college and career, and what access families have to vouchers and online schools.

Capturing this story requires strong beat reporting, source development, relationship-building, and writing skills. You should enjoy a fast-paced and newsy environment and be comfortable as one of Chalkbeat’s public faces in the community and representing the organization at public events and on social media. This role includes night meeting coverage as well as the occasional evening event.

The key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Report and write compelling local education stories, balancing quick-turn news coverage with enterprise and accountability journalism.

  • Develop and execute longer-term reporting projects that deepen readers’ understanding of local education issues.

  • Serve as a trusted guide for readers by clearly explaining how education systems, policies, and decisions affect local communities.

  • Hold public officials and institutions accountable through rigorous, fair, and well-sourced reporting.

  • Engage with readers and community members to identify relevant stories, questions, and areas of interest.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across Chalkbeat and with external news partners on reporting and special projects, including TV, radio and panel appearances.

  • Build and maintain relationships with a broad range of sources, including educators, education leaders, parents, students, and community members.

  • Report stories that make an impact in the community and drive change.

What background and skills do you have? (We know not all strong candidates will have all the skills we list. That’s OK. What else do you bring to the table? Please tell us!): The person we seek:

  • 3+ years of experience in journalism.

  • Excellent news judgment.

  • Breaking news metabolism and decisiveness.

  • Ability to produce ambitious, agenda-setting enterprise journalism.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, demonstrating empathy and understanding while being unafraid to have tough conversations when needed.

  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

  • Passion for education and Chalkbeat’s mission is a must; knowledge of education is a strong plus, but not required.

Bonus points if you’ve got:

  • Connections to Indianapolis.

  • Data journalism experience.

  • Photo and social video skills.

  • Fluency in a language other than English, especially Spanish.

Civic NewsValues, here’s how that shows up in our work together:

  • We work as one team.

    Rebuilding local news requires collaboration. We actively nurture a harmonious environment of dignity, respect, and professionalism. We assume good intent, support one another’s growth, and have a team-oriented approach to solving problems together.

  • We pursue truth with intellectual honesty.
    Our work demands rigor. We seek facts, challenge assumptions, and engage thoughtfully with perspectives different from our own. We follow the evidence wherever it leads.

  • We practice inclusive journalism.

    Strong civic life depends on representation and trust. We commit to antiracism, equity, and inclusive practices. We build meaningful relationships with the communities we serve and reflect their realities in our reporting.

  • We earn trust every day.

    We develop subject-matter expertise. We operate transparently. We take responsibility for our work and keep learning so our journalism remains credible, relevant, and strong.

This full-time, remote-eligible position is based in the Indianapolis area. Civic News Company already has a presence: Chicago, Colorado, Indianapolis, Newark, Pennsylvania, Arizona, Texas, Michigan, Tennessee, New York City, and Washington, D.C.

The salary range is $65,000 to $80,000; final salary will be determined based on level of experience and geographic location, with a generous benefits package, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance

  • Time off that truly supports rest, including 20 days of PTO, a paid one-week recess, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays, and 12 paid holidays in 2026

  • Retirement support through a 401(k) with a 4% employer match that is immediately vested

  • 100% paid parental leave: 18 weeks fully paid, plus a 2-week part-time return-to-work ramp-up

  • Flexible Spending Plan for eligible medical or childcare expenses

  • Annual professional development stipend

  • Employer-provided life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

  • Monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet expenses

Civic News Company recognizes a staff bargaining unit, Civic News Company, affiliated with the Writers Guild of America, East,a labor union representing thousands of members who write content for news and online media, motion pictures, and television.This position is included in the Civic News Company bargaining unit.

Physical Requirements of the Job

This role is primarily sedentary and involves extended periods of sitting and regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones, for up to 8 hours per day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Civic News Company Commitment

Civic News Company is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization. We believe restoring civic trust requires a plurality of voices, backgrounds, and experiences. Civic News Company is committed to equal employment opportunities and welcomes applicants and employees from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to races, colors, national origins, ancestries, creeds, religions, genders, ages, disabilities, veteran status, sexual orientations, and marital statuses. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply and contribute to our shared vision.

Civic News Company participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, Civic News Company is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before Civic News Company can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Civic News Company can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

At Sleek, we are on a mission to streamline operations and elevate customer experience through intelligent automation and modern engineering.

About the Role:

We are looking for a sharp, commercially-minded, and execution-oriented Product Manager to own the growth trajectory of our two core emerging products: the Sleek Business Account (SBA)—a licensed, fledgling digital business account in Singapore and our new proprietary In-House Payroll Solution

This is a senior-level, highly autonomous, hands-on builder role. You will not have a dedicated marketing department; you will own the product strategy, project management, and go-to-market execution from top to bottom. If you have deep neo- banking roots, love driving organic growth loops, and thrive in lean, rapid-deployment environments, this role is built for you.

Mission of the Role

To aggressively scale revenue for the SBA and Payroll products by driving rapid customer adoption, expanding AUM for SBA, and increasing the volume of active employees utilizing the Payroll system.

Key Outcomes (First 6–12 Months)

  • Accelerate customer adoption rates for both SBA and Payroll.
  • Significantly expand the AUM of the SBA and grow the total number of employees onboarded to the Payroll software.
  • Directly increase Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) through strategic product monetization,such as value-added foreign exchange (FX) transactions.
  • Successfully navigate ambiguities to deliver product commitments on time, partnering intimately with key stakeholders and a dedicated engineering squad.

Requirements

Must-Have Experience

  • 5 to 10 Years in Product Manager Roles: Proven track record of robust, hands-on product management within a Neobank, Digital Bank, or high-growth Fintech environment.
  • 0-to-1 Product Delivery: Demonstrated success taking tech products from ideation to launch and scaling them as an individual contributor.
  • Commercial & Growth Competency: Experience driving user adoption, managing legacy data migrations, and optimizing commercial metrics like Assets Under Management (AUM) and FX/transaction revenues
  • AI & Tech Literacy: Fluent with AI applications and structurally familiar with AI evaluations (evals) to drive automated feature development alongside engineering.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: Exceptional skill in working backwards from aggressive growth targets using structured, data-driven frameworks.

Must-Have Attributes

  • Extreme Ownership & High Agency: A self-starter who operates autonomously, moves fast under heavy ambiguity, and takes absolute accountability for outcomes.
  • Commercial Mindset & Customer Empathy: Deeply understands user pain points while simultaneously thinking strategically about monetization and business growth.
  • The "Builder" Mentality: Combines high-level product vision with a grounded, humble approach to doing the tactical, ground-level execution yourself.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Ability to handle both product strategy and hands-on Go-To-Market (GTM) execution without dedicated marketing support.
  • Collaborative Diplomat: A low-ego communicator who builds trust, bridges engineering and commercial teams, and aligns leadership to drive consensus.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. Le poste est pensé pour quelqu'un qui est à l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, et pour qui la construction d'une stratégie compte autant que sa mise en œuvre concrète sur le terrain.

A Keyrus é um grupo internacional com 2.800 consultores e especialistas em 28 países, construído sobre uma convicção: a IA não transforma empresas. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.
Há mais de 30 anos, construímos as bases de dados que tornam os sistemas inteligentes possíveis, projetando o Sistema Operacional da Empresa Inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada ao núcleo dos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável: operacionalizamos a inteligência.

A tecnologia amplia capacidades. A cultura da Keyrus diferencia. A excelência na execução conecta ambas.

jobs.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI for Automotive Retail
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityEvery used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart
  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed
  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate
  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you
  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up
  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need
  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors
  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something
  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app
  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning
  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"
  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on
  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself
  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead
  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data
  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)
  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there
  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

At Engine, we're transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented — we're here to change that. We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. That's why we're building a platform that brings together corporate travel, a powerful charge card, and modern spend management in one place.

To make this vision real, we're looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. As a Partner Acquisition Lead, Transportation, you will lead the development and acquisition of partnerships across fleet payments, transportation management systems (TMS), telematics, and fuel networks — building on our existing relationships with partners like WEX and Trimble to reach hundreds of thousands of fleets, owner-operators, and professional drivers who book lodging on the road every night.   • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of the transportation partnerships program, providing regular reporting to leadership. This includes the number and opportunity size of active partner opportunities in the pipeline, number of signed partners, and revenue generated from newly signed partners.

What You'll Bring to Engine

We're looking for someone who's ready to make an impact and grow alongside us:

You are a strategic, financially-minded business development leader with a history of closing complex, high-value deals inside the transportation, logistics, or fleet ecosystem. You thrive on building new go-to-market motions and have a unique ability to sell through partners to unlock exponential growth.

  • 7-10+ years of experience in enterprise sales or business development, with a proven track record of selling SaaS, fintech, or technology solutions
  • Mastery of the "one-to-many" sales motion, with demonstrated success in structuring partnerships that scale through a partner's network, portfolio, or member base.
  • Exceptional financial acumen and the ability to build a compelling, data-driven business case focused on ROI, operational efficiency, and value creation for both the partner and their end customer.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and close deals with C-suite executives and senior partnership leaders at large, complex organizations.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, with a bias for action and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into transportation, trucking, logistics, or fleet operators — or into the platforms that serve them (TMS, fleet cards, telematics, ELD, factoring).
  • Deep familiarity with the trucking and fleet ecosystem, including how carriers, owner-operators, brokers, and shippers actually run their business, and where lodging fits in the driver and dispatcher workflow.

  • Implement DNS strategies including Route 53, Azure DNS, or Cloud DNS with hybrid resolution.
  • Design private connectivity to managed services using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, or Private Service Connect.
  • Automate cloud networking with Terraform, providing infrastructure-as-code coverage across the network estate.
  • Implement network security controls including firewalls, NACLs, security groups, and DDoS protection.
  • Operate Kubernetes networking including CNI selection, ingress strategies, and service exposure patterns.
  • Build observability for cloud networking including flow logs, traffic insights, and packet capture.
  • Drive cost optimization including data transfer reduction and right-sizing of network resources.
  • Partner with security teams to harden the network perimeter and enforce zero-trust principles.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud networking issues across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Stay current with cloud networking platform updates and emerging patterns.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in networking, with significant time on cloud networking.
  • Deep hands-on experience with networking on at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong understanding of routing, switching, BGP, and modern networking fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or equivalents).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code for cloud networking, especially Terraform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security and network controls.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes networking and service mesh fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting and packet-level analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Responsible for providing leadership and strategic direction for the Commercial Surety business, driving underwriting excellence, profitable growth, portfolio performance, and market competitiveness. Serves as the senior underwriting executive accountable for establishing and executing underwriting strategy, risk appetite, product direction, and distribution objectives across the business. Leads a geographically dispersed team of underwriting leaders and directs the development of talent, succession strategies, and organizational capabilities to ensure long-term business success.

Oversees portfolio management, underwriting governance, capacity deployment, and emerging risk assessment to optimize profitability, growth, and operational effectiveness. Maintains key relationships with distribution partners, reinsurance stakeholders, and industry leaders while ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, underwriting standards, and enterprise risk management practices. Acts as the principal subject matter expert and strategic advisor for the Commercial Surety business, influencing business outcomes through data-driven decision-making, market insight, and disciplined underwriting execution.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Business Leadership & Distribution Management

  • Provides executive leadership for the Commercial Surety line of business, establishing and executing long-term strategies that drive profitable growth, market expansion, and sustainable competitive advantage.

  • Leads a team of Home Office and Regional Directors, creating alignment between underwriting, distribution, and business objectives across the operating territory.

  • Develops and maintains executive-level relationships with key agencies, brokers, producers, and industry stakeholders, influencing distribution strategy and optimizing market presence.

  • Directs agency and broker appointment strategies, ensuring alignment with growth objectives, risk appetite, and profitability goals.

Underwriting Strategy, Portfolio Management & Risk Governance

  • Establishes and maintains underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, authority structures, guidelines, and governance frameworks for the Commercial Surety portfolio.

  • Serves as the senior underwriting authority and principal subject matter expert, ensuring consistent underwriting discipline and portfolio management practices across the organization.

  • Oversees portfolio performance, capacity utilization, emerging risk assessment, and underwriting results to achieve profitability and growth objectives.

  • Collaborates with internal business partners on underwriting audits, quality assurance processes, and compliance activities to ensure adherence to underwriting standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Engages with reinsurance partners and executive stakeholders to communicate portfolio performance, strategic initiatives, and risk management outcomes.

Financial Performance & Product Management

  • Oversees pricing strategy, risk selection practices, and portfolio optimization efforts to maximize underwriting performance and return on capital.

  • Provides strategic direction for product development, policy form enhancement, rate adequacy initiatives, and regulatory filings.

  • Partners with enterprise leadership to evaluate market opportunities, competitive trends, and business performance, adjusting strategies as needed to achieve desired results.

Talent Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Provides leadership, coaching, and development for underwriting leaders and teams, fostering a caring, high-performance culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

  • Establishes organizational capability strategies, including workforce planning, succession management, talent retention, talent acquisition, and leadership development.

  • Maintains full management accountability for performance management, compensation decisions, employee engagement, and workforce effectiveness.

  • Develops future underwriting leaders and strengthens organizational bench strength to support long-term business objectives.

Operational Excellence & Business Transformation

  • Provides executive sponsorship and strategic direction for underwriting technology, workflow optimization, and business transformation initiatives.

  • Partners with technology, analytics, and operations leaders to enhance underwriting platforms, predictive modeling capabilities, and portfolio management tools.

  • Drives continuous improvement efforts that improve underwriting efficiency, decision quality, scalability, and customer experience while supporting enterprise objectives.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to VP – Head of Surety, leads a team of professionals.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in risk management, Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Master’s degree in business administration (MBA), Finance, Risk Management, Economics, or related discipline is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of CPCU and AFSB helpful.

Experience: Minimum of 15 years of Underwriting/Marketing/Leadership experience in the surety bond marketplace. Prior-related experience will be considered but most recently in surety marketplace with key broker contacts. Significant experience leading Commercial Surety underwriting operations with responsibility for profitability, growth, and portfolio performance. Experience managing large accounts, complex surety programs, and significant underwriting authority. Experience developing and executing underwriting strategies, risk appetite frameworks, and portfolio management initiatives. Demonstrated success leading geographically dispersed underwriting teams and developing underwriting leaders. Experience working with brokers, agents, producers, and key distribution partners. Experience presenting business results and strategic initiatives to executive leadership. Experience leading a national or multi-regional Commercial Surety business. Experience managing reinsurance relationships and negotiating treaty structures. Experience overseeing product development, pricing strategies, regulatory filings, and form development. Experience leading underwriting transformation, technology implementation, predictive modeling, or analytics initiatives. Experience managing P&L or direct financial accountability for a product line or business segment.

jobs.description:
Lead Ember's Southeast Asia team into its next chapter, shaping the vision, strategy and delivery of our policy work across one of the quickly emerging regions in the clean energy transition.

The Role

Ember is recruiting a Southeast Asia Regional Lead to build on our established, successful team - deepening our influence with regional policymakers and ensuring our analysis lands where decisions are made. You will set the vision, strategy and delivery of our policy programme across the region, leading a team of analysts and researchers, working within Ember’s organisational strategy and the quality standards set by the team director.

You will shape Ember’s strategy for the region, ensure high-quality delivery of the team's outputs and champion Ember's work directly with Southeast Asian policymakers, funders and media. You will also collaborate with our Comms and Data teams to collectively ensure our work lands with real reach and impact.In your first months, you'll work with the Deputy CEO through a defined process to shape how work and roles are organised within the team

This role reports to the Deputy CEO on an interim basis and will report to the team director once that role is in place. You will lead a team with direct line management of up to 4 staff. The team's internal structure is expected to evolve, and you'll play a central role in shaping it during your first months, with support from the Deputy CEO.

About Ember

Ember is an independent, not-for-profit energy think tank that aims to accelerate the clean energy transition with data and policy. We gather, curate and analyse data on the power sector and coal mine methane emissions, and use our findings to improve energy and climate policy.

See our work at and

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and drive Southeast Asia's programme strategy, translating Ember's overall direction into a compelling plan for the region, agreed with the team director.
  • Own delivery of the team's outputs, ensuring high-quality, timely work in line with regional priorities and funder KPIs, acting as the point of quality sign-off for regional outputs within standards agreed across regions
  • Champion and represent the team's work externally with Southeast Asian policymakers, media and partners
  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with Ember's network partners across Southeast Asia, positioning Ember as a reliable, collaborative partner in the region
  • Support funder relationships and grant reporting for the team, working with senior leadership on new fundraising opportunities with fundraising strategy and budget planning led by the team director, with the CEO and Deputy CEO.
  • Mentor and develop the Southeast Asia team, giving clear direction, setting objectives and supporting their growth
  • Co-create a close, day-to-day working relationship with Comms and Data team colleagues, so the three function as one delivery team
  • Coordinate with other Regional Leads to share learnings and align on cross-cutting issues

Location - Remote, based in Southeast Asia. Must have the right to work in your country of residence and be able to attend periodic in-person team meet-ups.

Requirements

Must have

  • Significant experience in a policy, research, or programme leadership role in Southeast Asia, with a track record of setting direction and delivering outputs that lead to real policy impact
  • Solid technical understanding of clean energy transition issues relevant to Southeast Asian countries and experience of influencing the clean energy narrative
  • Line management experience, including managing experienced staff and a track record of developing others with evidence of readiness to grow into managing managers, for example through leading senior colleagues, deputising, or coordinating work across multiple workstreams
  • Confidence representing an organisation's work internally, and externally with policymakers, media and funders
  • A track record of making sound decisions within their remit without needing constant consensus
  • Strong relationships with, or a credible path to building relationships with, Asian funders, policymakers, and media
  • Experience managing distributed or remote teams

Nice to have

  • Existing network of Southeast Asian policymakers, funders, and media contacts
  • Fundraising or grant management experience
  • Experience helping shape or restructure a growing team

We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.

Benefits

Salary: £54,880 per year, based on our standard local cost-of-living adjustment. The salary may be adjusted upwards for candidates based in higher cost-of-living locations in Asia; the applicable salary will be confirmed based on the candidate's location.

Contract: Full time (but only working 9 days every fortnight with no reduction in pay).

Location: Remote, based in Southeast Asia. Must have the right to work in your country of residence and be able to attend periodic in-person team meet-ups.

Further benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package, including:

  • We operate a nine-day fortnight meaning our full-time staff are given every other Friday off work with no reduction in pay
  • A minimum of 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • For each year that you're part of the team at Ember you'll receive an additional day of holiday, up to a maximum of 5 additional days.
  • Flexible working conditions, including the opportunity for part-time work and home working.
  • Access to a local working space can be arranged
  • Free annual eye tests
  • Access to a counselling service
  • Funding and allocated time for your training and development

jobs.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

The role is responsible for conducting data collection and analyses to support process improvement programs and projects to reduce cost and complexity across the enterprise. The role will lead a variety of projects in support of the goals of business divisions. Additionally, the incumbent may work in partnership with other BPI colleagues in support of cross-functional enterprise initiatives. The incumbent will draft and review project deliverables and analyses such as value-stream mapping and statistical analyses and supervise business process analysts in the project team environment. The role will also be responsible for business case development using ROI models in direct relationship to departmental goals. The incumbent of this position will interact with process and subject matter experts to develop solutions that improve process performance by increasing productivity and efficiency and/or managing process demands while enhancing the customer experience. In addition to BPI project work, the incumbent must also plan and participate in BPI organization building and activities to help promote the BPI brand, and serve as a mentor to business staff pursuing their Green Lean and Green Belt certifications. This position requires an individual with a strong background in process improvement with the ability to deliver significant sustainable business results.

What You'll Do

Leadership:

  • Experienced process improvement practitioner with a focus on driving cost reduction
  • Execute complex process improvement initiatives with some supervision and guidance
  • Report and communicate the results from process improvement efforts to division
  • Influence business partners to make informed decisions
  • Ability to influence small teams without direct authority
  • Act as a change agent/coach to instill and sustain changes
  • Build positive relationships and credibility with the BPI team and business partners
  • Assess change readiness and prepare plans for helping stakeholders through change
  • Utilize process improvement principles and tools to achieve significant improvement results
  • Direct the analyses of process improvement analysts
  • Drive for high quality results

Process Improvement:

  • Utilize Lean, DMAIC and Design for Six Sigma tools and methodologies to define activities that are aligned with business objectives
  • Identify and manage project risks and issues that impact project progress
  • Prepare detailed plans to track project performance and assure timely completion and achievement of project deliverables
  • Develop practical solutions and methodologies to solve complex business problems
  • Effectively coach, mentor and assist Lean and Green Belt candidates to certification
  • Develop internal and external content for leadership team presentations
  • Ensure deployment of common solutions across divisions and businesses
  • Identify and present new project opportunities to leadership
  • Develop and share best practices among fellow process improvement coaches and clients

​

Financial Management:

  • Partner with Finance and Business to develop and track project metrics
  • Develop business cases using ROI models
  • Develop control plans and monitor performance and improvement in key metrics
  • Deliver significant operational improvement and financial benefits to meet annual targets

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required
  • Bachelor degree preferred or relevant experience in lieu of degree
  • Requires a minimum of 5 years business process improvement or process redesign experience

Additional licensing, certifications, registrations:

  • Lean Six Sigma Green-level certification from an industry recognized academic or quality institution (e.g. Universities, American Society for Quality) plus the commitment to achieve Horizon Black Belt certification within two years of hire

Knowledge:

  • Healthcare industry experience preferred
  • Experience in a multi-divisional corporate environment desired
  • Understanding of change management challenges related to process improvement
  • Proven project management and process improvement skills including strong knowledge of lean and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experienced with Minitab and/or other statistical software
  • Must be proficient in MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to lead the work of others
  • Strong verbal/written communication skills, both verbal and in written
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to create strong working relationships with others
  • Ability to gather, synthesize and analyze data and draw logical conclusions
  • Strong project management experience
  • Well organized and results-driven individual

Travel (If Applicable):

  • Occasional travel may be required to alternate Horizon sites

Why Horizon?

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

$97,800 - $133,455

This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. Location
Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

Responsibilities

  • Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
  • Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
  • Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
  • Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
  • API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
  • Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
  • Strong TypeScript, including modern frontend work - React preferred
  • Hands-on experience with Go, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
  • Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
  • Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface
  • Working proficiency in SQL
  • Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)
  • A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next
  • AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles
  • Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

  • Experience building integration platforms or extensibility frameworks as a core part of a product
  • Experience with cloud or SaaS billing data - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
  • Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)
  • Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integration, intelligent automation)
  • Exposure to FinOps practices or cloud financial management products
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Are you a Do'er?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities supporting U.S. and Canadian companies. About the Role

As a Medical Administrative & Surgical Patient Coordinator, you will own the administrative coordination that happens after a patient begins moving through the surgical process. You will make sure required clearances, testing, records, appointments, documentation, and pre-operative steps are completed so patients stay on track for surgery.

This is an operations-focused healthcare role, not a sales position and not a remote clinical position. You will work directly with patients, medical offices, imaging centers, laboratories, hospitals, and other healthcare providers while knowing when a question or concern needs to be escalated to clinical staff. You will receive training on the practice's specific workflows and gradually take ownership of a critical part of the patient journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own and track the pre-operative process for multiple surgical patients from booking through readiness for surgery.
  • Keep each patient's pre-operative checklist current, identifying missing clearances, tests, records, documentation, and other requirements before they become delays.
  • Coordinate required appointments and testing, including imaging, medical clearances, laboratory work, and other pre-operative requirements.
  • Contact hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare facilities to obtain outstanding information and keep cases moving.
  • Follow up persistently with outside providers when testing, records, or clearances are delayed, advocating for patients while maintaining professional communication.
  • Conduct or support standardized pre-operative patient calls and clearly walk patients through established non-clinical instructions and next steps.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of patient conversations, completed requirements, pending items, and case status within the appropriate systems.
  • Communicate surgical readiness, outstanding requirements, and potential delays clearly to the broader practice team.
  • Recognize clinical questions, unusual circumstances, or concerns that fall outside your administrative scope and escalate them promptly rather than providing independent medical advice.
  • Provide additional medical administrative and patient-coordination support when needed to improve the efficiency of the surgical process.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in medical administration, surgical coordination, patient coordination, pre-operative coordination, or closely related healthcare operations.
  • Hands-on experience working in a U.S. medical practice or healthcare environment.
  • Direct experience coordinating surgical or pre-operative patients, including appointments, tests, medical records, clearances, or required documentation.
  • Experience using EMR, CRM, patient-management, or comparable medical-office systems.
  • Confidence communicating directly with patients and contacting hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare providers.

Nice to Have:

jobs.excerpt: THE ROLE Gorilla Commerce is seeking a Manager, PLM & Product Data to serve as the business owner and super-user of the company's PLM platform.
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Gorilla Commerce is seeking a Manager, PLM & Product Data to serve as the business owner and super-user of the company's PLM platform.

Gorilla Commerce has successfully implemented PLM as the system of record for product specifications, BOMs, materials, suppliers and costing, and the platform is live across the sourcing organization. This role owns it from here — closing the residual data gaps that follow any implementation, raising the standard of governance, and maturing the platform through its next phases of capability.

The scope is broad but well supported. Sourcing teams own day-to-day data entry and maintenance following go-live. A dedicated analyst supports bulk uploads, reconciliation and heavy data work. IT leads the technical build of the PLM–ERP integration. This role sets the standards, makes the system decisions, and directs the work.

There is genuine white space here. An 18-month roadmap is defined — stronger specification and BOM structure, packaging and artwork governance, warning-label and claims data — and the person in this role will shape how it is prioritized, sequenced and delivered.

The role can be based globally and works core US Eastern hours to stay aligned with the VP and the wider team, with some flexibility for Asia-based sourcing partners.

This is not a data-entry or system-administration role. It is a product-data ownership role focused on structure, governance, adoption and system maturity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

System Ownership & Configuration

  • Own the day-to-day health, configuration and evolution of the PLM platform.

  • Act as the internal authority on how PLM should be structured and used across parent and SKU hierarchy, specifications, BOMs, materials, supplier and factory records, quotes and costing.

  • Determine whether an issue is best solved through configuration, data architecture, process design or vendor development.

  • Own integration keys and mappings between PLM and the ERP.

Product Data Governance & Integrity

  • Own product data quality as an ongoing discipline rather than a periodic cleanup.

  • Establish validation standards, naming conventions and audit routines that prevent errors upstream.

  • Reconcile PLM against ERP master data and resolve discrepancies at root cause.

  • Close residual implementation gaps across product hierarchy, suppliers and factories, BOMs, color/size and supplier quote data.

Workflow, Change & Version Control

  • Design and govern state models, approval workflows and revision control.

  • Define how specification and BOM changes are requested, approved, tested and released.

  • Assess downstream impact of data and configuration changes before release.

  • Establish clear decision rights across this role, functional owners, IT and leadership.

Adoption, Training & Process Discipline

  • Drive adoption across a distributed sourcing organization as a core deliverable of the role.

  • Build and maintain SOPs, training materials and onboarding for new users.

  • Move remaining product workflows off spreadsheets and email and into PLM.

  • Identify recurring process failures and resolve the root cause rather than the symptom.

Vendor Partnership & Roadmap

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with the PLM software vendor.

  • Manage tickets, requirements, testing and feature scoping independently, escalating commercial matters to the VP.

  • Own the business-side PLM roadmap and translate business needs into practical system and process solutions.

  • Sequence future capability including deeper Level 2 and 3 BOM structure, packaging governance and claims data.

Integration Support

  • Support the IT-led PLM–ERP integration through requirements definition, mapping validation and UAT.

  • Diagnose whether issues originate in source data, PLM configuration, integration logic or the ERP.

  • Keep integration keys complete and accurate across all active SKUs.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 5+ years in PLM, product data management or product operations, including direct ownership of a PLM or comparable product-data platform.

  • Strong grasp of product hierarchy, multi-level BOMs, specifications and revision management.

  • Experience maintaining product data integrity against an ERP, including reconciliation and integration keys.

  • Experience designing or governing approval workflows and version control.

  • Advanced Excel and confident handling of large product datasets.

  • Excellent written and verbal English.

Preferred

  • Experience through a PLM implementation or major system rollout.

  • Vendor management experience with software providers.

  • Experience in Centric PLM would be a plus.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, integration mapping and UAT.

  • Python, SQL or Power Query for data reconciliation and automation.

  • Exposure to packaging, artwork or compliance documentation data.

  • Background in consumer products, retail, sourcing, manufacturing, apparel, footwear or hardlines.

Competencies

  • High ownership and accountability

  • Strong systems and structured-data thinking

  • Comfortable acting as a data gatekeeper

  • Independent problem solver — brings recommendations, not questions

  • Clear communicator across time zones and functions

  • Builds processes and standards that scale

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

  • PLM is live, but no single person owns its structure, standards and evolution.

  • Product data underpins sourcing, costing, compliance, quality and planning.

  • Residual implementation gaps need closing — and preventing.

  • Adoption determines whether the platform delivers its value.

  • This role exists to own PLM end to end, raise data standards, drive adoption and deliver the roadmap.

Leadership Assessment & Consulting

Education

  • Advanced studies or certifications (e.g., executive coaching, org psychology, OD, analytics) are welcome but optional if your experience speaks for itself.

Experience

  • Proven track record of direct headhunting and closing passive candidates across multiple markets/time zones.

  • Outstanding project management and organizational abilities.

  • Fluency with technology and AI tools as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought, using them to accelerate research, sourcing, and decision-making.

  • Global mindset: comfort working across cultures, languages, and sectors; high adaptability.

  • Integrity & empathy: candidate-first approach with uncompromising ethics and confidentiality.

  • Learning agility: iterate on playbooks, test new channels, and share best practices.

Our team profile

At matteria, Executive Search is fundamentally a people business. We believe outstanding results come from combining technical excellence with empathy, curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Our culture is built around ten guiding principles:

  • We Solve for the Client: their impact is our impact; we exceed expectations.

  • Responsible Autonomy: freedom with sound judgment; ownership and speed.

  • Curiosity: learn daily, research proactively, elevate collective knowledge.

Key interests for working with us
