About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities supporting U.S. and Canadian companies. We focus on long-term placements where experienced professionals can take real ownership, become trusted members of the team, and make a measurable impact from anywhere.

About the Role

As a Medical Administrative & Surgical Patient Coordinator, you will own the administrative coordination that happens after a patient begins moving through the surgical process. You will make sure required clearances, testing, records, appointments, documentation, and pre-operative steps are completed so patients stay on track for surgery.

This is an operations-focused healthcare role, not a sales position and not a remote clinical position. You will work directly with patients, medical offices, imaging centers, laboratories, hospitals, and other healthcare providers while knowing when a question or concern needs to be escalated to clinical staff. You will receive training on the practice's specific workflows and gradually take ownership of a critical part of the patient journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own and track the pre-operative process for multiple surgical patients from booking through readiness for surgery.
  • Keep each patient's pre-operative checklist current, identifying missing clearances, tests, records, documentation, and other requirements before they become delays.
  • Coordinate required appointments and testing, including imaging, medical clearances, laboratory work, and other pre-operative requirements.
  • Contact hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare facilities to obtain outstanding information and keep cases moving.
  • Follow up persistently with outside providers when testing, records, or clearances are delayed, advocating for patients while maintaining professional communication.
  • Conduct or support standardized pre-operative patient calls and clearly walk patients through established non-clinical instructions and next steps.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of patient conversations, completed requirements, pending items, and case status within the appropriate systems.
  • Communicate surgical readiness, outstanding requirements, and potential delays clearly to the broader practice team.
  • Recognize clinical questions, unusual circumstances, or concerns that fall outside your administrative scope and escalate them promptly rather than providing independent medical advice.
  • Provide additional medical administrative and patient-coordination support when needed to improve the efficiency of the surgical process.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in medical administration, surgical coordination, patient coordination, pre-operative coordination, or closely related healthcare operations.
  • Hands-on experience working in a U.S. medical practice or healthcare environment.
  • Direct experience coordinating surgical or pre-operative patients, including appointments, tests, medical records, clearances, or required documentation.
  • Experience using EMR, CRM, patient-management, or comparable medical-office systems.
  • Confidence communicating directly with patients and contacting hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare providers.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with strong documentation, organization, case-tracking, and follow-through skills.
  • Sound judgment regarding administrative versus clinical responsibilities, including knowing when an issue must be escalated to clinical staff.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in plastic surgery, cosmetic surgery, aesthetics, or another high-touch private-pay medical environment.
  • Medical Assistant training, nursing-related education, healthcare education, or equivalent clinical-office experience.
  • Experience conducting standardized pre-operative patient calls.

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Strategy

  • Develop and help lead the organic social media strategy across Instagram and TikTok

  • Help maintain a consistent brand voice, look, and feel across all social content
  • Develop organic content and creative concepts that can also be tested and repurposed as paid social advertising creatives

3. Publishing & Community Management

  • Own or support the day-to-day publishing of content across Instagram and TikTok

  • Identify high-performing creator content that could be repurposed across organic and paid channels

  • Communication: Strong written English; ability to write engaging social copy, captions, scripts, and content concepts
  • Analytics: Comfortable analyzing social media performance and making recommendations based on data

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Data Lead to help lead the strategy, governance, and quality of data on one of our large-scale federal data platform programs. In this role, you'll own execution of the data strategy for a multi-year enterprise data platform, lead the data supply chain, and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program that raises the bar for how data is documented, trusted, and reused across the platform. You'll govern how data is promoted from initial ingestion through validated, trusted status, set and maintain data quality standards, and serve as the connective tissue between the platform team and the many upstream source-system teams and business data owners who depend on it.

This is foundational work: the metadata and data quality practices you lead are what make it possible to safely expand governed self-service analytics and AI use cases. If you enjoy building durable data governance capability inside a live, high-stakes production environment — not just writing policy — we'd love to hear from you.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S., be able to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance, and obtain a U.S. Federal Government client badge. Bixal does not sponsor employment visas or assume sponsorship of existing employment visas.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $200,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own execution of the data strategy for a large-scale enterprise data platform, aligning day-to-day delivery with the organization’s broader data strategy and strategic goals.

  • Serve as the primary coordination point across multiple upstream source-system teams and business data owners, managing handoffs, ingestion readiness, and shared metadata standards across the ecosystem.

  • Lead the data supply chain — source onboarding, ingestion, and transformation — and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program, treating metadata as an operational capability rather than a one-time cataloging effort.

  • Govern the promotion of data through a tiered catalog architecture (e.g., raw, source, and trusted layers), defining clear admission criteria and applying the model consistently across teams.

  • Set and maintain data quality standards across the platform, including completeness, conformance, freshness against SLAs, and defect/rework tracking.

  • Partner with engineering, product, and AI/platform teams to ensure metadata and data quality are sufficient to support expanding self-service analytics and AI use cases.

  • Establish and track measures of data quality, metadata coverage, and promotion/certification cycle time, and use them to prioritize remediation work.

  • Communicate data strategy progress, risks, and dependencies to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership.

  • Participate in Agile/SAFe delivery cadences, including planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified and trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, plus at least 10 years of related experience.

  • Strong track record coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams and data owners in complex, multi-system environments.

  • Demonstrated experience owning or leading a data strategy for a large, multi-source enterprise data platform.

  • Experience designing and operating metadata governance or maturity programs, including cataloging, ownership models, and promotion/certification criteria.

  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar) and metadata/catalog tooling (e.g., Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Microsoft Purview).

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Working knowledge of distributed data processing concepts and common data programming or query languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Scala), sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams on pipeline design and performance.

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data concepts for non-technical audiences, including client leadership.

  • Professional certification in a cloud or data platform (e.g., AWS, Databricks), data governance (e.g., DAMA CDMP), or Agile delivery (e.g., SAFe).

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in highly regulated federal data domains (e.g., healthcare, benefits, or financial data).

  • Familiarity with responsible AI governance and how metadata and data quality maturity gate the expansion of AI use cases.

  • Hands-on experience building, tuning, or troubleshooting data pipelines on a cloud lakehouse platform (e.g., Databricks or comparable).

  • Exposure to CI/CD, source control, and observability tooling as applied to data platform and pipeline operations.

  • Experience with data lineage and impact-analysis tooling.

  • Experience supporting or serving in a Key Personnel role on a federal contract.

  • Background in federal digital services delivery.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

jobs.description:
Description

MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.

The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.

That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide, including at Fortune 500 companies.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader to lead the Cloud Integrations Team. The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. jobs.description:
At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra is what drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and instead create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for Fortune 500 companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. And we make this lofty standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design and technology together to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone.

We use these values to fuel superior results:

Lock arms
We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good.

Show hustle
We’re not ones to sit on our hands and wait. Instead, we anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional.

Embrace change
From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what’s next.

Elevate empathy
We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.

Never settle
We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

The Digital Platform Strategist is a collaborative, cross-functional practitioner who partners with enterprise clients to define, orchestrate, and activate the marketing technology (MarTech) ecosystems that power personalized, connected customer experiences. This role bridges business strategy, marketing operations, customer insights, and platform capabilities ensuring clients maximize the value across platform categories such as Content Management System (CMS), Customer Data Platform (CDP), Digital Asset Management (DAM), Experimentation and Personalization within the Sitecore, Optimizely, and Contentstack ecosystem.

You will guide clients in understanding what’s possible, how to mature, and how to activate MarTech investments through experience optimization, content operations, data foundations, and automation. This role is consultative, technical, creative, and highly collaborative.

What you’ll do:

Strategic Consulting & CX Vision

  • Lead discovery sessions with marketing, digital, IT, and product stakeholders to define business goals and map them to MarTech enabled CX outcomes.
  • Build platform activation roadmaps that clarify use cases, dependencies, data flows, content requirements, and measurable KPIs.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into actionable strategies that marketing and business teams can understand and execute.
  • Develop maturity assessments across personalization, content operations, data readiness, testing/optimization, and marketing automation.

MarTech Platform and Ecosystem Expertise

  • Serve as a subject matter expert across platforms such as:
  • - Content Platforms: Sitecore (SitecoreAI, XM Cloud, XP, Content Hub), Optimizely (CMS, CMP, Opal) and Contentstack (Content Cloud, Data Cloud, Agent OS).
  • - Customer Data and Personalization: Customer Data Platform (CDP), experimentation platforms, real-time decisioning, and AI-driven personalization tools.
  • Assess clients’ current-state platform usage and identify opportunities to unify data, content, automation, and analytics.
  • Work with lead strategists, solution architects, and technical teams to translate strategy into platform configurations, integration requirements, and implementation plans.

Personalization & Content Operations Strategy

  • Create frameworks for content orchestration, taxonomy, tagging, modular content, metadata design, and governance.
  • Define personalization approaches in relation to audience segmentation, journeys, triggers, content decisioning, and testing methodologies.
  • Partner with creative and content teams to ensure messaging and content structures align with platform capabilities.

Client Leadership & Collaboration

  • Act as a strategic advisor and platform evangelist for senior marketing and digital leaders.
  • Partner with client partners, project managers, designers, engineers, and analysts to ensure alignment between strategy and execution.
  • Present recommendations, POV’s, and roadmaps to executive stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
  • Contribute to new business pursuits, including vision decks, RFP responses, and workshop facilitation.

Development & Mentoring

  • Develop thought leadership and support business development.
  • Mentor and manage team members, while contributing to and advancing the Strategy competency. 

What you bring:

Required

  • 5–10+ years of experience in digital strategy, MarTech consulting, CX/UX strategy, or marketing operations.
  • Hands-on understanding of MarTech platforms such as CMS, CDP, DAM, marketing automation, and testing/optimization tools.
  • Proven ability to translate business objectives into actionable digital strategies and platform activation plans.
  • Experience defining content architecture, governance models, and personalization programs.
  • Strong analytical thinking with comfort interpreting data and shaping measurable KPIs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build trust among technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience working within or consulting for enterprise organizations with complex stakeholder models.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered content generation workflows, journey orchestration, and predictive analytics.
  • Understanding of privacy, compliance, and consent management frameworks.
  • Background in customer journey mapping, service design, or product strategy.
  • Certifications in Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentstack or other leading digital experience platforms.

Travel

  • Some travel required based on client and business needs

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer (CPO)
jobs.excerpt: About Allia Health GroupAllia Health Group (AHG) is building a vertically integrated digital health platform — connecting compounding pharmacy, women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record, and an AI-and-data infrastructure layer into a single, coordinated patient experience.
jobs.description:
About Allia Health Group

Allia Health Group (AHG) is building a vertically integrated digital health platform — connecting compounding pharmacy, women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record, and an AI-and-data infrastructure layer into a single, coordinated patient experience. Our portfolio spans a 503A compounding pharmacy, two direct-to-consumer telehealth brands, and a provider-network EHR launching in 2026, all sharing a common goal: deliver personalized, outcomes-driven care beyond the limits of the traditional healthcare model.

We are assembling a senior leadership team to scale that platform. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to define and lead the product strategy that turns a collection of strong businesses into one connected, durable healthcare system.

The Opportunity

This is AHG's first dedicated product executive. You will build and lead the product discipline across the company: what we build, for whom, why, and in what order — across every brand and surface. That means consumer direct-to-consumer subscription products in women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record launching this year, a clinical layer on top of a compounding pharmacy, and the shared patient platform that connects them. It is a deliberately broad mandate, and the breadth is the point.

The role is defined by a clear division of decision rights with our Chief Technology Officer.The CTO owns supply— architecture, engineering, data infrastructure, security, reliability, and delivery.The CPO owns demand— the user problems worth solving, the product strategy, the roadmap and its priority order, the discovery work that validates what gets built, and the outcomes the product is accountable for. The two roles are peers at the executive table, reporting to the CEO. Neither stacks under the other.

If you are the kind of product leader who is energized by building a function from the ground up — installing discovery, design, and product analytics as disciplines, growing a high-potential product team, and being personally accountable for whether real patients and providers actually use and value what we ship — this is a rare mandate.

AI is central to this role, not adjacent to it.Our CTO is investing heavily in AHG's AI and data platform — models, ML pipelines, automation, and safety infrastructure. We are looking for a CPO who is the demand-side counterpart to that investment: an AI-native product leader who decides which AI capabilities become real products for patients and clinicians, designs them to earn trust, and runs the product organization itself with AI woven into how the team discovers, prototypes, researches, and measures. You will not be selling AI to a skeptical company — you will be partnering with a technology org that is already all-in, and giving that capability a product and a purpose.

How the Role Works

AHG operates as a multi-entity platform.Each business unit is led by its own CEO who owns that unit's P&L. The CPO leads the product function as a shared, enterprise-wide capability that every business consumes — setting product standards, methods, and talent for the whole company, while owning end-to-end product for the shared patient platform and the new provider EHR directly.

  • Direct ownership:the shared cross-brand patient platform, the provider-network EHR product, the company's product discovery / design / research / analytics disciplines, and the product talent function.
  • Partnership ownership:business-unit roadmaps are set in close partnership with each BU's leadership. You are the executive who brings product rigor, evidence, and prioritization to those conversations — and the executive BU leaders escalate product and UX problems to.
  • Influence over authority:you will succeed here by being the most trusted voice on what's worth building, not by command. The mandate is real, but it is earned through evidence, outcomes, and partnership.
  • Stays with the CTO (not this role):the data warehouse and business intelligence, cloud and platform architecture, security and SOC 2, ERP and infrastructure vendors, engineering delivery, and the AI/ML platform and its safety infrastructure. The CPO sets the demand on these systems — what they must enable and why — while the CTO owns how they are built and run.

Key Responsibilities

Product strategy & portfolio prioritization

  • Own a product strategy for each business and for the portfolio — a distinct artifact from the technology roadmap that states, for each area: the user problem, the hypothesis, the outcome we are trying to move, and what we are deliberately not doing.
  • Prioritize across the portfolio through a product lens, not a bandwidth lens — deciding how finite product and engineering capacity is allocated across competing opportunities based on value, not on who asks loudest.
  • Champion a “connected system over isolated products” approach: a unified patient identity and experience across brands, rather than four disconnected silos.

Product discovery & evidence

  • Install product discovery as a standard: continuous customer and provider interviews, prototype and usability testing, and validated problem definition before significant build begins.
  • Require that major initiatives carry discovery artifacts — interview findings, an explicit hypothesis, and the metric that will tell us we were right or wrong — and make those artifacts drive what gets prioritized.

Design, user research & quality

  • Build the product design, user research, and design-system disciplines AHG needs — accessibility standards, interaction patterns, and a consistent quality bar across every brand and the EHR.
  • Be the executive accountable for whether the product is genuinely usable by the humans who use it — patients, providers, and pharmacists — and the advocate for the user when speed and shipping pressure compete with quality.

Outcomes & product analytics

  • Own outcome metrics, not output metrics: subscription retention and activation in the consumer telehealth brands, provider activation and retention on the EHR, medication adherence in the pharmacy programs, and patient experience (e.g., NPS) across the platform.
  • Stand up product analytics as a discipline distinct from business intelligence — event-level instrumentation, cohort and funnel analysis, and experimentation that lets a product manager find a drop-off and ship a fix against it.

Healthcare product leadership

  • EHR / provider experience:ensure the provider workflow is mapped, observed, and prototyped before production screens are built; reducing clinician cognitive burden is the single biggest determinant of adoption. Own the provider activation funnel end to end.
  • Clinical AI as product:set strategy for AI features that touch patients and clinicians — including an ambient documentation / scribing strategy for the EHR — partnering with the CTO, who owns the AI platform and safety infrastructure. You decide what AI ships to users and hold the line when something isn't ready, even if it is technically deployable.
  • Chronic-care platform layer:design the clinical-engagement layer (adherence, side-effect management, dose support) that turns medication fulfillment into a durable chronic-disease management experience.
  • Platform & interoperability:own the strategic product decision of whether AHG becomes one connected, multi-brand patient experience or stays a set of separate products — and ensure the shared platform and EHR are designed API-first, with a standards-based (HL7 / FHIR) encounter layer open enough to integrate external pharmacy, lab, imaging, and ambient-AI services rather than a closed system.
  • Regulated by design:partner with Compliance and Clinical so that product decisions respect HIPAA, telehealth, FDA, and clinical-safety requirements from the start, not as an afterthought.

An AI-first product organization

  • AI in the product:treat AI as a core design surface, not a bolt-on feature — set the strategy for the AI capabilities that touch patients and providers (triage and coaching assistants, ambient documentation, adherence and follow-up agents, decision support), partnering with the CTO who owns the underlying AI/ML platform and safety infrastructure.
  • Agentic AI with proportionate oversight:match the level of human oversight to the cost of a mistake — autonomous with audit logging for low-stakes, high-volume tasks; human-in-the-loop for medium-stakes; mandatory clinician review and accountability for anything liability-bearing. You decide what AI ships to users and hold the line when something isn't ready, even if it is technically deployable.
  • An AI-native team:run the product function itself with AI built into how the team works — AI-assisted user-research synthesis, rapid prototyping, competitive and market analysis, PRD and spec drafting, and product-analytics querying — so a small product team operates with outsized leverage. We want a leader who raises the bar on what AI-augmented product work looks like and hires people who think the same way.
  • Trustworthy by design:ensure AI features show their reasoning, expose confidence, and always leave a clear human override — in regulated healthcare this is a trust and liability standard, not a preference.

Team & cross-functional leadership

  • Build the product organization — hiring, leveling, and career paths for product managers, designers, and researchers, and developing existing high-potential product talent into senior leaders.
  • Partner deeply with the CTO and engineering to co-own delivery of the core platform, data products, and AI-enabled systems — product owns what and why; engineering owns how.
  • Serve as the bridge between the executive team and the product organization, translating company strategy into a roadmap and reporting on outcomes at the board level.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • A documented product strategy exists for each business and the portfolio, distinct from the tech roadmap, and is driving prioritization decisions.
  • Discovery, design, user research, and product analytics exist as functioning disciplines — with the right early hires in place — not as ad-hoc activities.
  • The provider EHR has a mapped clinical workflow, a decided ambient-AI strategy, and a measured provider activation funnel before — or at — launch.
  • Outcome metrics (retention, provider activation, adherence, NPS) are instrumented, visible to leadership, and owned by Product.
  • Business-unit leaders treat the CPO as the trusted partner they negotiate roadmap with and escalate product problems to.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 12+ years in product, with 5+ years in an executive product role (CPO, SVP/VP of Product, or equivalent) at a digital health, healthtech, regulated-SaaS, or enterprise-technology company.
  • A track record of building and scaling multi-product or platform-based ecosystems — not managing a single product line.
  • Direct experience in a regulated environment (healthcare strongly preferred; fintech or similarly regulated industries considered), including HIPAA, telehealth, FDA, or clinical-safety contexts.
  • Range across both of AHG's product worlds: consumer DTC subscription product (acquisition, activation, retention economics) AND provider- or clinical-facing product (clinical workflow, provider adoption). Deep expertise in one is required; credible, demonstrated range into the other is essential — this role cannot be filled by a single-surface specialist.
  • A proven partnership with a CTO/engineering leadership to bring complex products to market, with a clear, healthy demand-vs-supply working model.
  • Experience standing up product discovery, design, user research, and product analytics as disciplines — having built the function, not just inherited it.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-powered product features — ideally including LLM and agentic-AI use cases — with a clear point of view on oversight, safety, and trust in a high-stakes or regulated setting.

Skills & attributes

  • A strategic thinker who turns vision into evidence-based, prioritized roadmaps — and who says “no” well.
  • Deep product-led-growth and outcomes orientation; fluent in retention, activation, cohort, and funnel analysis.
  • A builder's instinct for design and user research quality, with the judgment to hold a quality bar under shipping pressure.
  • An influence-first operator comfortable leading a shared function across autonomous business units without relying on positional authority.
  • AI-native in how you work and lead — you use AI tools fluently across discovery, prototyping, research, and analysis, and you expect your team to; you are energized, not threatened, by a technology org going all-in on AI.
  • Strong business and commercial acumen — able to tie product investment to revenue, margin, and enterprise value, and to make that case to the board.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence; calm and clarifying in ambiguity and high growth.

Why Join AHG

  • Found the function.You will be AHG's first product executive, with the mandate to define how product is done across the company.
  • Real stakes, real users.Your work directly shapes patient and provider outcomes across pharmacy, telehealth, and a new EHR.
  • A clear seat.A defined demand-vs-supply partnership with a strong CTO, and a direct line to the CEO and board.
  • AI-forward, with a real platform behind it.Partner with a technology organization investing heavily in AI and data infrastructure — and own the product side of turning that capability into things patients and clinicians actually trust and use.
  • Platform-level impact.Decide whether AHG becomes one connected patient experience or stays four silos — one of the most consequential product calls in the company's next five years.

Bring more to life.

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact — innovating at the speed of life.

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

About the Diagnostics Platform

The Diagnostics Platform is one of Danaher's three global platforms, uniting a portfolio of leading operating companies whose work sits at the point of clinical decision — from the emergency room and intensive care unit to the pathology lab, the core hospital laboratory, the molecular diagnostics workstation, and the patient bedside. The technologies developed and delivered by these operating companies help clinicians detect cancer earlier, identify and manage infectious diseases ranging from tuberculosis and HIV to sepsis and respiratory infections, monitor critically ill and vulnerable patients continuously, and make faster, more confident decisions when time and accuracy save lives.

The platform has a global presence, with operating companies serving hospitals, clinical laboratories, and point-of-care settings on six continents. Its products are highly regulated connected medical devices and in vitro diagnostics (IVD) directly involved in acute-care and life-critical clinical decisions — making cybersecurity a patient-safety, regulatory, and brand-trust priority for the platform.

The Platform Information Security Officer (PISO), Diagnostics Platform is responsible for end-to-end cybersecurity execution across all operating companies (OpCos) within the Diagnostics Platform globally. As part of Danaher's global information security operating model — six central DIS Global Services pillars and identically structured DIS Platform Security Teams under each platform — this leader is the platform's senior-most cybersecurity executive and the operational counterpart to the Global CISO across a global conglomerate of OpCos.

The PISO enforces enterprise cyber standards across the Diagnostics OpCos, drives continuous improvement, and adapts the global program to the unique security needs of each OpCo's connected medical devices, clinical customers, regulatory obligations (including FDA premarket and postmarket medical device cybersecurity, EU IVDR, and IEC 81001-5-1 / IEC 62443), and manufacturing footprint.

This position reports to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and is part of the Global Information Security organization, located in Washington, D.C. and will be a remote role, with regular global travel required to Diagnostics OpCo sites.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Department & Team: Facilities & Real Estate
Reports to: Director, Global Workplace
Location: New York, NY preferred; Virtual US / East Coast Time Zone

Role Overview

The Technical Facilities and Project Manager is a key member of the Global Facilities and Real Estate team responsible for delivering and continuously improving Genesys workplaces globally. The role combines project leadership with technical facilities expertise to ensure offices are well designed, efficiently operated, sustainable, secure, and aligned with consistent standards. It leads complex design, construction, renovation, and infrastructure initiatives while developing scalable solutions across building systems, energy and sustainability, physical security, occupancy, and facilities operations.

Supporting a portfolio of more than 40 locations, this role translates global workplace strategy into repeatable, sound solutions while adapting to local requirements. Reporting to the Director, Global Workplace, the position partners with regional facilities teams, business leaders, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, landlords, vendors, sustainability and security teams, and other senior stakeholders.

This role provides meaningful visibility across global workplace initiatives and the opportunity to influence how Genesys facilities evolve as the portfolio and workplace needs change. Through close partnership across regions and functions, the role helps create reliable, sustainable, and effective workplaces that support employees and the broader business.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead multiple concurrent workplace design, construction, renovation, infrastructure, and facilities improvement projects from planning and due diligence through design, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.

  • Act as an owner-focused project lead, protecting Genesys interests and balancing business objectives, employee experience, technical performance, cost, schedule, quality, risk, and long-term operational value.

  • Develop and manage scopes, schedules, budgets, forecasts, procurement plans, change controls, risk registers, governance, reporting, and escalation paths; identify issues early and drive corrective action.

  • Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, vendors, landlords, and internal stakeholders across regions and time zones, and support site selection and technical due diligence.

  • Lead operational readiness and turnover, including commissioning, punch-list completion, asset documentation, training, O&M manuals, warranties, and transition to facilities operations.

Technical Facilities Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership across HVAC, electrical, lighting, controls, plumbing, life safety, building automation, metering, and related workplace infrastructure.

  • Assess existing facilities and system performance, risks, deficiencies, lifecycle needs, and improvement opportunities; read and review architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Evaluate designs for functionality, constructability, maintainability, regulatory compliance, sustainability, reliability, lifecycle cost, energy performance, and employee experience; participate in design reviews, value engineering, commissioning, and technical problem solving.

  • Translate workplace strategies into specifications, standards, workflows, and repeatable implementation guidelines, using lessons learned to continuously improve global practices.

Global Standards, Workplace Integration & Data

  • Develop and maintain global technical standards, design criteria, specifications, checklists, templates, and performance requirements for facilities, building systems, sustainability, security integration, and project delivery.

  • Partner with regional teams to apply global standards while addressing local codes, regulations, landlord requirements, climate, operations, and cultural needs; ensure project decisions transition effectively into ongoing operations.

  • Establish measurable requirements and verify completed projects perform as intended; support occupancy measurement, space performance, facilities analytics, and clear technical documentation that strengthens portfolio consistency and institutional knowledge.

Sustainability, Energy & Environmental Compliance

  • Embed sustainable design and operating practices into projects and facilities, supporting Genesys environmental objectives and alignment with ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems.

  • Advance energy efficiency, water conservation, responsible materials, waste reduction, indoor environmental quality, carbon reduction, and high-performance building practices; identify opportunities in HVAC, controls, metering, lighting, equipment, operations, and green-energy procurement.

  • Partner with stakeholders to measure, validate, track, and report energy, water, waste, and related environmental performance, and support applicable regional requirements such as CSRD, EED, and evolving sustainability frameworks.

  • Support LEED strategies for interior fit-outs and ongoing operations, and use post-implementation data to identify further efficiency and performance improvements.

Physical Security & Life Safety Integration

  • Partner with Corporate Security and other stakeholders to assess and integrate physical security and life-safety requirements into projects and existing facilities, including access control, surveillance, visitor management, intrusion detection, and related technologies.

  • Ensure security requirements are addressed early and coordinated with architectural, engineering, IT, facilities, and building infrastructure.

Financial, Procurement & Risk Management

  • Prepare and maintain project budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections, cost reports, and variance analyses; evaluate proposals, bids, estimates, change orders, and contractor recommendations for cost, quality, and value.

  • Partner with Procurement and Legal on sourcing, selection, contract administration, and vendor negotiations; monitor external partner performance and hold consultants and contractors accountable for commitments and outcomes.

  • Identify technical, financial, schedule, operational, compliance, and delivery risks; develop mitigation strategies and business cases that clearly present costs, benefits, alternatives, and long-term implications.

Stakeholder Leadership & Communication

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor and primary project contact for regional teams, business leaders, and senior stakeholders, translating complex topics into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Facilitate project meetings, design reviews, workshops, executive updates, and decision-making sessions, with clear visibility into status, risks, decisions, budget, and schedule.

  • Build effective relationships across a geographically distributed organization and navigate competing priorities while maintaining focus on successful project outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • 10+ years of experience in facilities, design, engineering, construction, or project management, including significant responsibility for complex commercial workplace projects and multiple concurrent, multi-phase initiatives.

  • Strong working knowledge of commercial building systems, construction methods, project controls, facilities operations, and the ability to read architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and technical documentation.

  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets, schedules, forecasts, procurement, risks, change controls, commissioning, and operational turnover.

  • Working knowledge of environmental management and sustainability practices, including ISO 14001, energy management, high-performance building principles, building codes, workplace safety, accessibility, and regulatory compliance.

  • Excellent organization, problem solving, decision-making, written and verbal communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to work independently and collaboratively in a global, remote-working environment.

  • Ability to periodically participate in meetings outside normal business hours for international collaboration and to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require, generally not expected to exceed 20%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience serving as an Owner’s Representative for corporate workplace, commercial interiors, or facilities projects and/or managing global or multi-regional project portfolios.

  • Professional certification or licensure such as PMP, LEED AP, PE, RA, CFM, or equivalent.

  • Experience with LEED ID+C or O+M, ESG initiatives, energy-management programs, environmental or energy reporting requirements, commissioning, building automation, metering, facilities analytics, or asset lifecycle planning.

  • Familiarity with BIM, AutoCAD, facilities-management and project-management platforms, reporting dashboards, and related digital tools.

  • Experience developing global technical standards, specifications, playbooks, or design guidelines for a corporate real estate portfolio.

  • Strong global perspective and commitment to continuous improvement, sustainability, resilience, accessibility, safety, workplace excellence, and employee experience

Application Security Engineer

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will make security decisions that impact millions of our customers while gaining hands-on experience in exploit development and CVE discovery. The ideal candidate will combine an attacker mindset with the humility and detail-oriented attitude required to coordinate fixes and security architecting with busy engineers.

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels? Three reasons:

This is the moment.It's an exciting time at Parallels — strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers
  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

Desired Qualities:

  • An attacker mindset: engineers will often want proof before fixes are implemented
  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job
  • The ability to communicate clearly, acknowledge mistakes, and disagree when necessary
  • Demonstrable passion for offensive security
  • Experience reading, writing and debugging C++ and Python code
  • Basic experience with memory exploitation techniques
  • Demonstrable experience with web exploitation techniques and tools (e.g. PortSwigger lab scoreboards)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • BSc/MS in computer science or a related field
  • Previous CVEs in desktop applications
  • Proficiency with reverse engineering tools
  • Significant experience in memory exploitation techniques (e.g. gaining code execution from memory vulnerabilities in modern operating systems)
  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

What are you waiting for? Apply now. We can't wait to meet you.

(FYI, we're lucky to get a lot of interest and we appreciate every application — please note we'll only reach out if you've been selected for an interview.)

jobs.description:
Job Post: Patient Outreach Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

Work Days: Monday – Friday

Salary: $5 - $6 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Our client is a well-established U.S.-based prosthetics and orthotics healthcare provider with approximately 30 clinic locations. We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and proactive Patient Outreach Specialist to join the remote scheduling and patient access team.

In this patient-facing role, you will help patients move efficiently from an initial inquiry, referral, or prescription to a scheduled appointment at the appropriate clinic. You will communicate with patients through phone, email, chat, and text while coordinating with physician offices and internal healthcare teams to ensure required information and documentation are complete.

This position is ideal for someone who combines excellent patient communicationwith strong organization and follow-through. You should be comfortable making outbound calls, guiding patients through next steps, handling objections or concerns professionally, and managing multiple patient cases in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

Above all, you will help create a positive patient experience by making the scheduling process as clear, efficient, and supportive as possible.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Outreach & Communication

  • Handle inbound and outbound patient inquiries through phone, email, chat, and text
  • Communicate with patients professionally, empathetically, and in accordance with HIPAA requirements
  • Promptly contact patients following an inquiry, referral, or prescription
  • Gather required demographic, insurance, referral, prescription, and relevant clinical information
  • Assess patient needs using established product, service, and scheduling guidelines
  • Clearly explain scheduling requirements, next steps, and expectations
  • Address questions and concerns while helping patients understand what is needed to proceed
  • Follow up consistently with patients who have incomplete information or outstanding requirements
  • Maintain professionalism when communicating with upset, hesitant, or difficult-to-reach patients
  • Send approved patient reminders, updates, newsletters, or other communications as needed

Patient Scheduling & Access Coordination

  • Schedule patients for prosthetic and orthotic appointments at the appropriate clinic
  • Determine the appropriate scheduling location based on patient needs, location, device type, documentation status, and provider availability
  • Support patient-facing scheduling and calendar coordination
  • Ensure required information and documentation are received and reviewed before scheduling
  • Coordinate with patients, physician offices, intake, billing, clinic teams, and other support departments to resolve barriers to care
  • Escalate difficult patient concerns, incomplete documentation, unreachable patients, or workflow barriers to the appropriate supervisor or department
  • Help ensure each patient interaction ends with a clear and appropriate next step

Documentation & Follow-Up

  • Review and confirm required documentation, including prescriptions, insurance information, physician details, referrals, and other necessary records
  • Accurately enter and maintain patient information in applicable systems
  • Document all patient interactions, outreach attempts, appointment details, and follow-up actions
  • Sort, prioritize, and respond to patient emails, text messages, and other communications in a timely manner
  • Maintain organized follow-up workflows for multiple patient cases
  • Protect patient confidentiality and ensure all documentation and communication meet HIPAA standards
  • Take ownership of assigned patient interactions through the appropriate next step or escalation

Additional Support

  • Collaborate with intake, billing, clinic operations, support teams, and leadership
  • Participate in virtual training, coaching sessions, team meetings, and remote huddles
  • Assist with internal calendar coordination when needed
  • Participate in community outreach events or virtual health education sessions when requested

What Success Looks Like

A successful Patient Outreach Specialist delivers an exceptional patient experience while helping patients get scheduled quickly, accurately, and compassionately.

Success in this position includes:

  • Timely and consistent patient outreach
  • Accurate and complete documentation
  • Strong follow-up and ownership of patient cases
  • Efficient and accurate appointment scheduling
  • Clear, compassionate, and professional communication
  • Effective coordination with internal teams and physician offices
  • Proper escalation of barriers or incomplete requirements
  • Consistent adherence to HIPAA and confidentiality standards
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in healthcare, patient scheduling, patient access, customer service, call center operations, sales, or another patient-facing role
  • Experience handling inbound and/or outbound calls
  • Comfortable conducting proactive patient outreach and following established scripts or workflows
  • Ability to professionally address questions, concerns, and objections while guiding patients toward an appropriate next step
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong listening skills and ability to understand patient needs, concerns, urgency, and scheduling barriers
  • Compassionate, patient, and professional communication style
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple patient cases, communications, follow-ups, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and metrics-driven environment
  • Strong follow-through and ownership of assigned patient interactions
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with intake, billing, clinic operations, physician offices, support teams, and leadership
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and commitment to protecting confidential patient information
  • Positive and resilient attitude when handling rejection, upset patients, incomplete information, or unsuccessful outreach attempts

Preferred Experience

  • 1–3 years of relevant patient-facing or healthcare experience
  • Previous experience with prosthetics and orthotics
  • Durable Medical Equipment (DME) experience
  • Medical scheduling or patient access experience
  • Referral and prescription coordination experience
  • Experience verifying or collecting insurance information
  • Experience communicating with physician offices
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms
  • Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems
  • Experience with VoIP or healthcare phone systems
  • Experience with chat or text-based patient communication platforms
  • Experience working with a U.S.-based healthcare organization

Basic requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English
  • Must have relevant healthcare, administrative, customer service, or patient-facing work experience
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory)
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required
  • Must be comfortable participating in virtual training, coaching sessions, and remote team huddles
  • Must maintain HIPAA-compliant work practices and patient confidentiality at all times
  • Must not have concurrent employment during scheduled working hours
  • Must be available for the required 40-hour workweek

Technical Requirements

  • Device: Reliable laptop or desktop computer
  • Internet: High-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps)
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset
  • Video: Webcam for virtual meetings
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.excerpt: Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.  Join us on theProduct Management team as a Product Manager –Mobile Platform, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.
jobs.description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Join us on the

Product Management team as a Product Manager –Mobile Platform, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.

Start your journey with Anova today!

Role Summary

This role's center of gravity is the customer — their experience of the Anova solution and their ability to realize meaningful value from it. You'll grow into deeper ownership as you build your track record here.

The Product Manager owns discovery and delivery across a defined product area within the Anova Unify platform. Working closely with a Senior PM or Director, you drive the full product lifecycle for your area — from structured customer research through to shipping, measuring adoption, and iterating. This is a hands-on execution role: you will write specs, manage a backlog, partner daily with engineering, and get close to customers. You won't be handed a roadmap to execute — you'll help shape it.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage. Use AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis. Build conviction before building product.
  • Own your backlog end-to-end. Write specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from. Prioritize ruthlessly. Keep the backlog current and free of ambiguity.
  • Ship and measure. Define success metrics before each release. Monitor adoption post-launch. Share what you're learning with the broader team and make fast, evidence-based adjustments.
  • Partner with engineering and design daily. Be a reliable, responsive partner. Unblock your team. Make trade-off calls with good judgment and know when to escalate.
  • Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.
  • Enable go-to-market. Write clear release notes, internal briefings, and customer-facing materials. Help sales and customer success understand what you've shipped and why it matters.
  • Support customers. Triage escalated product issues in your area. Maintain a feedback loop with support and customer success to surface patterns early.

Outcomes you'll own

  • Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your deep curiosity about customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to value for our customers' customers.
  • Feature adoption and customer value realization. Features you ship get used, and customers can point to the value. You define the adoption metric before you ship, track it after, and iterate until it moves.
  • Discovery pipeline. A healthy, evidence-backed backlog — prioritized from real customer insight, validated with data, and ready for engineering.
  • On-time, high-quality delivery. Your area ships on cadence and predictably. Specs are clear, edge cases are handled, and engineering isn't blocked waiting for answers.
  • Squad metrics. You track velocity, cycle time, and escaped defects — not to report up, but to spot friction early and remove it.
  • NPS contribution. Customers in your product area trust the product and feel heard. You stay close to feedback, close the loop on issues, and bring the voice of the customer into every decision.

How you'll work at Anova

  • Specs, one-pagers, and decision memos are how we align a global, distributed team — writing clearly forces clear thinking. AI can help you draft, but writing well remains your skill to own.
  • You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis, and you bring a clear point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products.
  • You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature, and you're comfortable pulling the numbers yourself in a modern BI tool.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Minimum Requirements -

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with mobile platform development, device connectivity, and software deployment.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product area strategy and adoption outcomes.
  • 6+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, or related technical functions.
  • You have at least one example of taking a product, feature, or initiative from zero — no spec, no playbook — to something real and used.
  • Track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software in close partnership with engineering teams — from spec to production — using Agile/DevOps.
  • Experience conducting customer discovery interviews and translating qualitative and quantitative insight into prioritized, well-scoped backlog items.
  • Demonstrated use of AI and LLM tools in a PM context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight.
  • Ability to write clear, structured specs, one-pagers, and narratives for cross-functional audiences.
  • Comfort reasoning about technical trade-offs — APIs, data models, integration patterns — credibly with engineers.
  • Data fluency: define metrics, pull and analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence-based roadmap calls.

Preferred Qualifications -

  • Prior experience in IIoT, connected-hardware, SaaS, or industrial technology environments.
  • Experience shipping ML- or AI-assisted features in a SaaS product.
  • Exposure to industrial or field-operations workflows — understanding how things work in the physical world.
  • Background in venture or private-equity-backed high-growth industrial technology companies.

ABOUT ANOVA

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer I - Mexico
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to provide world-class hardware and software support experience to our customers. You will be a part of our Tier 2 support team within the umbrella of the Global Technical Support organization. You will be responsible for resolving complex customer problems and improving support across all teams. Your work will be collaborative in nature, working together with other support engineers in multiple support locations to serve our customers and troubleshoot complex issues.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background with experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong communication skills. You understand the day-to-day aspects of customer support including managing tickets, building knowledge base articles, and providing product feedback to Engineering and PM teams.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.


In this role, you will:

  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on Samsara’s product portfolio of complete Internet of Things (“IoT”) solutions combining hardware, software, and cloud to bring real-time visibility, analytics, and AI to operations across multiple industries.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Use your technical knowledge and product expertise to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with medium to high complexity.
  • Responsiveness & Resolution: Respond to customers and resolve their inquiries in a timely and helpful manner with a primary focus on meeting our SLA goals.
  • Documentation: Partner with Enablement to author and maintain customer-facing knowledge base articles to help improve the self-serviceability for our end users.
  • Partnerships: Work closely to develop partnerships with our Engineering and Product teams in order to reproduce bugs and build testbeds as necessary.
  • Feedback Loop: Provide direct feedback to Support Management for product and process improvements to help enhance the customer experience.
  • Team Player: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
  • 1-3 years of experience in support, engineering, or other technical roles.

Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is a must.

  • Experience with troubleshooting and supporting hardware & software products.
  • Strong familiarity with using CRMs like Zendesk or Salesforce.
  • Technical know-how - you’re comfortable interfacing with engineers, translating complex technical concepts into everyday language, and working with SaaS systems.
  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills coupled with the ability to influence individual contributors and leaders across the company.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, improve processes, and drive greater efficiency
  • Strong bias for action, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.
  • Ability to work in a hyper-growth environment with shifting priorities.
  • Willingness to work holidays and weekends as needed to meet customer demands.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with industrial systems, electronics, tinkering with cars or IoT devices, or similar hands-on work is a big plus.
  • French or German proficiency is a big plus.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Job Description

Position Overview:

The Patient Financial Services Associate position (PFS) is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of claims, appeals, denials, and statements.
