  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy

  • Strong follow-through and accountability

jobs.excerpt: THE OPPORTUNITY: A new opportunity for an enthusiastic and highly driven electrical or mechanical estimator who enjoys dealing with people and wants to move into the tech industry.
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY: A new opportunity for an enthusiastic and highly driven electrical or mechanical estimator who enjoys dealing with people and wants to move into the tech industry.

Countfire is cloud-based takeoff and estimating software for electrical, mechanical and other construction contractors. We're growing in the United States and Canada, so this role supports customers on both sides of the Atlantic. Your working hours will include cover for North American business hours, which we'll agree with you up front.

You've probably not done a job like this before, and that's fine. Your estimating knowledge is the essential ingredient. The rest we'll teach you, with comprehensive on-the-job training in a supportive and collaborative environment. You'll be given clear processes to follow and won't be expected to figure things out on your own.

ABOUT VALSOFT CORPORATION:

Established in Canada in 2015, Valsoft has grown to a global portfolio of 120+ companies, acquiring and developing vertical market software companies, enabling each business to deliver the best mission-critical solutions for customers in their respective industries. A key tenet of Valsoft’s philosophy is to invest in well-established businesses and foster an entrepreneurial environment that moulds companies into leaders in their respective industries. Valsoft looks to buy, hold, and create value through long-term partnerships with existing management.

ABOUT COUNTFIRE:

Countfire is revolutionizing the construction industry with our automated takeoff software that's transforming how electrical contractors, estimators, and construction professional’s work. We're a fast-growing SaaS scale-up backed by ambitious goals and a team that's passionate about solving real-world problems with innovative technology.

Our team is lean, agile, and results driven. We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, experiment, and grow alongside our business. When you join Countfire, you're not just taking a job, you're joining a mission to make estimators superhuman and digitally transform an entire industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Answer inbound support enquiries from users in the UK, US and Canada, professionally and quickly.
  • Run training sessions with new customers as part of their onboarding, following our training format.
  • Learn the product inside out so users get the full benefit of every feature.
  • Use your first-hand estimating experience to relate to what users are trying to achieve.
  • Explain technical features in a simple way that people can understand.
  • Follow our internal processes accurately so every type of request is handled the right way.
  • Help maintain our response time (we aim to respond to any support request within 2 minutes).
  • Keep accurate records of the support conversations you handle.
    •

What we Provide

  • Comprehensive product and support training.
  • Coaching from experienced product specialists.
  • Clear, documented processes for every type of support request.
  • Set formats and materials for customer training sessions.
  • The tools you need to do the job well.
  • A collaborative remote team that shares knowledge openly.
    •

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years experience as an Electrical or Mechanical Estimator, or in a customer support or technical role within the electrical, mechanical, or construction industry.
  • A strong interest in technology and a desire to build a career in software.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and approachable way.
  • A customer-first mindset with a genuine passion for helping people succeed.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow established processes consistently.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer enquiries.
  • Confidence delivering customer training, presentations, or demonstrations (or the willingness to learn).
  • The ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while collaborating effectively with a global team.
  • A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and commitment to achieving individual and team performance goals.
  • Flexibility to work scheduled hours that overlap with customers in the United States and Canada.

Need to Have

  • Reliable computer with stable high-speed internet.

· Professional headset.

  • Quiet, private workspace suitable for handling customer information.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using estimating or takeoff software such as Countfire, Trimble, Bluebeam, Accubid, ConEst, McCormick, or similar platforms.
  • Previous experience in a customer support, technical support, help desk, onboarding, or software training role.
  • Experience working with CRM or customer support platforms (such as HubSpot, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar).
  • Experience delivering virtual customer training sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS (Software-as-a-Service) products and cloud-based applications.
    •

* This is a remote role supporting customers in the UK and North America. Your schedule will include agreed cover for North American business hours, alongside team meetings and training sessions.

Benefits

Although Countfire is an established product, we have the hunger and attitude of a young company- the best of both worlds and perfect if you're looking for somewhere you can make a real impact. The team comes from a mix of backgrounds. From ex-estimators with a wealth of industry knowledge, to developers and marketers with no estimating experience. But everyone has a lot to offer and are full of ideas and enthusiasm.

We work hard to "work smarter" using new technology tools to increase efficiency across the company, but we appreciate that not everything is in place or is perfect, so our team needs to be prepared (and excited!) for change.

#Countfire

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in India. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in India.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Workday Technical Consultant - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Workday Technical Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Workday Technical Consultant with broad expertise across Workday configuration, reporting, calculated fields, business process design, and Workday Extend application development. The role spans technical configuration, custom report design, integration support, and lightweight application extension work, helping HR, finance, and IT stakeholders get more value from the Workday platform. The ideal candidate combines strong Workday platform knowledge with practical engineering discipline and the ability to translate business requirements into clean, maintainable Workday configurations. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop complex calculated fields, custom reports, and advanced reports using the Workday report writer.
  • Build composite reports, matrix reports, and dashboards supporting business decision-making.
  • Configure and maintain business processes, condition rules, and approval routing across HCM and Finance.
  • Develop Workday Extend applications and PRISM analytics where appropriate, packaging custom logic in supported platform extensions rather than fragile customizations that complicate future upgrades.
  • Build report-as-a-service integrations and support data export needs for downstream systems.
  • Configure security domains, role-based security, and segment-based security across complex tenants.
  • Partner with HR, payroll, and finance stakeholders to translate requirements into Workday configurations.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for business processes, calculated fields, and security models.
  • Support Workday tenant refreshes, regression testing cycles, and platform release adoption, validating configuration and reports against expected behavior before each move into production.
  • Troubleshoot configuration and report issues in production tenants, working closely with functional teams to isolate root causes, propose remediation, and prevent recurrence through configuration improvements.
  • Collaborate closely with integration developers on report-driven data flows, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Provide guidance on Workday best practices and configuration design patterns.
  • Participate in Workday community forums, brainstorms, and product feedback channels, contributing field perspective and bringing back valuable insights and emerging best practices to the broader team.
  • Stay current with Workday releases and platform innovations, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of Workday technical experience.
  • Deep expertise in Workday report writer including advanced and composite reports.
  • Strong proficiency with calculated fields across HCM and Finance.
  • Hands-on experience configuring business processes and condition rules.
  • Strong understanding of Workday security framework.
  • Experience with PRISM Analytics or Workday Extend.
  • Familiarity with Workday tenant management and release process.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro certifications.
  • Experience with Workday Extend application development.
  • Familiarity with PRISM data ingestion and modeling.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Experience supporting Workday Payroll or Workday Financials.

The Rare Cardiology Field Medical, Team Leader possesses deep Therapeutic Area knowledge and is responsible for managing and developing a team of Rare Cardiology Field Medical colleagues.

Rare Cardiology Field Medical, Team Leader Role Responsibilities

  • Perform all Rare Cardiology Field Medical responsibilities in order to lead, manage, develop, and coach a team of Rare Cardiology Field Medical colleagues with Rare Cardiology and Pfizer medicine expertise

  • Guide work prioritization and resource allocation within team, and authorize expenditures for team related to travel, training, supplies, and other miscellaneous expenses

  • Conduct HR-related issues for assigned team (such as performance appraisals, salary planning, new colleague selection, colleague development plans, colleague retention, team culture, and conflict resolution) and manage concerns in a timely and compliant manner

  • Ensure team activities are conducted in compliance with all policies, guidelines, and regulations, and that team members complete all assigned trainings within the specified timeframe

  • Collaborate and partner effectively with Medical Governance team as appropriate

  • Partner with administrative professional staff to ensure effective support is provided to the Rare Cardiology Field Medical team

  • Assist the Rare Cardiology HQ Medical Affairs team with the strategic planning, development, inclusion of Field Medical insights, and execution of team Medical plan for Rare Cardiology, including budget planning

  • Support the Rare Cardiology HQ Medical Affairs team in the assessment and roll-out of major above-brand strategic initiatives

  • Ensure that communication and collaboration between HQ Medical Affairs and Rare Cardiology Field Medical and commercial functions are effective, appropriate, and compliant

  • Take accountability for the Medical Review Committee approval process within Rare Cardiology, ensuring appropriate approval of Medical content for Rare Cardiology Field Medical use in accordance with Pfizer Medical policies and SOPs

  • Serve on Rare Cardiology Field Medical and/or cross-functional committees and teams as requested by Medical Affairs leadership

  • Interact with investigators and other HCPs as appropriate in clinical and research activities

  • Understand, communicate, and adhere to current FDA and other US regulations and guidance that impact interactions with and delivery of medical information to external HCPs

  • Anticipate and lead team to effectively adopt new digital technology, on-demand, and other related offerings that improve the efficiency of Rare Cardiology Field Medical communications and activities and that enhance the overall Medical customer experience

  • Remain up to date on scientific and medical literature and developments within Rare Cardiology

Basic Qualifications

  • MD or DO degree required

  • 5+ years of relevant experience required

  • Demonstrate a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes, and create business impact

  • Demonstrate leadership skills with the ability to inspire, motivate, develop, and lead a team in a complex, changing environment that is focused on generating a positive Medical customer experience while embodying the Pfizer Core Values

  • Possess strong strategic, analytical, self-awareness, and interpersonal skills

  • Able to work independently while demonstrating flexibility and organizational awareness, adapting to changes within short timeframes

Demonstrate ability to:

  • Manage a diverse team of geographically dispersed professionals

  • Manage a significant volume of projects developed in a remote environment, while exhibiting the ability to prioritize, successfully implement, and demonstrate excellent judgment skills and work in a continuous improvement environment

  • Work within a matrixed, multi-disciplinary team to foster strong Pfizer/customer professional relationships which are aligned with Pfizer Medical objectives

  • Effectively manage through and lead change in an ever-changing and evolving external health care environment

  • Demonstrate change agility; be flexible to new opportunities (e.g. new therapeutic areas) and adaptable to organizational change

  • Problem-solve and network enterprise wide as appropriate to identify solutions

  • Collaborate effectively and demonstrate leadership and teamwork with peers, internal stakeholders and external customers that inspires alignment and partnership on a shared vision or strategy

  • Be a self-starter, be accountable, and have a sense of urgency in delivering results that have medical impact and yield a positive customer experience

  • Be decisive but exercise good judgement in decisions

  • Maintain self-awareness and continually choose behaviors and responses based on how it impacts one’s own and others’ performance and engagement

  • Demonstrate clinical and technical skills

  • Rapidly adopt and utilize new digital technology and other resources with medical customers and record medical interactions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with internal/external SOPs/Rules/Regulations regarding Pfizer/customer interactions and relationships, etc.

  • Previous Field Medical experience

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Operate a Pfizer company car and regularly fly on airplanes (i.e. attend HCP/customer meetings; attend NYHQ meetings, etc. required; proximity to airline ‘hub’ city); maintain flexibility to travel approximately 50% of time

  • Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired

Other Job Details

  • Last Date to Apply for Job: September 18, 2026

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $254,100.00 to $423,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 25.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

As Director, Internal Communications & Employer Brand, you'll drive two of our most visible functions shaping how Circle is understood — by employees, by candidates, and by the world. This is a highly cross-functional role for a strategic builder, operator, and storyteller who can shape programs, elevate standards, and partner across the business to deliver clear, credible, and compelling communications.

You'll play a central role in advancing Circle's internal communications approach across a distributed, global, remote-first workforce — helping employees stay informed, aligned, and connected to the company's strategy, priorities, and culture. You'll also advance Circle's employer brand, translating the employee experience into a strong, differentiated presence in the talent market.

What you'll work on

Internal Communications

  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, including HR and Corporate Communications, to develop internal communications plans for major initiatives, organizational moments, and company priorities – not reactive support, but proactive counsel on what to say, when, and how.

  • Help shape how Circle communicates company strategy and OKRs internally, translating priorities into messaging that feels relevant and actionable for employees across functions and regions.

  • Build and scale internal communications programs in partnership with the Employee Experience Director and other cross-functional partners to support engagement, connection, and understanding across a distributed workforce.

  • Evolve and maintain the operational infrastructure that makes communications effective and scalable, including: editorial planning, channel governance, distribution practices, and measurement frameworks.

  • Support Circle's intranet strategy and evolution, serving as the business owner steering this work in partnership with IT.

  • Support sensitive, high-stakes, and change-related communications with sound judgment, strong stakeholder partnership, and attention to timing, tone, and employee impact.

Employer Brand

  • Drive the ongoing evolution of Circle's employee value proposition (EVP) in partnership with Talent Acquisition, People leadership, and Marketing, ensuring it reflects real employee experience and talent priorities.

  • Lead employer brand storytelling and content strategy across priority channels — careers content, employee stories, social content, recruiting campaigns, and talent-facing moments.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to strengthen candidate experience as a brand touchpoint, using survey insights, feedback, and market signals to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Build and maintain employer brand intelligence infrastructure — including LLM/AI sentiment monitoring across major platforms and competitive benchmarking against talent peers.

  • Drive Circle's presence in employer awards, recognition programs, and talent-focused external opportunities that reinforce the company's reputation as a destination employer.

  • Build and own Circle's alumni network — selecting and launching the right platform, developing community strategy, and creating engagement touchpoints that keep former Circlers connected to the brand as advocates, referral sources, and potential boomerangs.

  • Ensure alignment between employer brand, people narrative, and broader corporate story so candidates and employees experience a consistent, authentic picture of Circle.

Content & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Oversee the development of high-quality content across internal and talent-facing audiences — executive messaging, employee features, onboarding communications, event content, and campaign materials.

  • Partner closely with Corporate Communications, Talent Acquisition, Employee Experience, and the broader People & Workplace team to ensure messaging is coordinated, timely, and mutually reinforcing.

  • Drive key communications moments in the employee lifecycle, especially new hire and onboarding communications, in partnership with program owners.

  • Serve as a trusted thought partner and communications advisor to People & Workplace leadership, Corporate Communications and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Bring a change-management lens to communications planning, helping teams communicate in ways that build understanding, reduce ambiguity, and support adoption.

AI-First Operations

  • Build repeatable, AI-enabled workflows across internal communications and employer brand that improve speed, consistency, and scale while preserving quality and editorial judgment.

  • Use AI tools across the communications lifecycle — research, synthesis, drafting, localization, content adaptation, measurement, and workflow design.

  • Contribute reusable prompts, templates, and automations to Circle's shared AI ecosystem so the function benefits from scalable ways of working.

  • Identify where automation can improve the operating model — recurring content workflows, campaign support, insights generation, and process coordination.

  • Model strong judgment around where AI should accelerate work and where human voice, sensitivity, or relationship context should remain central.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core Requirements

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in internal communications, marketing, HR communications, content strategy, or a related field, including meaningful experience operating in complex, cross-functional environments.

  • Exceptional writing and editorial judgment across formats, with the ability to adapt voice and messaging for executives, employees, candidates, and cross-functional audiences.

  • Strong strategic instincts paired with operational discipline — able to move between big-picture program design and the details required to make systems run well.

  • Strong track record driving internal communications programs at a fast-moving, global company — including communications planning, leadership messaging, editorial strategy, and stakeholder advisory work.

  • Experience shaping or scaling employer brand efforts, including EVP development, talent storytelling, campaign planning, or employer brand measurement.

  • Comfort using data and insights to assess effectiveness, identify opportunities, and improve communications outcomes.

  • Proven ability to influence across functions and levels, build trust quickly, and drive progress through partnership rather than formal authority.

  • People management experience, with a track record of developing talent, giving clear feedback, and building strong, resilient teams.

  • Demonstrated AI fluency in a communications, content, or brand context — you actively use AI to improve quality, speed, and scale, and can translate that into practical team workflows.

Preferred

  • Background in financial services, fintech, digital assets, or another fast-evolving, highly regulated industry.

  • Experience supporting communications through rapid growth, organizational change, or major business inflection points (IPO, M&A, rapid scaling).

jobs.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: up to $5 per accepted task equivalent depending on the project
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank app across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What Will You Build

  • Build mobile features across Android, iOS or cross-platform flows depending on your strength.

  • Create clean journeys for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX and AI-assisted features.

  • Work from product problem to shipped mobile experience, not just assigned screens.

  • Collaborate with backend, design, product and AI teams to launch reliable customer-facing features.

  • Improve app quality through production feedback, analytics, crash reports and user behaviour.

  • Help raise the standard for mobile UX, reliability and speed across the product.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Experience shipping production mobile apps used by real users.

  • Good product sense, UX judgement and attention to edge cases.

  • Able to work across APIs, releases, debugging and production issues.

  • Hands-on builder who can take ownership without heavy guidance.

  • Clear evidence of shipped work: app links, GitHub, screenshots or project explanations.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is based in Japan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Japan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Sunrise,FL - USA

Position Requirements

Location: Remote - nationally deployable; travel to assigned markets as required. This Market Region will cover the state of Illinois.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the cadence and accountability infrastructure that keeps NAPA client relationships healthy. Ensure that the right meetings are occurring on schedule, the right stakeholders are in the room, and that no relationship touchpoint falls through the cracks. Track and document all client engagement activity — chief meetings, administrator check-ins, joint reviews — and flag to the RVP when cadence slips or attendance patterns signal disengagement. Maintain timely, accurate records of all client interactions in the CRM. Proactively flag any issue, pattern, or signal that could lead to client dissatisfaction. Prepare materials and briefings that enable executive conversations to be high-quality and well-informed. The CSD will work in partnership with their Operations VP and Clinical VP to determine which relationships will be owned by whom and on what meeting cadence.

  • Serve as the first point of resolution for day-to-day operational issues in assigned markets, including staffing coverage gaps, payroll and scheduling inaccuracies, credentialing coordination, and compliance escalations. Drive accountability across shared services (RCM, HR, Talent Acquisition, Quality) to ensure timely, coordinated responses. Escalate to the RVP on issues determined to be outside of the decision scope.

  • Serve as a visible, accessible advocate for clinicians in assigned markets. Partner with Chiefs and Talent Acquisition on recruitment, onboarding, and credentialing. Monitor engagement signals and address concerns early. Participate in candidate interviewing and provide white-glove onboarding support. Track and address premium pay drivers, vacancy trends, and locum reliance as indicators of cultural or operational breakdown. Maintain knowledge of staffing models and flag model-level risks to the RVP.

  • Provide intentional capacity relief to Regional Vice Presidents by owning the operational and relational layer of account management. Prepare briefing materials, financial summaries, and client meeting prep; attend and support RVP-led strategic engagements as needed. Participate in FORC prep, monthly financial reviews, and other regional initiatives. Identify situations without resolution and bring structured recommendations — not just problem statements — to RVP attention.

  • Actively partner with the RVP to identify and develop expansion opportunities within assigned client accounts. This shall include developing strategic plans for where cross-credentialing should occur to enable more market-based clinical teams. The CSD’s on-the-ground presence and operational relationships make them a primary source of intelligence on client appetite for new service lines, ASC development, volume growth, or contract expansion. Surface these opportunities with specificity — context, timing, and the right internal contact. Maintain awareness of each market’s competitive dynamics and flag threats as well as opportunities. Serve as the connective tissue between field-level insight and NAPA’s RVPs and business development.

SCOPE & DEPLOYMENT MODEL

CSDs are nationally deployable and assigned to markets by need and strategic priority, not by physical proximity alone. A CSD may support multiple markets within a region or cross-region boundaries when RVP capacity and client risk warrant. Assignments are determined collaboratively with Regional SVP leadership and adjusted as portfolio conditions evolve.

Deployment principles:

  • Every client has an assigned, accountable partner with a preset meeting cadence with the executive decision makers for the relationship.

  • Travel cadence is defined by market need; CSDs are expected to achieve meaningful face time with clients and clinicians without being anchored to a single geography.

  • Remote-first work is the operating assumption; on-site presence is purposeful and planned, not incidental.

KEY INTERNAL RELATIONSHIPS

Vice President of Operations - Primary reporting relationship; CSD provides operational and relational capacity relief; escalates only issues requiring RVP authority.

Clinical Vice President - Dotted-line accountability; input on portfolio assignments, performance standards, and strategic priorities.

Chief Physicians / Chief CRNAs - Day-to-day operational partners; CSD supports chief effectiveness and surfaces leadership development needs.

APP Senior Director - Aligned on APP staffing models, performance trends, and practice integration.

Talent Acquisition / HR - Coordinated recruitment, credentialing, onboarding, and provider relations support.

RCM / Accounting - Monitor site-level billing performance; escalate compliance gaps and payer issues.

Client Success / Implementation Teams - Collaboration on new site stand-ups, HyperCare transitions, and escalated client satisfaction situations.

Centralized Scheduling Leadership - High-partnership relationship; CSD owns the effectiveness of every clinical schedule in their market, with shared accountability for delivering consistent operational standards across clients.

Centralized HR Leadership - High-partnership relationship; CSD routes all HR issues — provider relations, payroll concerns, onboarding, credentialing delays, personnel matters — through centralized HR leadership. Acts as the field-level connector and advocate, not the resolver. Timely and accurate escalation to HR is a core performance expectation.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in healthcare operations, account management, or clinical services administration, preferably within an anesthesia or physician practice management organization.

  • Demonstrated track record of managing complex client relationships and driving measurable retention or satisfaction outcomes.

  • Strong financial literacy: ability to read site-level P&Ls, identify performance variances, and communicate financial risk clearly.

  • Experience coordinating clinician recruitment, credentialing, and onboarding workflows in a multi-site healthcare environment.

  • Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to build trust with clinicians, hospital administrators, and executive stakeholders.

  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently — expected 30–50% travel depending on market portfolio.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with clinical operations systems including scheduling platforms (Qgenda preferred), practice management tools (iPro preferred), and CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics preferred).

  • Experience supporting or leading new site implementations in a healthcare services environment.

  • Familiarity with various types of client contractual agreements.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

Client retention in assigned portfolio - No at-risk contracts escalate without early CSD involvement and documented action plan.

RVP capacity relief - RVPs report meaningful reduction in day-to-day operational interruptions from CSD-covered markets.

Issue resolution cycle time - Operational issues are closed at the CSD level; escalation rate to RVP is tracked and declining.

Locum and premium pay reduction - Month-over-month reduction in locum reliance and unplanned premium pay in assigned markets.

Clinician satisfaction / retention - Chiefs and clinicians in CSD-supported markets report accessible, responsive support.

Client relationship health - Regular cadenced client touchpoints are documented; no significant satisfaction deterioration goes unreported.

TOTAL REWARDS:

North American Partners in Anesthesia (NAPA) offers excellent salary, benefits and paid time off.

  • Generous benefits package, including:

    • Paid Time Off

    • Health, life, vision, dental, disability, and AD&D insurance

    • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts

    • 401(k)

    • Leadership and professional development opportunities

    • ies

The Clinical Services Director (CSD) is a senior field-facing role responsible for the operational and financial health, clinician experience, and client relationships across an assigned portfolio of NAPA markets. Operating without a geographic residency requirement, the CSD is deployed where need and opportunity are greatest — providing consistent, high-quality support to their markets and amplifying the capacity and effectiveness of their VP of Operations who carries ultimate portfolio accountability.

The CSD role has full P&L ownership for their market and serves as the trusted, accountable partner to both NAPA clients and the clinicians who serve them. This is an intentionally matrixed role. The CSD works within the dyad clinical and operational leadership of their region, and is also expected to work through centralized service delivery leadership to achieve great outcomes. They consistently model the kind of cross-functional partnering that produces repeatable, high-quality output across every market they support.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Risk Assessor - Water Treatment Division

Position Overview

A Risk Assessor in JLL's water treatment division evaluates and manages risks associated with water systems in commercial and industrial facilities. This role combines technical knowledge of water treatment systems with risk management expertise to protect building occupants, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain operational continuity.

Key Responsibilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis

Conduct comprehensive risk assessments of water systems including cooling towers, domestic water systems, irrigation systems, and decorative water features. Identify potential hazards such as Legionella bacteria, chemical contamination, equipment failures, and regulatory non-compliance. Evaluate the likelihood and potential impact of identified risks on building occupants, operations, and the organization.

Regulatory Compliance

Ensure water treatment programs comply with local, state, and federal regulations including EPA standards, OSHA requirements, and industry-specific guidelines. Stay current with evolving water quality regulations and industry best practices. Prepare documentation and reports for regulatory audits and inspections.

Water Quality Monitoring

Review water quality testing results and treatment program data. Identify trends or anomalies that may indicate developing risks. Recommend corrective actions when parameters fall outside acceptable ranges.

Risk Mitigation Planning

Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies and control measures. Create water safety plans and emergency response procedures. Recommend equipment upgrades, treatment modifications, or operational changes to reduce identified risks.

Client Communication and Reporting

Prepare detailed risk assessment reports for clients and stakeholders. Present findings and recommendations to facility management teams. Provide training and guidance on water safety management practices.

Collaboration

Work closely with water treatment technicians, facility engineers, environmental health and safety teams, and client representatives. Coordinate with external laboratories, consultants, and regulatory agencies as needed.

Required Qualifications

Experience: 2-5 years of experience in water treatment, facility management, environmental health and safety, or related field. Experience conducting risk assessments or audits preferred.

Technical Knowledge: Understanding of water chemistry, microbiology (particularly Legionella control), water treatment technologies, and HVAC systems. Familiarity with risk assessment methodologies and regulatory frameworks.

Certifications: Relevant certifications such as Certified Water Technologist (CWT), Certified Legionella Professional (CLP), or similar credentials are highly desirable.

Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and as part of a team.

jobs.excerpt: CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance.
jobs.description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester, Gartner and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures. We empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.

Join a talented, product focussed engineering team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems within sales performance management.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in the earliest stages of product development — where the problems are ambiguous, the path is undefined, and the focus is on discovering what should exist, not just building what’s already been decided.

This is a highly creative, high-impact engineering role: you’ll help take brand-new concepts from idea → prototype → production, working closely with design, product, and customers. If you love building new experiences, validating assumptions quickly, shaping product direction, and turning abstract ideas into real software, you’ll excel here.

Remote: United States or Canada

What you’ll do:

  • Build 0→1 products: Create new services, features, and user experiences from scratch — often starting with rough prototypes and evolving them into scalable, production-ready systems.

  • Work through ambiguity: Take loosely defined, abstract problem spaces and transform them into clear technical and architectural approaches.

  • Partner deeply with product & design: Participate in customer discovery, sketch solutions, propose alternatives, challenge assumptions, and help define what valuable and delightful looks like.

  • Experiment rapidly: Build POCs, run technical spikes, validate ideas quickly, and iterate based on real customer feedback.

  • Influence product direction: Bring an engineering-driven perspective to what we build, how we build it, and what tradeoffs are worth making at early stages.

  • Design and build scalable systems once we validate the direction, balancing speed with long-term maintainability.

  • Raise the technical bar: Contribute to architectural discussions, coding standards, best practices, and mentoring other engineers.

  • Own quality end-to-end: From early prototypes to robust production code, you care deeply about reliability, performance, and customer experience.

What you’ll bring:

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience shipping real products in fast-moving environments.

  • Proven success building new products or highly exploratory features (0→1, startups, innovation labs, greenfield initiatives).

  • Comfort working with high ambiguity and incomplete information — you can define direction, propose solutions, and move work forward without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Strong customer empathy and interest in learning directly from users.

  • Fluency in full-stack development (or strong backend experience paired with solid product instincts), with hands-on experience in Python/Django, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and PostgreSQL.

  • Solid understanding of system design, APIs, performance, and scalable architecture.

  • Ability to balance speed vs. quality — you know when to build scrappy and when to build durable.

  • Excellent communication skills and willingness to collaborate across disciplines.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • You’ll help define a brand-new product experience and shape its technical foundation.

  • You’ll work in a space where engineering has a huge voice in product direction.

  • You’ll operate at the intersection of creativity, customer needs, and deep technical work.

  • The problems are meaningful, the ambiguity is real, and your impact will be visible from day one.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.
  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.
  • Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.
  • Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.
  • Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.
  • Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.
  • Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.

Notice to Prospective Candidates:

  • Only emails from @captivateiq.com should be trusted.
  • We are aware of active recruitment scams using the CaptivateIQ name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never do the following:Attempt to correspond with a candidate using a free web-based account, such as an email address that ends in @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @hotmail.com, etc.
  • Make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face-to-face using secure video-conferencing technology.
  • Ask candidates to cash checks to buy equipment on behalf of CaptivateIQ.
  • Ask candidates to make a payment in order to be considered for a position.
  • Make early requests for candidates' personal information such as date of birth, passport details, credit card numbers, bank details and social security number, etc.
  • Please note that we’ll only ask for more sensitive personal information in connection with background checks after an offer is made.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide after-hours support, ensuring timely resolution of critical issues and maintaining system uptime.

jobs.title: Android Developer
jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role: We're seeking an experienced Stock Plan Administrator to own Devoted's equity plan operations.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

We're seeking an experienced Stock Plan Administrator to own Devoted's equity plan operations. This role will develop, build, and run a best-in-class company equity plan function for the long term — one that's accurate, compliant, and easy for all shareholders (and especially employees) to navigate as we grow. You'll administer our stock option program day to day, ensure we have tools and processes to scale, inform our employee equity compensation strategy, provide education, and support shareholder liquidity as our equity program evolves.

You'll partner closely with teams across People, Legal, Accounting, Tax, Payroll, and other Finance operations, and serve as the definitive owner of the equity plan function — building the processes, controls, and documentation that scale with our investor cap table, potential transaction activity, and headcount while supporting and informing the full range of equity plan compensation activity across a growing private company. This role will report to the VP of Corporate Finance.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Oversee daily equity plan operations in Carta, including grant processing, option exercises, cancellations, repurchases, and cap table management.

  • Evaluate equity administration tools and lead implementation of new solutions.

  • Manage monthly and quarterly equity reconciliations and reporting.

  • Administer employee equity plan transactions accurately and compliantly, including any liquidity events the Company may offer, from planning through employee communications and settlement.

  • Build and optimize processes for equity plan transactions, particularly option exercises, while ensuring accuracy and compliance.

  • Support the development of equity plan tax policies and procedures in partnership with Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Payroll.

  • Design and document standard operating procedures and strong internal controls for all equity plan operations, including audit support.

  • Manage the 409A valuation process and cadence in collaboration with Legal and Accounting, and its downstream effects on grants, exercises, and liquidity events.

  • Lead HRIS and payroll system integrations to streamline equity plan operations and eliminate manual reconciliation.

  • Develop automated processes for tax withholding calculations and payroll integration, including withholding on liquidity events.

  • Create scalable workflows that support our growing headcount over a multi-year private horizon.

  • Coordinate equity plan tax calculations and timely, accurate withholding and reporting with Payroll (including Forms 3921/3922 and W-2 treatment).

  • Support the introduction of new instruments such as RSUs (including appropriate vesting design for a private company) as the program evolves.

  • Provide high-touch guidance and support to managers and employees on equity-related questions — helping them understand their equity, from grants and vesting to exercises, secondaries, taxes, and payroll impacts.

  • Manage the equity-related information verification from non-employee shareholders including, but not limited to, audit requests, shareholding confirmations, and 409a value verification.

Required skills and experience:

  • 8+ years in equity plan administration, stock plan management, or a related field.

  • Hands-on administrator-level experience with Carta; experience with Shareworks and other platforms is a plus.

  • Strong knowledge of equity compensation principles and their tax treatment, including stock options (ISOs and NSOs) and RSUs, and the accounting treatment and execution experience of various private company liquidity events.

  • Proficiency with payroll systems integration and tax withholding processes.

  • A detail-oriented approach with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to both consult subject matter experts on bespoke equity issues across legal, tax, accounting, and payroll and explain complex equity concepts to employees in plain language.

Desired skills and experience:

  • A Certified Equity Professional (CEP) designation.

  • Experience at a high-growth private company with a wide shareholder base.

  • Hands-on experience administering private company liquidity events.

  • Experience evaluating different forms of employee equity, introducing a new instrument, and managing it on an ongoing basis post-introduction (e.g., evaluating and introducing RSUs to an options-focused employee equity program).

  • Knowledge of US and international equity compensation and tax requirements.

  • Familiarity with ASC 718 stock-based compensation and internal controls.

  • Excellent project management skills with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with modeling.

Salary Range: $110,000 - $194,000 annually base plus annual cash bonus

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

Description

We are hiring Bilingual Patient Services Representatives to join a growing healthcare support team in a fully remote role based in Mexico.

In this position, you will serve as an important point of contact for patients and healthcare providers, supporting both inbound patient calls and proactive outbound outreach. You will help patients with appointments, follow-ups, general nonclinical questions, and other patient-support needs while ensuring every interaction is handled professionally, accurately, and with care.

This is a great opportunity for someone with healthcare, medical office, patient services, healthcare contact center, insurance, or scheduling experience who is comfortable working in a structured, high-accountability environment.

What You'll Do

  • Handle inbound patient calls, messages, appointment requests, callbacks, and general nonclinical inquiries.
  • Schedule, reschedule, confirm, and cancel appointments according to established provider and workflow requirements.
  • Make outbound calls for appointment follow-ups, Annual Wellness Visits, new initiatives, canceled or unconfirmed appointments, website requests, and other approved patient-engagement campaigns.
  • Follow approved scripts for results-call workflows and appropriately route clinical questions to licensed staff.
  • Support insurance verification and prior-authorization workflows within the assigned scope.
  • Conduct approved Medicare, MIPS, HEDIS, and other patient outreach activities.
  • Communicate clearly and patiently with patients, including older adults who may require additional explanation, repetition, or a slower speaking pace.
  • Accurately document calls, patient interactions, appointment information, outcomes, messages, and follow-up requirements in the appropriate systems.
  • Communicate patient needs, scheduling challenges, escalations, and unresolved issues to office staff.
  • Maintain strong attendance, schedule adherence, productivity, quality, and patient-experience standards.

Work From Home & Technical Requirements

Company equipment will be provided.

You will need:

  • A reliable high-speed Ethernet connection with at least 25-30 Mbps download speed.
  • A dedicated, quiet, and secure workspace.
  • Professional wired USB headset.
  • Web-enabled camera and microphone.
  • Active email account.
  • Dual monitors.

Schedule

Monday-Friday | 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Pacific Time

  • Weekends off
  • Fully remote; work from home in Mexico

Compensation & Contract

  • $5.50 USD per hour
  • 40 hours per week
  • Paid weekly in arrears
  • Independent Contractor position

﻿

﻿Hiring Process

To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process.

Our process includes:

  1. Resume and Pre-Screen Questionnaire
  2. One-Way Video Interview
  3. Pre-Screen interview
  4. Client Interview

Please Note

  • ﻿This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent/professional English and Spanish, both spoken and written.
  • At least 6 months of customer service experience in a doctor's office, clinic, healthcare contact center, insurance office, scheduling operation, or similar patient-support environment.
  • Experience handling inbound calls and outbound follow-up in a structured environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.
  • Excellent organization and follow-through.
  • Ability to learn and consistently follow scripts, SOPs, workflows, escalation procedures, and documentation standards.
  • Ability to multitask across phone systems, electronic medical records, online requests, and internal communications.
  • Reliable attendance and strong schedule adherence.
  • A dedicated, quiet, secure work-from-home environment suitable for handling confidential patient information.
  • A secondary location available in case of a home internet or power outage.

Preferred Experience

  • Healthcare scheduling across multiple providers, clinics, or appointment types.
  • Insurance verification or prior authorization.
  • Medicare or Annual Wellness Visit outreach.
  • MIPS or HEDIS workflows.
  • Medical front desk, patient access, referrals, or back-office support.
  • Experience with an EMR/EHR and contact-center telephony platform.
  • Aprima or Intermedia/Elevate experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience identifying patient-access barriers and suggesting practical workflow improvements.

jobs.description:
My jsme Teya!

Teya vznikla na základě jednoduchého přesvědčení: lokální podniky si zaslouží víc.

Jsou to kavárny, restaurace, salony, obchody a podnikatelé, kteří vdechují život našim ulicím, vytvářejí pracovní místa a drží komunity pohromadě. Finanční služby jim však život příliš dlouho jen ztěžovaly – zbytečně složitými nástroji, špatnou podporou a komplexností, která je při podnikání jen brzdí.

Teya existuje proto, aby to změnila.

Budujeme finanční platformu pro lokální podniky po celé Evropě – platformu postavenou na jednoduchých nástrojích, propracovaném designu a reálné lidské podpoře. Naši členové na nás spoléhají, že jim pomůžeme podnikat s jistotou, a tato zodpovědnost formuje způsob, jakým pracujeme. Postupujeme rychle. Záleží nám na kvalitě. Jdeme do hloubky detailů. A věříme, že skvělé výsledky a upřímná pohostinnost by měly jít ruku v ruce.

Pokud chceš vytvářet smysluplné produkty, řešit reálné problémy a přinést lokálním podnikům skutečnou změnu, ozvi se nám!

Co tě u nás čeká? 🚀

Jako Partnerships Manager budeš nejen budovat a pěstovat vztahy s existujícími partnery, ale i aktivně vyhledávat nové příležitosti. Hledáme „architekta“ partnerství, který v sobě spojuje obchodní dravost s precizním projektovým managementem a analytickým myšlením.

  • Správa a rozvoj partnerství: Posilování vztahů s existujícími partnery, efektivní komunikace a zajištění vzájemného úspěchu.

  • Akvizice: Proaktivní vyhledávání, oslovování a kvalifikace potenciálních partnerů, včetně zajištění celého procesu onboardingu.

  • Strategické plánování a analýza: Úzká spolupráce s produktovými a komerčními týmy při tvorbě růstových strategií. Budeš zpracovávat data, tvořit byznys modely (např. pro nákup portfolií) a transformovat je do konkrétních byznys dokumentů.

  • Reporting a Insights: Poskytování pravidelných reportů o výkonnosti partnerství, analýza tržních trendů a zpětná vazba pro produktový tým.

  • Administrativní exekutiva: Odpovědnost za čistý a precizní administrativní chod, projektové řízení a management všech zainteresovaných stakeholderů.

Co k tomu potřebuješ? ✅

  • Obchodní praxe a zkušenosti: Zkušenosti s B2B obchodem, budováním partnerství nebo business developmentem (fintech zkušenost je velkým plusem).

  • Analytický mindset: Jsi doma v Excelu. Dokážeš interpretovat data, na jejich základě optimalizovat výkonnost a dělat kvalifikovaná rozhodnutí.

  • Projektové řízení: Schopnost řídit komplexní projekty, vést více stakeholderů najednou a dotahovat věci do konce.

  • Drive: Jsi iniciativní, samostatný/á a umíš být „pushy“, když je potřeba projekt posunout vpřed.

  • Komunikační dovednosti: Profesionální vystupování, schopnost vyjednávat a budovat důvěru u různých stakeholderů.

  • Jazyky: Plynulá čeština/slovenština a angličtina

Co za to?💰

  • Férová fixní mzda + motivující bonusy – tvoje snaha se cení!

  • Flexibilita – nemáme pevnou pracovní dobu a na home office se vždy domluvíme

  • 26 dní volna + 3 sick days – protože odpočinek je základ

  • BenefitPlus karta, Stravenky a Příspěvek na Dopravu (Lítačka) – vše, co potřebuješ pro pohodlný pracovní život, od Multisportky přes obědy až po cestování po městě.

  • Péče o duševní zdraví s Hedepy – abychom ti pomohli udržet si psychickou pohodu a balanc

  • Měsíční týmové meetingy v Praze – den plný inspirace, sdílení zkušeností, skvělé atmosféry i příběhů našich zákazníků

Chceš do toho jít?

Celý proces se snažíme držet svižný a přátelský – stejně jako naše kultura. Žádná zbytečná kola navíc, ale férový a otevřený přístup.

💥 Přihlas se hned teď a do pár dnů se ti ozveme! 🚀
